-- | Bindings to the QuantLib library.
@package hasquant
@version 0.5.0.0

module QuantLib.Syntax

-- | make a function with the first argument put at the last position, sort
--   of any arity flip to make it easier to chain monadic calls
--   
--   <pre>
--   -- advance :: Calendar -&gt; Date -&gt; (Int, TimeUnit) -&gt; BusinessDayConvention -&gt; Bool -&gt; IO Date
--   calendar Null &gt;&gt;= $(free1st 'advance) d (3, Months) Following False
--   </pre>
free1st :: Name -> ExpQ

-- | same as <a>free1st</a>, but frees the second argument instead of the
--   first
--   
--   <pre>
--   -- blackConstantVol :: Calendar -&gt; Date -&gt; Quote -&gt; DayCounter -&gt; IO BlackVolTermStructure
--   calendar TARGET &gt;&gt;= $(free2nd 'blackConstantVol) settl volQ dc
--   </pre>
free2nd :: Name -> ExpQ

-- | like <a>free1st</a>, but for a target <a>reify</a> can't see — a local
--   <tt>where</tt>/<tt>let</tt> binding, or an expression that isn't a
--   name at all (a lambda, a section, an operator) — so the arity is
--   supplied explicitly and the target becomes the generated function's
--   first argument instead. Top-level bindings and typeclass methods don't
--   need this; <a>free1st</a> handles both.
--   
--   <pre>
--   -- parRate is a local where-binding here, so 'parRate wouldn't reify
--   forM curves $ $(free1st' 3) parRate (bondSettle :| ds) dc
--   </pre>
free1st' :: Int -> ExpQ

-- | same as <a>free1st'</a>, but frees the second argument instead of the
--   first
free2nd' :: Int -> ExpQ

-- | the general form behind <a>free1st</a>/<a>free2nd</a>: frees the
--   <tt>i</tt>-th (1-based) argument of a reified function, moving it to
--   the trailing position
--   
--   <pre>
--   $(freeNth 3 'f) a1 a2 a4 a3  ==  f a1 a2 a3 a4
--   </pre>
freeNth :: Int -> Name -> ExpQ

-- | the general form behind <a>free1st'</a>/<a>free2nd'</a>: like
--   <a>freeNth</a>, but with a user-supplied arity instead of one
--   discovered via <a>reify</a>, and taking the target as its first
--   argument (see <a>free1st'</a>)
freeNth' :: Int -> Int -> ExpQ

-- | generalizes <a>free1st</a>/<a>free2nd</a>/<a>freeNth</a>: frees an
--   arbitrary subset of argument positions (by 1-based index) instead of a
--   single hardcoded one, moving them to the trailing position in their
--   original relative order
--   
--   <pre>
--   -- f :: A -&gt; B -&gt; C -&gt; D -&gt; R
--   $(cutAt [1,3] 'f) b d a c  ==  f a b c d
--   </pre>
cutAt :: [Int] -> Name -> ExpQ

-- | like <a>cutAt</a>, but with a user-supplied arity instead of one
--   discovered via <a>reify</a>, for a target <a>reify</a> can't see (same
--   reason as <a>free1st'</a>); the target becomes the generated
--   function's first argument
cutAt' :: [Int] -> Int -> ExpQ

-- | <a>cut</a>-style partial application via placeholders (in the spirit
--   of SRFI's <tt>cut</tt>): mark the argument(s) to leave free with a
--   bare <tt>_</tt> or a named hole (<tt>_x</tt>) -- GHC's own typed-hole
--   syntax, valid in any expression position -- inside a quoted
--   expression. Each hole becomes a trailing lambda parameter, ordered by
--   first occurrence, left to right. Repeating a named hole reuses the
--   parameter its first occurrence introduced, so the same argument can be
--   fed to several positions at once; a bare <tt>_</tt> is anonymous and
--   always gets a parameter of its own. Unlike
--   <a>freeNth</a>/<a>cutAt</a>, this never reifies the target, so it
--   works equally well on ordinary functions, typeclass methods, local
--   bindings, and operators.
--   
--   <pre>
--   $(cut [| advance _ (3, Months) Following False |]) `fmap` calendar Null
--   -- one argument fed to two positions:
--   $(cut [| f _x 2 _x |]) 1  ==  f 1 2 1
--   </pre>
cut :: ExpQ -> ExpQ

data Error
CPlusPlusException :: String -> Error
DateConversion :: Day -> Error
EnumConversion :: String -> Error
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Type.Error
instance GHC.Internal.Exception.Type.Exception QuantLib.Type.Error
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Type.Error

module QuantLib.TermStructure

-- | <pre>
--   TermStructure = GenTermStructure t
--    YieldTermStructure = GenYieldTermStructure y = GenTermStructure t
--      FittedBondDiscountCurve = GenYieldTermStructure ...
--      RelinkableYieldTermStructure = GenYieldTermStructure ...
--   </pre>
--   
--   (MultiCurve, below with the other standalone leaves, is not a
--   YieldTermStructure member -- it manages a cycle of them, handing out
--   <a>YieldTermStructure</a> handles via addBootstrappedCurve /
--   addNonBootstrappedCurve. See its own definition's comment.) &gt;
--   VolatilityTermStructure &gt; OptionletVolatilityStructure &gt;
--   RelinkableOptionletVolatilityStructure &gt; BlackVolTermStructure &gt;
--   BlackVarianceCurve &gt; BlackVolatilitySurfaceDelta &gt;
--   RelinkableBlackVolTermStructure &gt; SwaptionVolatilityStructure &gt;
--   RelinkableSwaptionVolatilityStructure &gt; SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube
--   &gt; InterpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCube &gt; CapFloorTermVolSurface
--   &gt; LocalVolTermStructure &gt; CallableBondVolatilityStructure &gt;
--   DefaultProbabilityTermStructure &gt; ZeroInflationTermStructure &gt;
--   YoYInflationTermStructure
type TermStructure = GenTermStructure CTermStructure
data GenTermStructure t
asTermStructure :: GenTermStructure t -> IO TermStructure

-- | the date at which discount = 1.0 and/or variance = 0.0
referenceDate :: GenTermStructure t -> IO Day

-- | the latest date for which the curve can return values
maxDate :: GenTermStructure t -> IO Day

module QuantLib.Process
data ProcessDiscretization
EulerDiscretization :: ProcessDiscretization
EndEulerDiscretization :: ProcessDiscretization
data ExtendedBlackScholesMertonProcessDiscretization
ExtendedBSMEuler :: ExtendedBlackScholesMertonProcessDiscretization
Milstein :: ExtendedBlackScholesMertonProcessDiscretization
PredictorCorrector :: ExtendedBlackScholesMertonProcessDiscretization
data HestonProcessDiscretization
HestonPartialTruncation :: HestonProcessDiscretization
HestonFullTruncation :: HestonProcessDiscretization
HestonReflection :: HestonProcessDiscretization
NonCentralChiSquareVariance :: HestonProcessDiscretization
QuadraticExponential :: HestonProcessDiscretization
QuadraticExponentialMartingale :: HestonProcessDiscretization
BroadieKayaExactSchemeLobatto :: HestonProcessDiscretization
BroadieKayaExactSchemeLaguerre :: HestonProcessDiscretization
BroadieKayaExactSchemeTrapezoidal :: HestonProcessDiscretization
data GJRGARCHProcessDiscretization
GJRGARCHPartialTruncation :: GJRGARCHProcessDiscretization
GJRGARCHFullTruncation :: GJRGARCHProcessDiscretization
GJRGARCHReflection :: GJRGARCHProcessDiscretization
data HybridHestonHullWhiteProcessDiscretization
HybridHestonHullWhiteEuler :: HybridHestonHullWhiteProcessDiscretization
BSMHullWhite :: HybridHestonHullWhiteProcessDiscretization
type GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess = GenGeneralizedBlackScholesProcess CGeneralizedBlackScholesProcess
type StochasticProcess1D = GenStochasticProcess1D CStochasticProcess1D
type GenStochasticProcess1D p1d = GenStochasticProcess AnyOf CStochasticProcess1D' p1d

-- | <pre>
--   StochasticProcess
--     ExtOUWithJumpsProcess
--     GJRGARCHProcess
--     HybridHestonHullWhiteProcess
--     KlugeExtOUProcess
--     LiborForwardModelProcess
--     StochasticProcessArray
--     HestonProcess
--       BatesProcess
--     StochasticProcess1D
--       ExtendedOrnsteinUhlenbeckProcess
--       HullWhiteForwardProcess
--       HullWhiteProcess
--       Merton76Process
--       VarianceGammaProcess
--       GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess
--         BlackProcess
--   </pre>
type StochasticProcess = GenStochasticProcess CStochasticProcess
data GenStochasticProcess p
type BlackProcess = GenGeneralizedBlackScholesProcess CBlackProcess
type ExtOUWithJumpsProcess = GenStochasticProcess CExtOUWithJumpsProcess
type ExtendedOrnsteinUhlenbeckProcess = GenStochasticProcess1D CExtendedOrnsteinUhlenbeckProcess
type GJRGARCHProcess = GenStochasticProcess CGJRGARCHProcess
type HestonProcess = GenHestonProcess CHestonProcess
type GenHestonProcess hp = GenStochasticProcess AnyOf CHestonProcess' hp
type BatesProcess = GenHestonProcess CBatesProcess
type HybridHestonHullWhiteProcess = GenStochasticProcess CHybridHestonHullWhiteProcess
type KlugeExtOUProcess = GenStochasticProcess CKlugeExtOUProcess
type LiborForwardModelProcess = GenStochasticProcess CLiborForwardModelProcess
type StochasticProcessArray = GenStochasticProcess CStochasticProcessArray
type VarianceGammaProcess = GenStochasticProcess1D CVarianceGammaProcess
type Merton76Process = GenStochasticProcess1D CMerton76Process
type HullWhiteProcess = GenStochasticProcess1D CHullWhiteProcess
type HullWhiteForwardProcess = GenStochasticProcess1D CHullWhiteForwardProcess
asStochasticProcess :: GenStochasticProcess p -> IO StochasticProcess
asStochasticProcess1D :: GenStochasticProcess1D p1d -> IO StochasticProcess1D
asGeneralizedBlackScholesProcess :: GenGeneralizedBlackScholesProcess gbs -> IO GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess
asHestonProcess :: GenHestonProcess hp -> IO HestonProcess

-- | Black (1976) process for a forward or futures contract: d(ln S) =
--   -sigma^2/2 dt + sigma dW.
blackProcess :: GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> ProcessDiscretization -> Bool -> IO BlackProcess

-- | Merton (1973) extension of Black-Scholes for a
--   continuous-dividend-paying stock: d(ln S) = (r - q - sigma^2/2) dt +
--   sigma dW.
blackScholesMertonProcess :: GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> ProcessDiscretization -> Bool -> IO GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess

-- | Black-Scholes (1973) process for a stock: d(ln S) = (r - sigma^2/2) dt
--   + sigma dW.
blackScholesProcess :: GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> ProcessDiscretization -> Bool -> IO GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess

-- | <a>blackScholesMertonProcess</a> with a choice of evolution scheme
--   (Euler/Milstein/predictor-corrector) on top of the discretization
--   argument.
extendedBlackScholesMertonProcess :: GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> ProcessDiscretization -> ExtendedBlackScholesMertonProcessDiscretization -> IO GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess

-- | Garman-Kohlhagen (1983) process for an exchange rate: d(ln S) = (r -
--   r_f - sigma^2/2) dt + sigma dW.
garmanKohlagenProcess :: GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> ProcessDiscretization -> Bool -> IO GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess

-- | Generalized Black-Scholes process with separate dividend and risk-free
--   curves: d(ln S) = (r - q - sigma^2/2) dt + sigma dW.
generalizedBlackScholesProcess :: GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> ProcessDiscretization -> Bool -> IO GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess

-- | square-root process: dx = a (b - x) dt + sigma sqrt(x) dW.
squareRootProcess :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> ProcessDiscretization -> IO StochasticProcess1D

-- | <a>blackScholesMertonProcess</a> variant supporting local vega stress
--   tests over a given time/asset border and stress level.
vegaStressedBlackScholesProcess :: GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> ProcessDiscretization -> IO GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess

-- | square-root stochastic-volatility Bates process: a Heston process plus
--   a compound Poisson jump component with log-normally distributed jump
--   size.
batesProcess :: GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenQuote q -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> HestonProcessDiscretization -> IO BatesProcess

-- | Kluge model: an extended Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process plus an
--   exponential-jump component, S = exp(X + Y) with dX = alpha (mu(t) - X)
--   dt + sigma dW and dY = -beta Y dt + J dN.
extOUWithJumpsProcess :: ExtendedOrnsteinUhlenbeckProcess -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO ExtOUWithJumpsProcess

-- | T-forward-measure counterpart of <a>g2Process</a>: the two-factor G2++
--   short-rate model, with the simulated state again shifted so its
--   components sum to the short rate.
g2ForwardProcess :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO StochasticProcess

-- | two-factor G2++ short-rate process, state shifted so its two OU
--   components sum to the short rate; degenerates to a pair of zero-mean
--   OU processes if no term structure is given.
g2Process :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO StochasticProcess

-- | Geman-Roncoroni process, a mean-reverting jump-diffusion model for
--   electricity spot prices with a seasonal deterministic mean and an
--   asymmetric jump term.
gemanRoncoroniProcess :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO StochasticProcess1D

-- | geometric Brownian motion process: dS = mue S dt + sigma S dW.
geometricBrownianMotionProcess :: Double -> Double -> Double -> IO StochasticProcess1D

-- | stochastic-volatility GJR-GARCH(1,1) process; parameters are supplied
--   as daily constants and annualized internally via daysPerYear.
gjrGARCHProcess :: GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenQuote q -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> GJRGARCHProcessDiscretization -> IO GJRGARCHProcess

-- | <i>dividendYield</i> may be <a>Nothing</a> (an empty term-structure
--   handle) -- required e.g. by <a>integralHestonVarianceOptionEngine</a>,
--   which rejects a process with a non-empty dividend handle.
hestonProcess :: GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y2) -> GenQuote q -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> HestonProcessDiscretization -> IO HestonProcess

-- | T-forward-measure counterpart of <a>hullWhiteProcess</a>.
hullWhiteForwardProcess :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Double -> IO HullWhiteForwardProcess

-- | Hull-White one-factor short-rate process, fitted to the given initial
--   term structure.
hullWhiteProcess :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Double -> IO HullWhiteProcess

-- | three-factor hybrid model combining a Heston equity process with a
--   Hull-White short-rate process, correlated via corrEquityShortRate.
hybridHestonHullWhiteProcess :: GenHestonProcess hp -> HullWhiteForwardProcess -> Double -> HybridHestonHullWhiteProcessDiscretization -> IO HybridHestonHullWhiteProcess

-- | joint correlated Kluge (<a>extOUWithJumpsProcess</a>) and extended
--   Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process.
klugeExtOUProcess :: Double -> ExtOUWithJumpsProcess -> ExtendedOrnsteinUhlenbeckProcess -> IO KlugeExtOUProcess

-- | Libor market model process, evolving <i>size</i> forward rates of
--   <i>index</i> under the rolling forward measure with a
--   predictor-corrector step.
liborForwardModelProcess :: Word -> GenIborIndex ibor -> IO LiborForwardModelProcess

-- | Merton (1976) jump-diffusion process: a Black-Scholes process plus a
--   log-normal jump component with Poisson jump intensity jumpInt.
merton76Process :: GenQuote q1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> GenQuote q2 -> GenQuote q3 -> GenQuote q4 -> ProcessDiscretization -> IO Merton76Process

-- | Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process: dx = a (level - x) dt + sigma dW.
ornsteinUhlenbeckProcess :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO StochasticProcess1D

-- | Variance Gamma process: a Brownian motion db = theta dt + sigma dW
--   time-changed by an independent Gamma process with mean 1 and variance
--   rate nu.
varianceGammaProcess :: GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO VarianceGammaProcess

-- | array of correlated 1-D stochastic processes, driven by a joint
--   correlation matrix.
stochasticProcessArray :: [GenStochasticProcess1D p1d] -> Matrix Double -> IO StochasticProcessArray

-- | default theta calculation for Black-Scholes options
blackScholesTheta :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Process.ExtendedBlackScholesMertonProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Process.GJRGARCHProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Process.HestonProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Process.HybridHestonHullWhiteProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Process.ProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Process.ExtendedBlackScholesMertonProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Process.GJRGARCHProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Process.HestonProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Process.HybridHestonHullWhiteProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Process.ProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Process.ExtendedBlackScholesMertonProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Process.GJRGARCHProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Process.HestonProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Process.HybridHestonHullWhiteProcessDiscretization
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Process.ProcessDiscretization

module QuantLib.Time.Date

-- | The Modified Julian Day is a standard count of days, with zero being
--   the day 1858-11-17.
data Day

-- | earliest allowed date in QuantLib
minDate :: Day

-- | latest date allowed in QuantLib
maxDate :: Day
today :: IO Day
isLeap :: Day -> Bool
year :: Day -> Int
month :: Day -> Month

-- | the day of the week for the given date
weekday :: Day -> IO Weekday

-- | returns TRUE if the given date's year is leap

Feb :: Month

Sun :: Weekday

-- | One-based (Jan 1st = 1)
dayOfYear :: Day -> IO Int

-- | last day of the month to which the given date belongs
endOfMonth :: Day -> IO Day

-- | whether a date is the last day of its month
isEndOfMonth :: Day -> IO Bool

-- | next given weekday following or equal to the given date E.g., the
--   Friday following Tuesday, January 15th, 2002 was January 18th,
--   2002.see <a>http://www.cpearson.com/excel/DateTimeWS.htm</a>
nextWeekday :: Day -> Weekday -> IO Day

-- | n-th given weekday in the given month and year E.g., the 4th Thursday
--   of March, 1998 was March 26th, 1998.see
--   <a>http://www.cpearson.com/excel/DateTimeWS.htm</a>
nthWeekday :: Word -> Weekday -> Month -> Int -> IO Day

-- | returns the IMM code for the given date (e.g. H3 for March 20th,
--   2013). <i>Warning</i> It raises an exception if the input date is not
--   an IMM date
immCode :: Day -> IO String

-- | returns the IMM date for the given IMM code (e.g. March 20th, 2013 for
--   H3). <i>Warning</i> It raises an exception if the input string is not
--   an IMM code
immDate :: String -> Day -> IO Day

-- | returns whether or not the given string is an IMM code
isIMMCode :: String -> Bool -> Bool

-- | returns whether or not the given date is an IMM date
isIMMDate :: Day -> Bool -> IO Bool

-- | next IMM code following the given date returns the IMM code for next
--   contract listed in the International Money Market section of the
--   Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
nextIMMCode :: Day -> Bool -> IO String

-- | next IMM code following the given code returns the IMM code for next
--   contract listed in the International Money Market section of the
--   Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
nextIMMCode' :: String -> Bool -> Day -> IO String

-- | next IMM date following the given date returns the 1st delivery date
--   for next contract listed in the International Money Market section of
--   the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
nextIMMDate :: Day -> Bool -> IO Day

-- | next IMM date following the given IMM code returns the 1st delivery
--   date for next contract listed in the International Money Market
--   section of the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
nextIMMDate' :: String -> Bool -> Day -> IO Day

-- | the given date advanced by a period
addPeriod :: Day -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> IO Day

-- | adds a date to the set of known ECB maintenance period start dates
addECBDate :: Day -> IO ()

-- | returns the ECB code for the given date (e.g. MAR10 for March xxth,
--   2010).Warning It raises an exception if the input date is not an ECB
--   date
ecbCode :: Day -> IO String

-- | returns the ECB date for the given ECB code (e.g. March xxth, 2013 for
--   MAR10).WarningIt raises an exception if the input string is not an ECB
--   code
ecbDate' :: String -> Maybe Day -> IO Day

-- | maintenance period start date in the given month/year
ecbDate :: Month -> Int -> IO Day

-- | returns whether or not the given string is an ECB code
isECBCode :: String -> IO Bool

-- | returns whether or not the given date is a maintenance period start
--   date
isECBDate :: Day -> IO Bool

-- | the set of known ECB maintenance period start dates

-- | next maintenance period start date following the given date

-- | next maintenance period start dates following the given date

-- | removes a date from the set of known ECB maintenance period start
--   dates

-- | global repository for run-time library settings
module QuantLib.Settings

-- | returns the current value of the boolean which enforce the usage of
--   historic fixings for today's date
evaluationDate :: IO Day

-- | sets the value of the Evaluation Date |Nothing sets the evaluation
--   date to Date::todaysDate() and allow it to change at midnight. This
--   comes at the price of losing some performance, since the evaluation
--   date is re-evaluated each time it is read.
--   
--   returns the current value of the Evaluation Date: the date at which
--   pricing is to be performed
setEvaluationDate :: Maybe Day -> IO ()
enforceTodaysHistoricFixings :: IO Bool

-- | sets the value of the boolean which enforce the usage of historic
--   fixings for today's date
setEnforceTodaysHistoricFixings :: Bool -> IO ()

-- | if set, whether CashFlows occurring on today's date should enter the
--   NPV; when the NPV date equals today's date this overrides
--   includeReferenceDateEvents and cannot be overridden locally
includeTodaysCashFlows :: IO (Maybe Bool)

-- | sets whether CashFlows occurring on today's date should enter the NPV
setIncludeTodaysCashFlows :: Maybe Bool -> IO ()

-- | This flag specifies whether or not Events occurring on the reference
--   date should, by default, be taken into account as not happened yet. It
--   can be overridden locally when calling the Event::hasOccurred method.
includeReferenceDateEvents :: IO Bool

-- | sets whether Events occurring on the reference date should, by
--   default, be taken into account as not happened yet
setIncludeReferenceDateEvents :: Bool -> IO ()

-- | brackets to restore settings once action has completed or raised an
--   exception
keepingSettings :: IO b -> IO b

-- | brackets to restore settings once action has completed or raised an
--   exception. Before restoring settings garbage collection is run to
--   avoid problems with market data objects watching evaluation date
keepingSettings' :: IO b -> IO b
version :: String
boostVersion :: String
epsilon :: Double

data Calendar
calendar :: CalendarConstructor -> IO Calendar

-- | Adjusts a non-business day to the appropriate near business day with
--   respect to the given convention
adjust :: Calendar -> Day -> BusinessDayConvention -> IO Day

-- | Advances the given date of the given number of business days and
--   returns the result using business day convention and the EOM flag
advance :: Calendar -> Day -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> IO Day

-- | Adds a date to the set of holidays for the given calendar.
addHoliday :: Calendar -> Day -> IO ()

-- | Calculates the number of business days between two given dates and
--   returns the result.
businessDaysBetween :: Calendar -> Day -> Day -> Bool -> Bool -> IO Int

-- | last business day of the month to which the given date belongs
endOfMonth :: Calendar -> Day -> IO Day

-- | Returns true iff the date is a business day for the given market.
isBusinessDay :: Calendar -> Day -> IO Bool

-- | Returns true iff the date is last business day for the month in given
--   market.
isEndOfMonth :: Calendar -> Day -> IO Bool

-- | Returns true iff the date is a holiday for the given market.
isHoliday :: Calendar -> Day -> IO Bool

-- | Returns true iff the weekday is part of the weekend for the given
--   market.
isWeekend :: Calendar -> Weekday -> IO Bool

-- | Removes a date from the set of holidays for the given calendar.
removeHoliday :: Calendar -> Day -> IO ()

-- | Returns the holidays between two dates.
holidays :: Calendar -> Day -> Day -> Bool -> IO [Day]
data BusinessDayConvention
Following :: BusinessDayConvention
ModifiedFollowing :: BusinessDayConvention
Preceding :: BusinessDayConvention
ModifiedPreceding :: BusinessDayConvention
Unadjusted :: BusinessDayConvention
HalfMonthModifiedFollowing :: BusinessDayConvention
Nearest :: BusinessDayConvention
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Time.Calendar.BusinessDayConvention
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Time.Calendar.BusinessDayConvention
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Time.Calendar.BusinessDayConvention

module QuantLib.Time.Schedule
data DayCounterConstructor

data DayCounter
dayCounter :: DayCounterConstructor -> IO DayCounter

-- | Returns the number of days between two dates.
days :: DayCounter -> Day -> Day -> IO Int

-- | Returns the period between two dates as a fraction of year.
years :: DayCounter -> Day -> Day -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double
data Schedule

-- | Builds a payment schedule by generating dates between effective and
--   termination dates according to the given tenor and rule.
schedule :: Maybe Day -> Day -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> BusinessDayConvention -> DateGenerationRule -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Schedule

-- | Builds a payment schedule from an explicit list of dates, without
--   checking them for plausibility. TODO add other parameters, provide a
--   more user-friendly way to build schedules
fromDates :: [Day] -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> IO Schedule

-- | truncated schedule TODO Introduce another Schedule type with
--   restricted interface? moreover, a fixed rate bond can be constructed
--   from a full schedule only!
until :: Schedule -> Day -> IO Schedule

-- | returns the dates for the given Schedule object
dates :: Schedule -> IO [Day]
data DateGenerationRule
Backward :: DateGenerationRule
Forward :: DateGenerationRule
Zero :: DateGenerationRule
ThirdWednesday :: DateGenerationRule
ThirdWednesdayInclusive :: DateGenerationRule
Twentieth :: DateGenerationRule
TwentiethIMM :: DateGenerationRule
OldCDS :: DateGenerationRule
CDS :: DateGenerationRule
CDS2015 :: DateGenerationRule

-- | returns a Period from a given Frequency (e.g. 6M from SemiAnnual)
fromFrequency :: Frequency -> IO (Word, TimeUnit)

-- | returns a Frequency from a given Period (e.g. SemiAnnual from 6M)
toFrequency :: (Word, TimeUnit) -> IO Frequency

-- | Parses a period from its short-format string representation (e.g.
--   "6M").
parse :: String -> IO (Int, TimeUnit)

-- | Adds two periods together.
add :: (Int, TimeUnit) -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> IO (Int, TimeUnit)

-- | Divides a period's length by an integer divisor.
divide :: (Int, TimeUnit) -> Int -> IO (Int, TimeUnit)

-- | Compares two periods, converting to a common time unit as needed.
lessThan :: (Int, TimeUnit) -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> IO Bool

-- | Normalizes a period to the coarsest equivalent time unit (e.g. 12M to
--   1Y).
normalize :: (Int, TimeUnit) -> IO (Int, TimeUnit)
data TimeUnit
Days :: TimeUnit
Weeks :: TimeUnit

Years :: TimeUnit

Milliseconds :: TimeUnit
Microseconds :: TimeUnit

module QuantLib.Quote

-- | <pre>
--   Quote
--     SimpleQuote
--     DeltaVolQuote
--     RelinkableQuote
--   </pre>
type Quote = GenQuote CQuote
type SimpleQuote = GenQuote CSimpleQuote
type DeltaVolQuote = GenQuote CDeltaVolQuote
type RelinkableQuote = GenQuote CRelinkableQuote
data GenQuote q
asQuote :: GenQuote q -> IO Quote
data PriceType
Bid :: PriceType
Ask :: PriceType
Last :: PriceType
Close :: PriceType
Mid :: PriceType
MidEquivalent :: PriceType
MidSafe :: PriceType
data IntervalPriceType
IntervalPriceOpen :: IntervalPriceType
IntervalPriceClose :: IntervalPriceType
IntervalPriceHigh :: IntervalPriceType
IntervalPriceLow :: IntervalPriceType
data AtmType
AtmNull :: AtmType
AtmSpot :: AtmType
AtmFwd :: AtmType
AtmDeltaNeutral :: AtmType
AtmVegaMax :: AtmType
AtmGammaMax :: AtmType
AtmPutCall50 :: AtmType
data DeltaType
Spot :: DeltaType
Fwd :: DeltaType
PaSpot :: DeltaType
PaFwd :: DeltaType

-- | market element returning a stored value
simpleQuote :: Double -> IO SimpleQuote

-- | quotation of an FX delta vs vol, e.g. a 25-delta
--   risk-reversal/butterfly point
deltaVolQuote :: Double -> GenQuote q -> Double -> DeltaType -> IO DeltaVolQuote

-- | quotation of an FX at-the-money vol point (e.g. ATM straddle)
atmVolQuote :: GenQuote q -> DeltaType -> Double -> AtmType -> IO DeltaVolQuote

-- | Returns the current value of the given Quote object
value :: GenQuote q -> IO Double

-- | returns true if the Quote holds a valid value
isValid :: GenQuote q -> IO Bool

-- | returns the difference between the new value and the old value
--   <i>NB</i> The change will propagate to all users of the quote
setValue :: SimpleQuote -> Double -> IO Double

-- | implied standard deviation of a Eurodollar future's underlying, solved
--   from its call/put prices
eurodollarFuturesImpliedStdDevQuote :: GenQuote q1 -> GenQuote q2 -> GenQuote q3 -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Word -> IO Quote

-- | implied rate of a forward-starting swap on the given swap index,
--   offset by a spread quote
forwardSwapQuote :: GenSwapIndex sidx -> GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> IO Quote

-- | forward value of an index as of a given fixing date
forwardValueQuote :: GenIndex idx -> Day -> IO Quote

-- | futures-convexity adjustment for an Ibor future identified by its IMM
--   code
futuresConvAdjustmentQuote' :: GenIborIndex ibor -> String -> GenQuote q1 -> GenQuote q2 -> GenQuote q3 -> IO Quote

-- | futures-convexity adjustment for an Ibor future identified by its
--   futures (IMM) date
futuresConvAdjustmentQuote :: GenIborIndex ibor -> Day -> GenQuote q1 -> GenQuote q2 -> GenQuote q3 -> IO Quote

-- | implied standard deviation of an underlying, solved from its option
--   price at a given strike
impliedStdDevQuote :: OptionType -> GenQuote q1 -> GenQuote q2 -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Word -> IO Quote

-- | last available fixing of the given index, updating whenever a new
--   fixing is added
lastFixingQuote :: GenIndex idx -> IO Quote

-- | A quote behind a relinkable handle. The result <i>is</i> a
--   <a>Quote</a>: pass it to any quote-taking function and everything
--   built on it keeps tracking whatever the handle currently points at, so
--   a later <a>linkTo</a> reprices already-constructed instruments without
--   rebuilding them. <a>Nothing</a> gives an empty handle -- meaningful
--   rather than an error -- but reading a value through one throws until
--   it is linked. Mirrors <a>relinkableYieldTermStructure</a>.
relinkableQuote :: Maybe (GenQuote q) -> IO RelinkableQuote

-- | Point a relinkable handle at a different quote. Everything already
--   built on the handle reprices against the new quote, with no object
--   rebuilt.
--   
--   This is the one mutator in the module besides <a>setValue</a>. The API
--   rules here otherwise forbid new setters and prefer constructing a
--   fresh object, but relinking <i>is</i> the capability being bound --
--   the same justification as <a>linkTo</a>. Note the narrower payoff
--   versus curves: <a>setValue</a> already covers the common bump case, so
--   this buys swapping in a different quote object, not a different value.
linkTo :: RelinkableQuote -> GenQuote q -> IO ()
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Quote.AtmType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Quote.DeltaType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Quote.IntervalPriceType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Quote.PriceType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Quote.AtmType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Quote.DeltaType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Quote.IntervalPriceType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Quote.PriceType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Quote.AtmType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Quote.DeltaType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Quote.IntervalPriceType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Quote.PriceType

data TimeGrid
timeGrid :: Double -> Word -> IO TimeGrid

-- | Time grid with mandatory time points. Mandatory points are guaranteed
--   to belong to the grid. No additional points are added.
timeGridFromList :: NonEmpty Double -> IO TimeGrid

-- | Time grid with mandatory time points. Mandatory points are guaranteed
--   to belong to the grid. Additional points are then added with regular
--   spacing between pairs of mandatory times in order to reach the desired
--   number of steps.
timeGridFromList' :: NonEmpty Double -> Word -> IO TimeGrid

-- | returns the time at the given index of the grid

-- | returns the number of times on the grid
size :: TimeGrid -> Word

-- | returns all the times on the grid, as a list
points :: TimeGrid -> IO [Double]

-- | returns all the times on the grid, as a vector
points' :: TimeGrid -> IO (Vector CDouble)

module QuantLib.Method
data PathGenerator
data SamplePath

-- | build a multi-asset path generator driven by a pseudo-random number
--   generator (Mersenne Twister, Poisson, or Ziggurat, chosen by the RNG
--   trait) over the given process and time grid.
pathGenerator :: RngTrait -> GenStochasticProcess p -> TimeGrid -> Word -> Word -> Bool -> IO PathGenerator

-- | build a multi-asset path generator driven by a low-discrepancy (Sobol)
--   sequence, using the given direction integers, over the given process
--   and time grid.
sobolPathGenerator :: SobolDirectionIntegers -> GenStochasticProcess p -> TimeGrid -> Word -> Word -> Bool -> IO PathGenerator

-- | draw the next weighted sample path from the generator.
next :: PathGenerator -> IO SamplePath

-- | draw the antithetic (sign-flipped) counterpart of the last drawn
--   sample path.
antithetic :: PathGenerator -> IO SamplePath

-- | the weight associated with a sample path.
weight :: SamplePath -> Double

-- | the number of correlated asset paths in a sample.
assetNumber :: SamplePath -> Word

-- | the number of time steps in each asset path of a sample.
pathSize :: SamplePath -> Word

-- | the value of one asset's path at a given time step.
assetAt :: SamplePath -> Word -> Word -> IO Double

-- | the full simulated path (values at every time step) of a single asset,
--   as a list.
asset :: SamplePath -> Word -> IO [Double]

-- | the full simulated path (values at every time step) of a single asset,
--   as a storable vector.
asset' :: SamplePath -> Word -> IO (Vector CDouble)

module QuantLib.InterestRate
data Compounding
Simple :: Compounding
Compounded :: Compounding
Continuous :: Compounding
SimpleThenCompounded :: Compounding
CompoundedThenSimple :: Compounding
data VolatilityType
ShiftedLognormal :: VolatilityType
Normal :: VolatilityType
data InterestRate

-- | construct an interest rate from a rate value, a day counter, a
--   compounding convention and a frequency.
interestRate :: Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> IO InterestRate

-- | compound factor implied by the rate compounded at time t. returns the
--   compound (a.k.a capitalization) factor implied by the rate compounded
--   at time t. <i>Warning</i> Time must be measured using InterestRate's
--   own day counter.
compoundFactor :: InterestRate -> Double -> IO Double

-- | compound factor implied by the rate compounded between two dates
--   returns the compound (a.k.a capitalization) factor implied by the rate
--   compounded between two dates.
compoundFactor' :: InterestRate -> Day -> Day -> Day -> Day -> IO Double

-- | discount factor implied by the rate compounded at time t.
--   <i>Warning</i> Time must be measured using InterestRate's own day
--   counter.
discountFactor :: InterestRate -> Double -> IO Double

-- | discount factor implied by the rate compounded between two dates
discountFactor' :: InterestRate -> Day -> Day -> Day -> Day -> IO Double

-- | equivalent interest rate for a compounding period t. The resulting
--   InterestRate shares the same implicit day-counting rule of the
--   original InterestRate instance. <i>Warning</i> Time must be measured
--   using the InterestRate's own day counter.
equivalentRate :: InterestRate -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Double -> IO InterestRate

-- | equivalent rate for a compounding period between two dates The
--   resulting rate is calculated taking the required day-counting rule
--   into account.
equivalentRate' :: InterestRate -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> Day -> Day -> Day -> IO InterestRate

-- | implied interest rate for a given compound factor at a given time. The
--   resulting InterestRate has the day-counter provided as input.
--   <i>Warning</i> Time must be measured using the day-counter provided as
--   input.
impliedRate :: InterestRate -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Double -> IO InterestRate

-- | implied rate for a given compound factor between two dates. The
--   resulting rate is calculated taking the required day-counting rule
--   into account.
impliedRate' :: InterestRate -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> Day -> Day -> Day -> IO InterestRate

-- | the rate value of an interest rate.
rate :: InterestRate -> Double
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.InterestRate.Compounding
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.InterestRate.VolatilityType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.InterestRate.Compounding
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.InterestRate.VolatilityType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.InterestRate.Compounding
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.InterestRate.VolatilityType

defaultBlackVolatilitySurfaceDeltaOpts :: BlackVolatilitySurfaceDeltaOpts
type BlackVolTermStructure = GenBlackVolTermStructure CBlackVolTermStructure
type GenBlackVolTermStructure bv = GenVolatilityTermStructure AnyOf CBlackVolTermStructure' bv

-- | A Black vol surface held behind a relinkable handle. It <i>is</i> a
--   <a>BlackVolTermStructure</a> -- pass it anywhere one is expected and
--   it upcasts like any other hierarchy member, sharing its <tt>Link</tt>
--   so that a later <a>linkBlackVolTo</a> reaches everything already built
--   on it. Mirrors <a>RelinkableYieldTermStructure</a>.
type RelinkableBlackVolTermStructure = GenBlackVolTermStructure CRelinkableBlackVolTermStructure
type CallableBondVolatilityStructure = GenTermStructure CCallableBondVolatilityStructure
type CapFloorTermVolSurface = GenVolatilityTermStructure CCapFloorTermVolSurface
type LocalVolTermStructure = GenVolatilityTermStructure CLocalVolTermStructure
type OptionletVolatilityStructure = GenOptionletVolatilityStructure COptionletVolatilityStructure
type GenOptionletVolatilityStructure ov = GenVolatilityTermStructure AnyOf COptionletVolatilityStructure' ov

-- | An optionlet vol surface held behind a relinkable handle. It <i>is</i>
--   an <a>OptionletVolatilityStructure</a> -- pass it anywhere one is
--   expected and it upcasts like any other hierarchy member, sharing its
--   <tt>Link</tt> so that a later <a>linkOptionletVolTo</a> reaches
--   everything already built on it. Mirrors
--   <a>RelinkableSwaptionVolatilityStructure</a>.
type RelinkableOptionletVolatilityStructure = GenOptionletVolatilityStructure CRelinkableOptionletVolatilityStructure
data SmileSection
data SabrInterpolatedSmileSection
type SwaptionVolatilityStructure = GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure CSwaptionVolatilityStructure

-- | A swaption vol surface held behind a relinkable handle. It <i>is</i> a
--   <a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a> -- pass it anywhere one is expected
--   and it upcasts like any other hierarchy member, sharing its
--   <tt>Link</tt> so that a later <a>linkSwaptionVolTo</a> reaches
--   everything already built on it. Mirrors
--   <a>RelinkableBlackVolTermStructure</a>.
type RelinkableSwaptionVolatilityStructure = GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure CRelinkableSwaptionVolatilityStructure
type VolatilityTermStructure = GenVolatilityTermStructure CVolatilityTermStructure
type GenVolatilityTermStructure v = GenTermStructure AnyOf CVolatilityTermStructure' v
asVolatilityTermStructure :: GenVolatilityTermStructure v -> IO VolatilityTermStructure
asBlackVolTermStructure :: GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> IO BlackVolTermStructure

-- | A local vol surface derived from a Black vol surface via Dupire's
--   formula (Gatheral's implementation).
localVolSurface :: GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenQuote q -> IO LocalVolTermStructure

-- | fixed reference date, floating market data
constantOptionletVolatility :: Day -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> VolatilityType -> Double -> IO OptionletVolatilityStructure

-- | Constant caplet volatility, no time-strike dependence floating
--   reference date, floating market data
constantOptionletVolatility' :: Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> VolatilityType -> Double -> IO OptionletVolatilityStructure

-- | Strips a <a>CapFloorTermVolSurface</a> (quoted cap/floor term vols)
--   into caplet/floorlet vols via <tt>OptionletStripper1</tt>, immediately
--   wrapping the result behind <tt>StrippedOptionletAdapter</tt> in one
--   step -- <tt>OptionletStripper1</tt> itself is never exposed as a
--   Haskell type, since none of its own getters
--   (capFloorPrices/capletVols/etc.) are needed beyond feeding the
--   adapter, per the "bind few inspectors" rule.
optionletStripper1 :: CapFloorTermVolSurface -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Maybe Double -> Double -> Word -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> VolatilityType -> Double -> Bool -> Maybe (Word, TimeUnit) -> IO OptionletVolatilityStructure

-- | <tt>origTS</tt> re-anchored to a new reference date, tracking
--   <tt>origTS</tt> for later changes. Only financially sensible for a
--   time-dependent (not asset-dependent) source structure.
impliedVolTermStructure :: GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> Day -> IO BlackVolTermStructure

-- | A constant Black volatility, no time-strike dependence -- floating
--   reference date, floating market data
blackConstantVol' :: Word -> Calendar -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO BlackVolTermStructure

-- | as 'blackConstantVol'', but a fixed reference date
blackConstantVol :: Day -> Calendar -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO BlackVolTermStructure

-- | A Black vol surface behind a relinkable handle. The result <i>is</i> a
--   <a>BlackVolTermStructure</a>: pass it anywhere one is expected and
--   everything built on it keeps tracking whatever the handle currently
--   points at, so a later <a>linkBlackVolTo</a> reprices
--   already-constructed instruments without rebuilding them. Mirrors
--   <a>relinkableYieldTermStructure</a>.
relinkableBlackVolTermStructure :: Maybe (GenBlackVolTermStructure bv) -> IO RelinkableBlackVolTermStructure

-- | Point a relinkable Black vol handle at a different surface. Everything
--   already built on the handle reprices against the new surface, with no
--   engine rebuilt. Mirrors <a>linkTo</a> -- see its haddock for why this
--   mutator is justified.
linkBlackVolTo :: RelinkableBlackVolTermStructure -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> IO ()

-- | fixed reference date, floating market data
constantSwaptionVolatility' :: Day -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> VolatilityType -> Double -> IO SwaptionVolatilityStructure

-- | floating reference date, floating market data
constantSwaptionVolatility :: Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> VolatilityType -> Double -> IO SwaptionVolatilityStructure

-- | returns the Black variance for a given option date and swap tenor
blackVarianceForPeriod' :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Day -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the Black variance for a given option time and swap tenor
blackVarianceForPeriod :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Double -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the Black variance for a given option tenor and swap length
blackVarianceForTenor :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the Black variance for a given option date and swap length
blackVariance' :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Day -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the Black variance for a given option time and swap length
blackVariance :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the Black variance for a given option tenor and swap tenor
blackVarianceForPeriods :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | the largest swapLength for which the term structure can return vols
maxSwapLength :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> IO Double

-- | the largest length for which the term structure can return vols
maxSwapTenor :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> IO (Int, TimeUnit)

-- | returns the smile for a given option date and swap tenor
smileSectionForPeriod' :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Day -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Bool -> IO SmileSection

-- | returns the smile for a given option time and swap tenor
smileSectionForPeriod :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Double -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Bool -> IO SmileSection

-- | returns the smile for a given option tenor and swap length
smileSectionForTenor :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Bool -> IO SmileSection

-- | returns the smile for a given option date and swap length
smileSection' :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Day -> Double -> Bool -> IO SmileSection

-- | returns the smile for a given option time and swap length
smileSection :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO SmileSection

-- | returns the smile for a given option tenor and swap tenor
smileSectionForPeriods :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Bool -> IO SmileSection

-- | a smile section built directly from SABR parameters (Hagan et al.
--   2002), rather than interpolated from a
--   <a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a>
sabrSmileSection :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> IO SmileSection

-- | as <a>sabrSmileSection</a>, but the time to expiry is derived from a
--   date, reference date and day counter rather than given directly
sabrSmileSection' :: Day -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Maybe Day -> DayCounter -> Double -> VolatilityType -> IO SmileSection

-- | an arbitrage-free SABR smile section (Doust's approach via
--   <tt>NoArbSabrSmileSection</tt>), built directly from SABR parameters
--   like <a>sabrSmileSection</a> but guaranteeing a proper terminal
--   density
noArbSabrSmileSection :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> IO SmileSection

-- | as <a>noArbSabrSmileSection</a>, but the time to expiry is derived
--   from a date and day counter rather than given directly
noArbSabrSmileSection' :: Day -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> DayCounter -> Double -> VolatilityType -> IO SmileSection

-- | the volatility for the given strike, for any <a>SmileSection</a>
--   (however it was constructed)
smileSectionVolatility :: SmileSection -> Double -> IO Double

-- | the Black variance for the given strike, for any <a>SmileSection</a>
--   (however it was constructed)
smileSectionVariance :: SmileSection -> Double -> IO Double
data SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts
SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts :: Bool -> Bool -> Bool -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe DayCounter -> Double -> SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts
[sabrIsAlphaFixed] :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts -> Bool
[sabrIsBetaFixed] :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts -> Bool
[sabrIsNuFixed] :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts -> Bool
[sabrIsRhoFixed] :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts -> Bool
[sabrVegaWeighted] :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts -> Bool
[sabrDayCounter] :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts -> Maybe DayCounter
[sabrShift] :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts -> Double
defaultSabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts

-- | a smile section calibrated to a market smile (strikes/vols given
--   directly, not as live quotes -- calibration runs once, eagerly, at
--   construction). alpha/beta/nu/rho/vegaWeighted are the SABR
--   calibration's initial guess and fixed/free flags;
--   endCriteria/optimization method are left at QuantLib's own internal
--   defaults (a raw, Haskell-finalized EndCriteria or OptimizationMethod
--   handle can't safely be stored for this object's full lifetime -- see
--   the qlXxxFitting comment in <a>QuantLib.Internal.Enum</a> for the same
--   ownership hazard elsewhere).
sabrInterpolatedSmileSection :: Day -> GenQuote q1 -> [Double] -> Bool -> GenQuote q2 -> [GenQuote q3] -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> SabrInterpolatedSmileSectionOpts -> IO SabrInterpolatedSmileSection

-- | upcast to the generic <a>SmileSection</a> interface (e.g. for
--   <a>smileSectionVolatility</a>/<a>smileSectionVariance</a>). A
--   fresh-<tt>shared_ptr</tt> upcast, always safe -- not the reverse
--   (downcast) direction.
sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionAsSmileSection :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSection -> IO SmileSection

-- | calibrated alpha (post-fit; can differ from the initial guess passed
--   to <a>sabrInterpolatedSmileSection</a> unless
--   <tt>sabrIsAlphaFixed</tt> was set).
sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionAlpha :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSection -> IO Double

-- | calibrated beta, see <a>sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionAlpha</a>
sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionBeta :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSection -> IO Double

-- | calibrated nu, see <a>sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionAlpha</a>
sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionNu :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSection -> IO Double

-- | calibrated rho, see <a>sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionAlpha</a>
sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionRho :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSection -> IO Double

-- | root-mean-square calibration error
sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionRmsError :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSection -> IO Double

-- | maximum calibration error
sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionMaxError :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSection -> IO Double

-- | the reason the SABR calibration's optimizer stopped
sabrInterpolatedSmileSectionEndCriteria :: SabrInterpolatedSmileSection -> IO EndCriteriaType

-- | implements the conversion between swap dates and swap (time) length
swapLength' :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Day -> Day -> IO Double

-- | implements the conversion between swap tenor and swap (time) length
swapLength :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> IO Double

-- | returns the volatility for a given option date and swap tenor
volatilityForPeriod' :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Day -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the volatility for a given option time and swap tenor
volatilityForPeriod :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Double -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the volatility for a given option tenor and swap length
volatilityForTenor :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the volatility for a given option date and swap length
volatilityForTenor' :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Day -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the volatility for a given option time and swap length
volatility :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | returns the volatility for a given option tenor and swap tenor
volatilityForPeriods :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | A constant callable-bond volatility, no time-strike dependence --
--   floating reference date, floating market data
callableBondConstantVolatility' :: Word -> Calendar -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO CallableBondVolatilityStructure

-- | as 'callableBondConstantVolatility'', but a fixed reference date
callableBondConstantVolatility :: Day -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO CallableBondVolatilityStructure

-- | fixed reference date, floating market data
constantCapFloorTermVolatility' :: Day -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO VolatilityTermStructure

-- | floating reference date, floating market data
constantCapFloorTermVolatility :: Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO VolatilityTermStructure

-- | A <a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a> whose volatility at every point
--   is <tt>source</tt>'s plus <tt>spread</tt> (which may change over time,
--   since it's a live <a>GenQuote</a> rather than a fixed number)
spreadedSwaptionVolatility :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> GenQuote q -> IO SwaptionVolatilityStructure

-- | A swaption vol surface behind a relinkable handle. The result
--   <i>is</i> a <a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a>: pass it anywhere one
--   is expected and everything built on it keeps tracking whatever the
--   handle currently points at, so a later <a>linkSwaptionVolTo</a>
--   reprices already-constructed instruments without rebuilding them.
--   Mirrors <a>relinkableYieldTermStructure</a>.
relinkableSwaptionVolatilityStructure :: Maybe (GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv) -> IO RelinkableSwaptionVolatilityStructure

-- | Point a relinkable swaption vol handle at a different surface.
--   Everything already built on the handle reprices against the new
--   surface, with no engine rebuilt. Named distinctly from <a>linkTo</a>
--   and <a>linkBlackVolTo</a> because
--   <a>BlackVolTermStructure</a>/<a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a>/<a>OptionletVolatilityStructure</a>
--   all live in this one module and a bare <tt>linkTo</tt> per type would
--   collide with its own siblings, not just with <a>chs</a>/<a>chs</a>.
linkSwaptionVolTo :: RelinkableSwaptionVolatilityStructure -> GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> IO ()

-- | An optionlet vol surface behind a relinkable handle. The result
--   <i>is</i> an <a>OptionletVolatilityStructure</a>: pass it anywhere one
--   is expected and everything built on it keeps tracking whatever the
--   handle currently points at, so a later <a>linkOptionletVolTo</a>
--   reprices already-constructed instruments without rebuilding them.
--   Mirrors <a>relinkableSwaptionVolatilityStructure</a>.
relinkableOptionletVolatilityStructure :: Maybe (GenOptionletVolatilityStructure ov) -> IO RelinkableOptionletVolatilityStructure

-- | Point a relinkable optionlet vol handle at a different surface.
--   Everything already built on the handle reprices against the new
--   surface, with no engine rebuilt. Named distinctly from
--   <a>linkTo</a>/<a>linkBlackVolTo</a>/<a>linkSwaptionVolTo</a> for the
--   same reason as those: all four relinkable vol types live in this one
--   module.
linkOptionletVolTo :: RelinkableOptionletVolatilityStructure -> GenOptionletVolatilityStructure ov -> IO ()

-- | A constant local volatility, no time-asset dependence -- floating
--   reference date, floating market data. Local and Black volatility
--   coincide when volatility is at most time dependent, so this is
--   effectively a proxy for <a>blackConstantVol'</a>.
localConstantVol' :: Word -> Calendar -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO LocalVolTermStructure

-- | as 'localConstantVol'', but a fixed reference date
localConstantVol :: Day -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO LocalVolTermStructure

-- | a local vol term structure derived from a <a>BlackVarianceCurve</a>
--   (no strike dependence): local vol at time <tt>t</tt> is the derivative
--   of the Black variance curve's total variance
localVolCurve :: BlackVarianceCurve -> IO LocalVolTermStructure

-- | floating reference date, floating market data
capFloorTermVolCurve :: Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> [(Word, TimeUnit, GenQuote q)] -> DayCounter -> IO VolatilityTermStructure

-- | fixed reference date, floating market data
capFloorTermVolCurve' :: Day -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> [(Word, TimeUnit, GenQuote q)] -> DayCounter -> IO VolatilityTermStructure

-- | A Black volatility curve built from time-dependent (ATM) market vols,
--   interpolating on total variance (linear by default, or the given
--   <a>Interpolation</a>) -- no strike dependence; see
--   <a>blackVarianceSurface</a> for that.
blackVarianceCurve :: Day -> [(Day, Double)] -> DayCounter -> Bool -> Maybe Interpolation -> IO BlackVarianceCurve

-- | floating reference date, floating market data
capFloorTermVolSurface :: Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> [Double] -> Matrix (GenQuote q) -> DayCounter -> IO CapFloorTermVolSurface

-- | fixed reference date, floating market data
capFloorTermVolSurface' :: Day -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> [Double] -> Matrix (GenQuote q) -> DayCounter -> IO CapFloorTermVolSurface

-- | The <tt>interpolator</tt> is applied through
--   <tt>BlackVarianceSurface::setInterpolation</tt> right after
--   construction; <a>Bilinear</a> reproduces upstream's default. Both
--   interpolators reproduce <tt>blackVolMatrix</tt> exactly at its own
--   (date, strike) nodes -- they only differ between them.
blackVarianceSurface :: Day -> Calendar -> [Day] -> [Double] -> Matrix Double -> DayCounter -> BlackVarianceSurfaceExtrapolation -> BlackVarianceSurfaceExtrapolation -> Interpolation2D -> IO BlackVolTermStructure

-- | Builds a Black volatility surface from a rectangular vol grid via
--   'PiecewiseBlackVarianceSurface::makeFromGrid': one interpolated smile
--   section per date column, linear in total variance between columns -- a
--   fixed interpolation scheme, unlike <tt>blackVarianceSurface'</tt>s
--   configurable 2-D interpolator.
piecewiseBlackVarianceSurface :: Day -> [Day] -> [Double] -> Matrix Double -> DayCounter -> IO BlackVolTermStructure

-- | A Black volatility surface parameterized by market deltas (put/call
--   deltas and, optionally, an ATM quote) rather than fixed strikes -- the
--   standard FX vol quoting convention. Constructed with upstream's own
--   defaults for the trailing options; use
--   <a>blackVolatilitySurfaceDeltaFull</a> to override them.
blackVolatilitySurfaceDelta :: Day -> [Day] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Matrix Double -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> IO BlackVolatilitySurfaceDelta

-- | As <a>blackVolatilitySurfaceDelta</a>, but takes a
--   <a>BlackVolatilitySurfaceDeltaOpts</a> record for the trailing options
--   instead of hardcoding upstream's defaults.
blackVolatilitySurfaceDeltaFull :: Day -> [Day] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Matrix Double -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> BlackVolatilitySurfaceDeltaOpts -> IO BlackVolatilitySurfaceDelta

-- | The Black vol smile at a given time to expiry (year fraction from the
--   reference date), built by interpolating/extrapolating the delta-quoted
--   surface. The returned <a>SmileSection</a> does not track later changes
--   to the surface's spot/curve handles -- recreate it if those change.
blackVolSmile :: BlackVolatilitySurfaceDelta -> Double -> IO SmileSection

-- | As <a>blackVolSmile</a>, for a given expiry <a>Day</a> instead of a
--   year fraction.
blackVolSmile' :: BlackVolatilitySurfaceDelta -> Day -> IO SmileSection

-- | fixed reference date, floating market data. Pass an empty
--   <a>Matrix</a> (<tt>Matrix 0 0 []</tt>) for <tt>shifts</tt> when no
--   shift is needed -- upstream treats a zero-row shift matrix as
--   all-zero.
swaptionVolatilityMatrix' :: Day -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> Matrix (GenQuote q) -> DayCounter -> Bool -> VolatilityType -> Matrix Double -> IO SwaptionVolatilityStructure

-- | A SABR-calibrated swaption vol cube. It <i>is</i> a
--   <a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a> -- pass it anywhere one is
--   expected. Its own extra getters (sparse/dense SABR parameters,
--   market/ATM- calibrated vol cubes, ATM strike) are bound directly
--   against this concrete type rather than via a downcast: it has real
--   calculations of its own beyond the generic interface, so per the
--   API-design rule in CLAUDE.md it earns a dedicated leaf instead of
--   being collapsed into <a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a> the way
--   <tt>swaptionVolatilityMatrix'</tt> is.
type SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube = GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure CSabrSwaptionVolatilityCube

-- | The non-SABR, linear-interpolation swaption vol cube. It <i>is</i> a
--   <a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a> -- pass it anywhere one is
--   expected. Gets the same dedicated-leaf treatment as
--   <a>SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube</a> for its <tt>atmStrike</tt> getter
--   (inherited, in upstream, from the same abstract
--   <tt>SwaptionVolatilityCube</tt> base both concrete cubes share).
type InterpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCube = GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure CInterpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCube

-- | A SABR-calibrated swaption volatility cube: fits a SABR smile at every
--   (option tenor, swap tenor) node from an ATM surface plus a grid of vol
--   spreads. The result <i>is</i> a <a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a> --
--   pass it anywhere one is expected (pricing engines,
--   <a>smileSection</a>/<a>volatilityForPeriod'</a>/etc.) -- but its own
--   extra getters (<a>sparseSabrParameters</a>,
--   <a>denseSabrParameters</a>, <a>marketVolCube</a>,
--   <a>volCubeAtmCalibrated</a>,
--   <a>sabrSwaptionVolatilityCubeAtmStrike</a>/'\'') only accept this
--   concrete type, not the generic one.
--   
--   <tt>endCriteria</tt>/<tt>optMethod</tt> are not exposed:
--   <a>SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube</a> stores them as <tt>shared_ptr</tt>
--   members for its full lifetime, and hasquant's
--   <a>EndCriteria</a>/<a>OptimizationMethod</a> handles are raw,
--   Haskell-finalized pointers rather than <tt>shared_ptr</tt> boxes --
--   the same ownership hazard already avoided for
--   <a>sabrInterpolatedSmileSection</a> and
--   <a>fittedBondDiscountCurve'</a>s fitting methods. Upstream's internal
--   Levenberg-Marquardt/EndCriteria defaults apply at every calibrated
--   node instead.
--   
--   <tt>volSpreads</tt> and <tt>parametersGuess</tt> are both flattened
--   over the (optionTenor x swapTenor) product as the *outer* index (row =
--   j*nSwapTenors+k, j over <tt>optionTenors</tt>, k over
--   <tt>swapTenors</tt>) -- not one row per <tt>optionTenor</tt> the way
--   <tt>swaptionVolatilityMatrix''</tt>s grid is: <tt>matrixRows == length
--   optionTenors * length swapTenors</tt> for both. <tt>volSpreads</tt>'s
--   columns are one per <tt>strikeSpreads</tt> entry;
--   <tt>parametersGuess</tt>'s columns are always exactly 4, in order
--   alpha/beta/nu/rho.
--   
--   Calibration is lazy: unlike <a>sabrInterpolatedSmileSection</a>,
--   construction here does <i>not</i> force an eager fit, so this call can
--   succeed even for inputs that will later fail to calibrate -- the error
--   only surfaces on the first
--   <a>smileSection</a>/<a>volatilityForPeriod'</a>/diagnostic call.
sabrSwaptionVolatilityCube :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> [Double] -> Matrix (GenQuote q1) -> GenSwapIndex sidx1 -> GenSwapIndex sidx2 -> Bool -> Matrix (GenQuote q2) -> Bool -> Bool -> Bool -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe Double -> Maybe Double -> Bool -> Word -> Bool -> Double -> IO SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube

-- | The non-SABR, linear-interpolation swaption volatility cube:
--   interpolates the given <tt>volSpreads</tt> rather than calibrating a
--   smile model. No <a>EndCriteria</a>/<a>OptimizationMethod</a> hazard
--   here -- this class never calibrates anything. See
--   <a>sabrSwaptionVolatilityCube</a> for the <tt>volSpreads</tt>
--   flattening convention (identical here, minus
--   <tt>parametersGuess</tt>).
interpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCube :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> [Double] -> Matrix (GenQuote q) -> GenSwapIndex sidx1 -> GenSwapIndex sidx2 -> Bool -> IO InterpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCube

-- | Per-node calibrated SABR parameters (alpha, beta, nu, rho columns)
--   before ATM recalibration.
sparseSabrParameters :: SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube -> IO (Matrix Double)

-- | Per-node calibrated SABR parameters, meaningfully populated only when
--   the cube was built with <tt>isAtmCalibrated = True</tt> (see
--   <a>sabrSwaptionVolatilityCube</a>).
denseSabrParameters :: SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube -> IO (Matrix Double)

-- | The raw market vol grid the cube's SABR fit targets: ATM vol
--   (interpolated from <tt>atmVolStructure</tt> at each node) plus
--   <tt>volSpreads</tt>.
marketVolCube :: SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube -> IO (Matrix Double)

-- | Like <a>marketVolCube</a>, adjusted so the cube's own ATM row is
--   consistent with <tt>atmVolStructure</tt>; meaningfully populated only
--   when the cube was built with <tt>isAtmCalibrated = True</tt>.
volCubeAtmCalibrated :: SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube -> IO (Matrix Double)

-- | ATM strike at a given (option date, swap tenor) node.
sabrSwaptionVolatilityCubeAtmStrike' :: SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube -> Day -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> IO Double

-- | ATM strike at a given (option tenor, swap tenor) node, see
--   'sabrSwaptionVolatilityCubeAtmStrike''
sabrSwaptionVolatilityCubeAtmStrike :: SabrSwaptionVolatilityCube -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> IO Double

-- | ATM strike at a given (option date, swap tenor) node.
interpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCubeAtmStrike' :: InterpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCube -> Day -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> IO Double

-- | ATM strike at a given (option tenor, swap tenor) node, see
--   'interpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCubeAtmStrike''
interpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCubeAtmStrike :: InterpolatedSwaptionVolatilityCube -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> IO Double

-- | floating reference date, floating market data. See
--   'swaptionVolatilityMatrix'' for the <tt>shifts</tt> convention
--   (<tt>Matrix 0 0 []</tt> for "no shift").
swaptionVolatilityMatrix :: Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> Matrix (GenQuote q) -> DayCounter -> Bool -> VolatilityType -> Matrix Double -> IO SwaptionVolatilityStructure

-- | as <a>localVolSurface</a>, but a local vol calculation that would
--   otherwise throw returns <tt>illegalLocalVolOverwrite</tt> instead
noExceptLocalVolSurface :: GenBlackVolTermStructure bv -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenQuote q -> Double -> IO LocalVolTermStructure

-- | a local vol surface fed directly from a matrix of local vols (rather
--   than derived from a Black vol surface, as <a>localVolSurface</a> is)
--   -- one flat strike grid shared across all dates, same shape as
--   <a>blackVarianceSurface</a>.
fixedLocalVolSurface :: Day -> [Day] -> [Double] -> Matrix Double -> DayCounter -> FixedLocalVolSurfaceExtrapolation -> FixedLocalVolSurfaceExtrapolation -> IO LocalVolTermStructure

-- | as <a>spreadedSwaptionVolatility</a>, for
--   <a>OptionletVolatilityStructure</a> rather than
--   <a>SwaptionVolatilityStructure</a>
spreadedOptionletVol :: GenOptionletVolatilityStructure ov -> GenQuote q -> IO OptionletVolatilityStructure

-- | the local vol at a given date and underlying level, for any
--   <a>LocalVolTermStructure</a> (however it was constructed) -- the only
--   way to observe what a local vol surface actually computes.
localVol :: LocalVolTermStructure -> Day -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | the ATM level baked into the <a>SmileSection</a> at construction (or
--   later re-anchored via <a>atmSmileSection</a>), for any
--   <a>SmileSection</a> (however it was constructed)
smileSectionAtmLevel :: SmileSection -> IO Double

-- | a flat-volatility smile section: <a>volatility</a> returns
--   <tt>vol</tt> for every strike. <a>Nothing</a>/<a>Nothing</a> reproduce
--   upstream's own defaults for <tt>referenceDate</tt>/<tt>atmLevel</tt>.
flatSmileSection :: Day -> Double -> DayCounter -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Double -> VolatilityType -> Double -> IO SmileSection

-- | a <a>SmileSection</a> whose volatility at every strike is
--   <tt>source</tt>'s plus <tt>spread</tt> (which may change over time,
--   since it's a live <a>GenQuote</a> rather than a fixed number)
spreadedSmileSection :: SmileSection -> GenQuote q -> IO SmileSection

-- | <tt>source</tt> re-anchored to a different ATM level (<a>Nothing</a>
--   reproduces upstream's own default, which recomputes the ATM level from
--   <tt>source</tt> itself). <tt>source</tt>'s volatility at every other
--   strike is unchanged -- use <a>smileSectionAtmLevel</a> to observe what
--   this changed.
atmSmileSection :: SmileSection -> Maybe Double -> IO SmileSection
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.BlackVarianceSurfaceExtrapolation
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.BlackVolTimeExtrapolationType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.ExtendedBlackVarianceSurfaceExtrapolation
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.FixedLocalVolSurfaceExtrapolation
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.SmileInterpolationMethod
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.BlackVarianceSurfaceExtrapolation
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.BlackVolTimeExtrapolationType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.ExtendedBlackVarianceSurfaceExtrapolation
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.FixedLocalVolSurfaceExtrapolation
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.SmileInterpolationMethod
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.BlackVarianceSurfaceExtrapolation
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.BlackVolTimeExtrapolationType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.ExtendedBlackVarianceSurfaceExtrapolation
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.FixedLocalVolSurfaceExtrapolation
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.TermStructure.Volatility.SmileInterpolationMethod

module QuantLib.Instrument.CapFloor
type CapFloor = GenInstrument CCapFloor

-- | constructs a cap: pays the excess of the floating leg's rate over each
--   exercise rate, if positive
cap :: GenLeg l -> [Double] -> IO CapFloor

-- | constructs a collar: a cap struck at the cap rates combined with a
--   floor struck at the floor rates
collar :: GenLeg l -> [Double] -> [Double] -> IO CapFloor

-- | constructs a floor: pays the excess of each exercise rate over the
--   floating leg's rate, if positive
floor :: GenLeg l -> [Double] -> IO CapFloor

-- | returns the fair (at-the-money) rate for the cap/floor's underlying
--   floating leg, discounted on the given curve
atmRate :: CapFloor -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> IO Double

-- | implied term volatility
impliedVolatility :: CapFloor -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Double -> Word -> Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Returns the n-th optionlet as a new CapFloor with only one cash flow.
optionlet :: CapFloor -> Word -> IO CapFloor

-- | One value from QuantLib's `Instrument::additionalResults()` map.
--   QuantLib stores the map as `ext::any`, so this Haskell view picks
--   three concrete shapes -- <a>Real</a> (<a>Double</a>), `std::string`
--   (<a>String</a>), `std::vector<a>Real</a>` (`[Double]`) -- plus an
--   <a>UnsupportedVal</a> fallback recording the value's C++ RTTI type
--   name, so no key is ever silently dropped or mislabelled.
data AdditionalResultVal
RealVal :: Double -> AdditionalResultVal
StringVal :: String -> AdditionalResultVal
RealVectorVal :: [Double] -> AdditionalResultVal
UnsupportedVal :: String -> AdditionalResultVal

-- | Returns the net present value of the given Instrument
npv :: GenInstrument i -> IO Double

-- | returns the error estimate on the NPV when available.
errorEstimate :: GenInstrument i -> IO Double

-- | returns whether the instrument might have value greater than zero.
isExpired :: GenInstrument i -> IO Bool

-- | returns the date the net present value refers to.
valuationDate :: GenInstrument i -> IO Day
composite :: [(Instrument, Double)] -> IO Instrument

-- | Returns QuantLib's `additionalResults()` map for the given Instrument,
--   as an association list keyed by the C++ result name. The map's values
--   are populated by the pricing engine; `additionalResults()` calls
--   `calculate()` internally, so this is safe and idempotent after
--   pricing.
additionalResults :: GenInstrument i -> IO [(String, AdditionalResultVal)]

-- | Sets the pricing engine used to compute the instrument's results.
setPricingEngine :: GenInstrument i -> PricingEngine -> IO ()

module QuantLib.TermStructure.Credit
data ProbabilityTrait
SurvivalProbability :: ProbabilityTrait
HazardRate :: ProbabilityTrait
DefaultDensity :: ProbabilityTrait
type DefaultProbabilityTermStructure = GenTermStructure CDefaultProbabilityTermStructure
data DefaultProbabilityHelper

-- | a curve whose hazard rate is another curve's, scaled by a spread
--   factor
factorSpreadedHazardRateCurve :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> GenQuote q -> IO DefaultProbabilityTermStructure

-- | flat hazard-rate curve anchored at a settlement date
flatHazardRate' :: Word -> Calendar -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO DefaultProbabilityTermStructure

-- | flat hazard-rate curve anchored at a reference date
flatHazardRate :: Day -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO DefaultProbabilityTermStructure

-- | a curve whose survival probability is another curve's, multiplied by a
--   spread factor
spreadedHazardRateCurve :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> GenQuote q -> IO DefaultProbabilityTermStructure

-- | default probability from the reference date until a given date
defaultProbability :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Day -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | hazard rate at a given time, with annual frequency and continuous
--   compounding
hazardRate' :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | hazard rate at a given date, with annual frequency and continuous
--   compounding
hazardRate :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Day -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | The same day-counting rule used by the term structure should be used
--   for calculating the passed time t.
survivalProbability' :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | survival probability from the reference date until a given date
survivalProbability :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Day -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | The same day-counting rule used by the term structure should be used
--   for calculating the passed time t.
defaultDensity' :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | default density at a given date
defaultDensity :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Day -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | The same day-counting rule used by the term structure should be used
--   for calculating the passed time t.
defaultProbability' :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | probability of default between two given dates
defaultProbabilityBetween :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Day -> Day -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | probability of default between two given times
defaultProbabilityBetween' :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | bootstrap helper for a CDS quoted by running spread
spreadCdsHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Int -> Calendar -> Frequency -> BusinessDayConvention -> DateGenerationRule -> DayCounter -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> DayCounter -> Bool -> PricingModel -> IO DefaultProbabilityHelper

-- | the upfront must be quoted in fractional units.
upfrontCdsHelper :: GenQuote q -> Double -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Int -> Calendar -> Frequency -> BusinessDayConvention -> DateGenerationRule -> DayCounter -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Word -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> DayCounter -> Bool -> PricingModel -> IO DefaultProbabilityHelper
interpolatedDefaultDensityCurve :: [(Day, Double)] -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> Interpolation -> IO DefaultProbabilityTermStructure
interpolatedHazardRateCurve :: [(Day, Double)] -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> Interpolation -> Bool -> IO DefaultProbabilityTermStructure
interpolatedSurvivalProbabilityCurve :: [(Day, Double)] -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> Interpolation -> IO DefaultProbabilityTermStructure
piecewiseDefaultCurve :: Day -> [DefaultProbabilityHelper] -> DayCounter -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> ProbabilityTrait -> Interpolation -> IO DefaultProbabilityTermStructure
piecewiseDefaultCurve' :: Word -> Calendar -> [DefaultProbabilityHelper] -> DayCounter -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> ProbabilityTrait -> Interpolation -> IO DefaultProbabilityTermStructure
