module QuantLib.Instrument.Option
type Option = GenOption COption
asOption :: GenOption o -> IO Option
asOneAssetOption :: GenOneAssetOption oo -> IO OneAssetOption
type CdsOption = GenOption CCdsOption
type BarrierOption = GenOneAssetOption CBarrierOption
type DoubleBarrierOption = GenOneAssetOption CDoubleBarrierOption
type MargrabeOption = GenMultiAssetOption CMargrabeOption
type MultiAssetOption = GenMultiAssetOption CMultiAssetOption
type OneAssetOption = GenOneAssetOption COneAssetOption
type QuantoBarrierOption = GenOneAssetOption CQuantoBarrierOption
type QuantoForwardVanillaOption = GenOneAssetOption CQuantoForwardVanillaOption
type QuantoVanillaOption = GenOneAssetOption CQuantoVanillaOption
type VanillaOption = GenOneAssetOption CVanillaOption
data ExerciseType
ExerciseTypeAmerican :: ExerciseType
ExerciseTypeBermudan :: ExerciseType
ExerciseTypeEuropean :: ExerciseType

-- | <pre>
--   Exercise
--    American
--    Early
--    Vanilla
--    EuropeanExercise
--    BermudanExercise
--      SwingExercise
--   </pre>
data Exercise
American :: !Maybe Day -> !Day -> !Bool -> Exercise
Early :: !ExerciseType -> !Bool -> Exercise
Vanilla :: !ExerciseType -> Exercise
European :: !EuropeanExercise -> Exercise
Bermudan :: !BermudanExercise -> Exercise
data EuropeanExercise
EuropeanExercise :: Day -> EuropeanExercise
data BermudanExercise
BermudanExercise :: ![Day] -> !Bool -> BermudanExercise
Swing :: SwingExercise -> BermudanExercise

-- | Use <tt>swingExerice</tt> to construct <a>Exercise</a>
data SwingExercise

-- | (dates, seconds)
SwingListExercise :: ![(Day, Word)] -> SwingExercise

-- | stepSizeSecs
SwingIntervalExercise :: !Day -> !Day -> !Word -> SwingExercise
data OptionType
Put :: OptionType
Call :: OptionType
data PositionType
Long :: PositionType
Short :: PositionType

-- | use <a>strikedPayoff</a> to construct <a>Payoff</a>
data StrikedPayoff
AssetOrNothing :: !OptionType -> !Double -> StrikedPayoff
CashOrNothing :: !OptionType -> !Double -> !Double -> StrikedPayoff
Gap :: !OptionType -> !Double -> !Double -> StrikedPayoff
PercentageStrike :: !PercentageStrikePayoff -> StrikedPayoff
PlainVanilla :: !PlainVanillaPayoff -> StrikedPayoff
SuperFund :: !Double -> !Double -> StrikedPayoff
SuperSharePayoff :: !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> StrikedPayoff

-- | use <a>plainVanillaPayoff</a> to construct <a>Payoff</a>
data PlainVanillaPayoff

-- | use <a>percentageStrikePayoff</a> to construct <a>Payoff</a>
data PercentageStrikePayoff
PercentageStrikePayoff :: !OptionType -> !Double -> PercentageStrikePayoff
data BasketPayoff

AverageMultiple :: !Payoff -> ![Double] -> BasketPayoff

-- | p
Max :: !Payoff -> BasketPayoff

-- | p
Min :: !Payoff -> BasketPayoff

-- | p
Spread :: !Payoff -> BasketPayoff

-- | <pre>
--   Payoff
--    DoubleStickyRatchet
--    ForwardType
--    RatchettMax
--    RatchetMin
--    StickyMax
--    StickyMin
--    Sticky
--    TypePayoff
--      Floating
--      Striked
--        AssetOrNothing
--        CashOrNothing
--        Gap
--        PercentageStrike

--        SuperFund
--        SuperSharePayoff
--    BasketPayoff
--      Average
--      AverageMultiple
--      Max
--      Min
--      Spread
--   </pre>
data Payoff
DoubleStickyRatchet :: !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> Payoff
ForwardType :: !PositionType -> !Double -> Payoff
RatchetMax :: !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> Payoff
RatchetMin :: !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> Payoff
Ratchet :: !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> Payoff
StickyMax :: !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> Payoff
StickyMin :: !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> Payoff
Sticky :: !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> Payoff
Type :: !TypePayoff -> Payoff
Basket :: !BasketPayoff -> Payoff
data TypePayoff
Striked :: !StrikedPayoff -> TypePayoff

-- | type
Floating :: !OptionType -> TypePayoff
strikedPayoff :: StrikedPayoff -> Payoff
plainVanillaPayoff :: PlainVanillaPayoff -> Payoff
percentageStrikePayoff :: PercentageStrikePayoff -> Payoff
swingExercise :: SwingExercise -> Exercise

-- | Barrier option on a single asset.
barrierOption :: BarrierType -> Double -> Double -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO BarrierOption

-- | Barrier option on a single asset that is only monitored for part of
--   its life (a partial-time barrier).
partialTimeBarrierOption :: BarrierType -> PartialBarrierRange -> Double -> Double -> Day -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Double-barrier option on a single asset, with a lower and an upper
--   barrier.
doubleBarrierOption :: DoubleBarrierType -> Double -> Double -> Double -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO DoubleBarrierOption

-- | Implied Black-Scholes volatility that reproduces the given price for a
--   DoubleBarrierOption; see VanillaOption's implied-volatility for the
--   caveats on reliability.
doubleBarrierOptionImpliedVolatility :: DoubleBarrierOption -> Double -> GenGeneralizedBlackScholesProcess gbs -> Double -> Word -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Forward-starting (strike-resetting) version of a vanilla option.
forwardVanillaOption :: Double -> Day -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Compound option (an option on another option) on a single asset. The
--   mother option is the compound option itself; the daughter option is
--   its underlying.
compoundOption :: StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Sensitivity of a MargrabeOption's value to the price of the first
--   asset.
delta1 :: MargrabeOption -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity of a MargrabeOption's value to the price of the second
--   asset.
delta2 :: MargrabeOption -> IO Double

-- | Second derivative of a MargrabeOption's value with respect to the
--   price of the first asset.
gamma1 :: MargrabeOption -> IO Double

-- | Second derivative of a MargrabeOption's value with respect to the
--   price of the second asset.
gamma2 :: MargrabeOption -> IO Double

-- | Margrabe option on two assets: the right to exchange Q2 units of the
--   second asset for Q1 units of the first at expiration.
margrabeOption :: Int -> Int -> Exercise -> IO MargrabeOption

-- | Base construction for an option on multiple assets.
multiAssetOption :: Payoff -> Exercise -> IO MultiAssetOption

-- | Sensitivity of the option's value to the forward price of the
--   underlying.
deltaForward :: GenOneAssetOption oo -> IO Double

-- | Percentage change in the option's value per percentage change in the
--   underlying price.
elasticity :: GenOneAssetOption oo -> IO Double

-- | Probability of the option expiring in-the-money in a cash-or-nothing
--   sense.
itmCashProbability :: GenOneAssetOption oo -> IO Double

-- | Base construction for an option on a single asset.
oneAssetOption :: Payoff -> Exercise -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Sensitivity of the option's value to the strike price.
strikeSensitivity :: GenOneAssetOption oo -> IO Double

-- | Theta divided by the number of days elapsed per day (as opposed to per
--   year).
thetaPerDay :: GenOneAssetOption oo -> IO Double

-- | Quanto version of a barrier option on a single asset.
quantoBarrierOption :: BarrierType -> Double -> Double -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO QuantoBarrierOption

-- | Quanto version of a forward-starting (strike-resetting) vanilla
--   option.
quantoForwardVanillaOption :: Double -> Day -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO QuantoForwardVanillaOption

-- | Quanto version of a vanilla option on a single asset.
quantoVanillaOption :: StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO QuantoVanillaOption

-- | Vanilla option (no discrete dividends, no barriers) on a single asset.
vanillaOption :: StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO VanillaOption

-- | Basket option on a number of assets, combined by the given basket
--   payoff (e.g. min<i>max</i>spread/average).
basketOption :: BasketPayoff -> Exercise -> IO MultiAssetOption

-- | Himalaya option: at the end of each of a series of periods, the
--   best-performing asset in the basket is added to the average and
--   dropped from the basket; the payoff is the max of the strike and the
--   final average of best performers.
himalayaOption :: [Day] -> Double -> IO MultiAssetOption

-- | Roofed Asian option on a number of assets: pays the given fraction of
--   the minimum of the roof and the positive portfolio performance, or
--   nothing if the performance is negative.
pagodaOption :: [Day] -> Double -> Double -> IO MultiAssetOption

-- | Cliquet (ratchet) option: a series of forward-starting options where
--   each period's strike is set to a fixed percentage of the spot price at
--   the start of that period.
cliquetOption :: PercentageStrikePayoff -> EuropeanExercise -> [Day] -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Continuous-averaging Asian option on a single asset, for an unseasoned
--   (fresh) option where averaging has not yet started.
continuousAveragingAsianOption :: AverageType -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Continuous-fixed lookback option: the payoff uses the fixed strike
--   against the minimum/maximum price observed over the option's life.
continuousFixedLookbackOption :: Double -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Continuous-floating lookback option: the strike is set to the
--   minimum/maximum price observed over the option's life.
continuousFloatingLookbackOption :: Double -> TypePayoff -> Exercise -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Discrete-averaging Asian option on a single asset, taking the running
--   sum/product of past fixings plus a list of future fixing dates.
discreteAveragingAsianOption :: AverageType -> Double -> Word -> [Day] -> StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Storage option (e.g. a gas storage facility): a payoff-free instrument
--   exercisable on a Bermudan schedule, with a maximum capacity,
--   load/withdrawal rate, and per-period rate of change.
vanillaStorageOption :: BermudanExercise -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | Swing option: a payoff exercisable a bounded number of times (between
--   minExerciseRights and maxExerciseRights) at the dates of a
--   SwingExercise.
vanillaSwingOption :: StrikedPayoff -> SwingExercise -> Word -> Word -> IO OneAssetOption

-- | European (single-exercise-date) vanilla option on a single asset.
europeanOption :: StrikedPayoff -> Exercise -> IO VanillaOption
class HasImpliedVol a
impliedVolatility :: HasImpliedVol a => a -> Double -> GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> [Dividend] -> Double -> Word -> Double -> Double -> IO Double
class HasQuanto a
qrho :: HasQuanto a => a -> IO Double
qvega :: HasQuanto a => a -> IO Double
qlambda :: HasQuanto a => a -> IO Double
class HasGreeks a
delta :: HasGreeks a => a -> IO Double
gamma :: HasGreeks a => a -> IO Double
rho :: HasGreeks a => a -> IO Double
theta :: HasGreeks a => a -> IO Double
vega :: HasGreeks a => a -> IO Double
dividendRho :: HasGreeks a => a -> IO Double
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Option.HasGreeks QuantLib.Internal.Type.MultiAssetOption
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Option.HasGreeks QuantLib.Internal.Type.OneAssetOption
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Option.HasImpliedVol QuantLib.Internal.Type.VanillaOption
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Option.HasImpliedVol QuantLib.Internal.Type.BarrierOption
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Option.HasQuanto QuantLib.Internal.Type.QuantoBarrierOption
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Option.HasQuanto QuantLib.Internal.Type.QuantoForwardVanillaOption
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Option.HasQuanto QuantLib.Internal.Type.QuantoVanillaOption

module QuantLib.PricingEngine
data PricingEngine

-- | <pre>
--   BlackCalculator
--     BlackScholesCalculator
--   </pre>
type BlackCalculator = GenBlackCalculator CBlackCalculator
type BlackScholesCalculator = GenBlackCalculator CBlackScholesCalculator
data BachelierCalculator
data BlackDeltaCalculator
data CashAnnuityModel
SwapRate :: CashAnnuityModel
DiscountCurve :: CashAnnuityModel
data Probabilities
None :: Probabilities
Naive :: Probabilities
Digital :: Probabilities
data CashDividendModel
CashDividendSpot :: CashDividendModel
CashDividendEscrowed :: CashDividendModel
data NumericalFix
NumericalFixNone :: NumericalFix
NumericalFixTaylor :: NumericalFix
data AccrualBias
HalfDayBias :: AccrualBias
NoBias :: AccrualBias
data ForwardsInCouponPeriod
Flat :: ForwardsInCouponPeriod
Piecewise :: ForwardsInCouponPeriod
data FdmQuantoHelper
data GenBlackCalculator bc
asBlackCalculator :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO BlackCalculator

-- | discounts a bond's cash flows off a yield term structure
discountingBondEngine :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Maybe Bool -> IO PricingEngine

-- | discounts a bond's cash flows off a default-risky curve and a flat
--   recovery rate
riskyBondEngine :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> IO PricingEngine

-- | discounts a swap's legs off a single discount curve
discountingSwapEngine :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO PricingEngine

-- | discounts an FX forward's two legs off their respective currency
--   discount curves
discountingFxForwardEngine :: GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenQuote q -> IO PricingEngine

-- | CVA/DVA-adjusted swap pricing engine.
--   <tt>invstDTS</tt>/<tt>invstRecoveryRate</tt> are the own
--   (investor-side) default probability curve and recovery rate for
--   bilateral CVA/DVA; pass <a>Nothing</a> for <tt>invstDTS</tt> and
--   <tt>0.999</tt> for <tt>invstRecoveryRate</tt> to match upstream's
--   unilateral-CVA-only defaults.
counterpartyAdjSwapEngine :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenQuote q -> DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> Maybe DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for barrier options
analyticBarrierEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for partial-time barrier options
analyticPartialTimeBarrierOptionEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for American binary barrier options
--   (cash-or-nothing/asset-or-nothing)
analyticBinaryBarrierEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | finite-differences Black-Scholes barrier-option pricing engine
fdBlackScholesBarrierEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> Word -> Word -> Word -> FdmScheme -> Bool -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

-- | finite-differences Heston-model barrier-option pricing engine
fdHestonBarrierEngine :: GenHestonModel hm -> Word -> Word -> Word -> Word -> FdmScheme -> Maybe LocalVolTermStructure -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

-- | finite-differences Heston-model barrier-option pricing engine, with
--   discrete dividends
fdHestonBarrierEngine' :: GenHestonModel hm -> [Dividend] -> Word -> Word -> Word -> Word -> FdmScheme -> Maybe LocalVolTermStructure -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

-- | <i>NB</i> Timesteps for Cox-Ross-Rubinstein trees are adjusted using
--   the Boyle-Lau algorithm; pass <tt>maxTimeSteps = timeSteps</tt> to
--   disable it, or <tt>0</tt> to use the library's default heuristic.
binomialBarrierEngine :: BinomialTree -> GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> Word -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | FX barrier option engine using the vanna-volga method to account for
--   the volatility smile
vannaVolgaBarrierEngine :: DeltaVolQuote -> DeltaVolQuote -> DeltaVolQuote -> GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> Bool -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for double-barrier European options
analyticDoubleBarrierEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> Int -> IO PricingEngine

-- | finite-differences Heston-model double-barrier-option pricing engine
fdHestonDoubleBarrierEngine :: GenHestonModel hm -> Word -> Word -> Word -> Word -> FdmScheme -> Maybe LocalVolTermStructure -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

-- | always uses <tt>AnalyticDoubleBarrierEngine</tt> as the underlying
--   smile-free double-barrier engine
vannaVolgaDoubleBarrierEngine :: DeltaVolQuote -> DeltaVolQuote -> DeltaVolQuote -> GenQuote q -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> Bool -> Double -> Int -> IO PricingEngine

-- | pricing engine for double-barrier options using binomial trees
binomialDoubleBarrierEngine :: BinomialTree -> GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | Monte Carlo pricing engine for double-barrier options
mcDoubleBarrierEngine :: RngTrait -> GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> Maybe Word -> Maybe Word -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe Word -> Maybe Double -> Maybe Word -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for Cliquet (ratchet) options
analyticCliquetEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for compound options
analyticCompoundOptionEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for European continuous fixed-strike lookback
--   options
analyticContinuousFixedLookbackEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for European continuous floating-strike
--   lookback options
analyticContinuousFloatingLookbackEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for European continuous geometric
--   average-price Asian options
analyticContinuousGeometricAveragePriceAsianEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for American digital
--   (cash-or-nothing/asset-or-nothing) options
analyticDigitalAmericanEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for European discrete geometric average-price
--   Asian options
analyticDiscreteGeometricAveragePriceAsianEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for European discrete geometric average-strike
--   Asian options
analyticDiscreteGeometricAverageStrikeAsianEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for European options with discrete dividends
analyticDividendEuropeanEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> [Dividend] -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic Black-Scholes pricing engine for European options
analyticEuropeanEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for performance (return) options
analyticPerformanceEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | Black-formula cap/floor engine, taking an optionlet volatility
--   structure
blackCapFloorEngine' :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenOptionletVolatilityStructure ov -> IO PricingEngine

-- | Black-formula cap/floor engine, taking a flat volatility quote
blackCapFloorEngine :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

--   volatility quote
blackSwaptionEngine :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> Double -> CashAnnuityModel -> IO PricingEngine

-- | shifted-lognormal Black-formula swaption engine, taking a swaption
--   volatility structure
blackSwaptionEngine' :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> IO PricingEngine

-- | Bachelier (normal) cap/floor engine, taking an optionlet volatility
--   structure
bachelierCapFloorEngine' :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenOptionletVolatilityStructure ov -> IO PricingEngine

-- | Bachelier (normal) cap/floor engine, taking a flat volatility quote
bachelierCapFloorEngine :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> IO PricingEngine

-- | Bachelier (normal) swaption engine, taking a flat volatility quote
bachelierSwaptionEngine :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> CashAnnuityModel -> IO PricingEngine

-- | Bachelier (normal) swaption engine, taking a swaption volatility
--   structure
bachelierSwaptionEngine' :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic European option pricer including stochastic interest rates
--   (Black-Scholes-Merton + Hull-White)
analyticBSMHullWhiteEngine :: Double -> GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> HullWhite -> IO PricingEngine

-- | the term structure is only needed when the short-rate model cannot
--   provide one itself.
analyticCapFloorEngine :: AffineModel -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO PricingEngine

-- | analytic pricing engine for vanilla options under a GJR-GARCH process
analyticGJRGARCHEngine :: GJRGARCHModel -> IO PricingEngine

-- | semi-analytic Heston-model pricing engine, integrating with a fixed
--   relative tolerance and evaluation cap
analyticHestonEngine :: GenHestonModel hm -> Double -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | semi-analytic pricing engine combining a Heston equity model with a
--   Hull-White short-rate model
analyticHestonHullWhiteEngine :: GenHestonModel hm -> HullWhite -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | semi-analytic pricing engine for the Bates (Heston plus jumps) model,
--   integrating with a fixed order
batesEngine :: GenBatesModel bm -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | FFT-based pricing engine for vanilla options under a Black-Scholes
--   process
fftVanillaEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

-- | swaption pricing engine for the G2 two-factor short-rate model, priced
--   via the Black formula
g2SwaptionEngine :: G2 -> Double -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | jump-diffusion pricing engine for vanilla options, taking a Merton76
--   process
jumpDiffusionEngine :: Merton76Process -> Double -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | numerical-lattice pricing engine for caps/floors under a short-rate
--   model
treeCapFloorEngine :: GenShortRateModel sm -> Word -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO PricingEngine

-- | numerical-lattice pricing engine for swaptions under a short-rate
--   model
treeSwaptionEngine :: GenShortRateModel sm -> Word -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO PricingEngine

-- | numerical-lattice pricing engine for plain vanilla swaps under a
--   short-rate model
treeVanillaSwapEngine :: GenShortRateModel sm -> Word -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO PricingEngine

-- | pricing engine for European vanilla options using the Variance Gamma
--   model, integrated numerically
varianceGammaEngine :: VarianceGammaProcess -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

-- | semi-analytic Heston-model pricing engine, integrating with a fixed
--   quadrature order
analyticHestonEngine' :: GenHestonModel hm -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | semi-analytic Heston/Hull-White engine, integrating with a fixed
--   relative tolerance and evaluation cap
analyticHestonHullWhiteEngine' :: GenHestonModel hm -> HullWhite -> Double -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | semi-analytic Bates-model pricing engine, integrating with a fixed
--   relative tolerance and evaluation cap
batesEngine' :: GenBatesModel bm -> Double -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

-- | <i>NB</i> C++ classes Monte Carlo engines are additionally
--   parameterised via statistic template argument Functions below use
--   default value of Statistics
mcHestonHullWhiteEngine :: RngTrait -> HybridHestonHullWhiteProcess -> Maybe Word -> Maybe Word -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe Word -> Maybe Double -> Maybe Word -> Word -> IO PricingEngine

--   American options

--   integrating with a fixed relative tolerance and evaluation cap

--   integrating with a fixed quadrature order

--   deterministic jumps, integrating with a fixed quadrature order

--   CDS's step-wise schedule

integralEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

isdaCdsEngine :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Maybe Bool -> NumericalFix -> AccrualBias -> ForwardsInCouponPeriod -> IO PricingEngine

-- | the term structure is only needed when the short-rate model cannot
--   provide one itself.
jamshidianSwaptionEngine :: GenOneFactorAffineModel om -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO PricingEngine

--   evaluated by integration over the model's state variable
gaussian1dSwaptionEngine :: Gaussian1dModel -> Int -> Double -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> Probabilities -> IO PricingEngine

juQuadraticApproximationEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> IO PricingEngine

-- | pricing engine for a spread option on two futures/assets
kirkEngine :: BlackProcess -> BlackProcess -> Double -> IO PricingEngine

midPointCdsEngine :: DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Maybe Bool -> IO PricingEngine

replicatingVarianceSwapEngine :: GeneralizedBlackScholesProcess -> Double -> [Double] -> [Double] -> IO PricingEngine

lfmSwaptionEngine :: LiborForwardModel -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> IO PricingEngine

-- | Snapshots <tt>rTS</tt><i><tt>fTS</tt></i><tt>fxVolTS</tt> at

-- | intermediate value N'(d1) (or its sign-flipped equivalent) used
--   internally to derive the calculator's Greeks
alpha :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

-- | intermediate value N'(d2) (or its sign-flipped equivalent) used
--   internally to derive the calculator's Greeks
beta :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 option-price calculator, from the option type and strike
--   directly
blackCalculator' :: OptionType -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO BlackCalculator

-- | Black 1976 option-price calculator, from a striked payoff
blackCalculator :: StrikedPayoff -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO BlackCalculator

-- | Sensitivity to change in the underlying spot price.
blackDelta :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to change in the underlying forward price.
deltaForward :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to dividend/growth rate.
dividendRho :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity in percent to a percent change in the underlying spot
--   price.
blackElasticity :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity in percent to a percent change in the underlying forward
--   price.
elasticityForward :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

--   price.
blackGamma :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Second order derivative with respect to change in the underlying
--   forward price.
gammaForward :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

-- | Probability of being in the money in the asset martingale measure,
--   i.e. N(d1). It is a risk-neutral probability, not the real world one.
itmAssetProbability :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

-- | Probability of being in the money in the bond martingale measure, i.e.
--   N(d2). It is a risk-neutral probability, not the real world one.
itmCashProbability :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to discounting rate.
rho :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to strike.
strikeSensitivity :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

-- | gamma w.r.t. strike.
strikeGamma :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to time to maturity.
blackTheta :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to time to maturity per day, assuming 365 day per year.
blackThetaPerDay :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

value :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> IO Double

vanna :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to volatility.
vega :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> IO Double

volga :: GenBlackCalculator bc -> Double -> IO Double

--   price.

blackScholesThetaPerDay :: BlackScholesCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Bachelier (normal-model) analogue of <a>BlackCalculator</a>, for
--   options on a rate rather than a price. No subclass hierarchy upstream,
--   unlike BlackCalculator/BlackScholesCalculator, so this is a single
--   leaf type with its own methods rather than a <a>GenBlackCalculator</a>
--   instance.
bachelierCalculator' :: OptionType -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO BachelierCalculator

-- | Bachelier (normal-model) option-price calculator, from a striked
--   payoff
bachelierCalculator :: StrikedPayoff -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO BachelierCalculator

-- | intermediate value used internally to derive the calculator's Greeks
bachelierAlpha :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | intermediate value used internally to derive the calculator's Greeks
bachelierBeta :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to change in the underlying spot price.
bachelierDelta :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to change in the underlying forward price.
bachelierDeltaForward :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to dividend/growth rate.
bachelierDividendRho :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity in percent to a percent change in the underlying spot
--   price.
bachelierElasticity :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity in percent to a percent change in the underlying forward
--   price.
bachelierElasticityForward :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | Second order derivative with respect to change in the underlying spot
--   price.
bachelierGamma :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Second order derivative with respect to change in the underlying
--   forward price.
bachelierGammaForward :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | Probability of being in the money in the asset martingale measure,
--   i.e. N(d). It is a risk-neutral probability, not the real world one.
bachelierItmAssetProbability :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | Probability of being in the money in the bond martingale measure, i.e.
--   N(d). It is a risk-neutral probability, not the real world one.
bachelierItmCashProbability :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to discounting rate.
bachelierRho :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to strike.
bachelierStrikeSensitivity :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | gamma w.r.t. strike.
bachelierStrikeGamma :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to time to maturity.
bachelierTheta :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to time to maturity per day, assuming 365 day per year.
bachelierThetaPerDay :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | the option's fair value
bachelierValue :: BachelierCalculator -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity of vega to spot (Vanna).
bachelierVanna :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity to volatility.
bachelierVega :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Sensitivity of vega to volatility (Volga).
bachelierVolga :: BachelierCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | computes the strike given the option's Black-Scholes delta (in an
--   FX-style delta/vol quotation)
blackDeltaCalculator :: OptionType -> DeltaType -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO BlackDeltaCalculator

-- | the option delta under the calculator's chosen convention, for the
--   given strike
deltaFromStrike :: BlackDeltaCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | the strike price corresponding to the given option delta (under the
--   calculator's chosen convention)
strikeFromDelta :: BlackDeltaCalculator -> Double -> IO Double

-- | the at-the-money strike under the given ATM convention, independent of
--   the strike passed at construction
atmStrike :: BlackDeltaCalculator -> AtmType -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 formula <i>Warning</i> instead of volatility it uses
--   standard deviation, i.e. volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity)
blackFormula' :: PlainVanillaPayoff -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 formula <i>Warning</i> instead of volatility it uses
--   standard deviation, i.e. volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity)
blackFormula :: OptionType -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 probability of being in the money (in the bond martingale
--   measure), i.e. N(d2). It is a risk-neutral probability, not the real
--   world one. <i>Warning</i> instead of volatility it uses standard
--   deviation, i.e. volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity)
blackCashItmProbability' :: PlainVanillaPayoff -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 probability of being in the money (in the bond martingale
--   measure), i.e. N(d2). It is a risk-neutral probability, not the real
--   world one. <i>Warning</i> instead of volatility it uses standard
--   deviation, i.e. volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity)
blackCashItmProbability :: OptionType -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 implied standard deviation, i.e.
--   volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity)
blackImpliedStdDev' :: PlainVanillaPayoff -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Word -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 implied standard deviation, i.e.
--   volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity)
blackImpliedStdDev :: OptionType -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Word -> IO Double

-- | Approximated Black 1976 implied standard deviation, i.e.
--   volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity).It is calculated using Brenner and
--   Subrahmanyan (1988) and Feinstein (1988) approximation for
--   at-the-money forward option, with the extended moneyness approximation
--   by Corrado and Miller (1996)
blackImpliedStdDevApproximation' :: PlainVanillaPayoff -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Approximated Black 1976 implied standard deviation, i.e.
--   volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity).It is calculated using Brenner and
--   Subrahmanyan (1988) and Feinstein (1988) approximation for
--   at-the-money forward option, with the extended moneyness approximation
--   by Corrado and Miller (1996)
blackImpliedStdDevApproximation :: OptionType -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 formula for standard deviation derivative <i>Warning</i>
--   instead of volatility it uses standard deviation, i.e.
--   volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity), and it returns the derivative with
--   respect to the standard deviation. If T is the time to maturity Black
--   vega would be blackStdDevDerivative(strike, forward, stdDev)*sqrt(T)
blackStdDevDerivative' :: PlainVanillaPayoff -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 formula for standard deviation derivative <i>Warning</i>
--   instead of volatility it uses standard deviation, i.e.
--   volatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity), and it returns the derivative with
--   respect to the standard deviation. If T is the time to maturity Black
--   vega would be blackStdDevDerivative(strike, forward, stdDev)*sqrt(T)
blackStdDevDerivative :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Black 1976 formula for derivative with respect to implied vol, this is
--   basically the vega, but if you want 1% change multiply by 1%
blackVolDerivative :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Black style formula when forward is normal rather than log-normal.
--   This is essentially the model of Bachelier. <i>Warning</i> Bachelier
--   model needs absolute volatility, not percentage volatility. Standard
--   deviation is absoluteVolatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity)
bachelierBlackFormula' :: PlainVanillaPayoff -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Black style formula when forward is normal rather than log-normal.
--   This is essentially the model of Bachelier. <i>Warning</i> Bachelier
--   model needs absolute volatility, not percentage volatility. Standard
--   deviation is absoluteVolatility*sqrt(timeToMaturity)
bachelierBlackFormula :: OptionType -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | default theta-per-day calculation
defaultThetaPerDay :: Double -> IO Double

-- | lognormal SABR volatility, no validity checks on the parameters
unsafeSabrLogNormalVolatility :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | shifted SABR volatility (lognormal or normal), no validity checks on
--   the parameters
unsafeShiftedSabrVolatility :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> IO Double

-- | normal SABR volatility, no validity checks on the parameters
unsafeSabrNormalVolatility :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | SABR volatility (lognormal or normal), no validity checks on the
--   parameters
unsafeSabrVolatility :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> IO Double

-- | SABR volatility (lognormal or normal), with validity checks on the
--   parameters
sabrVolatility :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> IO Double

-- | shifted SABR volatility (lognormal or normal), with validity checks on
--   the parameters
shiftedSabrVolatility :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> IO Double

-- | lognormal SABR volatility using the Floc'h-Kennedy formula, with
--   validity checks on the parameters
sabrFlochKennedyVolatility :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | validate SABR parameters, throwing if they are not acceptable
validateSabrParameters :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO ()

-- | initial guess (alpha, beta, nu, rho) for SABR calibration, per Le
--   Floc'h and Kennedy
sabrGuess :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> IO [Double]

module QuantLib.Instrument.Forward
type Forward = GenForward CForward
asForward :: GenForward f -> IO Forward
type ForwardRateAgreement = GenInstrument CForwardRateAgreement
type BondForward = GenForward CBondForward
type FxForward = GenInstrument CFxForward

-- | FRA with a par-rate approximation: the forward rate is forecast from
--   valueDate to maturityDate by the index's forecast curve
--   (useIndexedCoupon=false).
forwardRateAgreement :: GenIborIndex ibor -> Day -> Day -> PositionType -> Double -> Double -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO ForwardRateAgreement

-- | If strike is given in the constructor, can calculate the NPV of the
--   contract via NPV().If strike/forward price is desired, it can be
--   obtained via forwardPrice(). In this case, the strike variable in the
--   constructor is irrelevant and will be ignored.
bondForward :: Day -> Day -> PositionType -> Double -> Word -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> GenBond b -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y1) -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y2) -> IO BondForward

-- | FX forward using nominal amounts in both currencies.
fxForward :: Double -> Currency -> Double -> Currency -> Day -> Bool -> Word -> Calendar -> IO FxForward

-- | FX forward using a source nominal amount and a contracted forward rate
--   (target/source).
fxForward' :: Double -> Currency -> Currency -> Double -> Day -> Bool -> Word -> Calendar -> IO FxForward

-- | (dirty) forward bond price minus accrued on bond at delivery
cleanForwardPrice :: BondForward -> IO Double

-- | (dirty) forward bond price
forwardPrice :: BondForward -> IO Double

-- | forward value<i>price of underlying, discounting income</i>dividends
--   if this is a bond forward price, is must be a dirty forward price.
forwardValue :: GenForward f -> IO Double

-- | Simple yield calculation based on underlying spot and forward values,
--   taking into account underlying income. When $ t&gt;0 $, call with:
--   underlyingSpotValue=spotValue(t), forwardValue=strikePrice, to get
--   current yield. For a repo, if $ t=0 $, impliedYield should reproduce
--   the spot repo rate. For FRA's, this should reproduce the relevant zero
--   rate at the FRA's maturityDate_;
impliedYield :: GenForward f -> Double -> Double -> Day -> Compounding -> DayCounter -> IO InterestRate

-- | Date on which the forward contract settles.
settlementDate :: GenForward f -> IO Day

-- | NPV of income<i>dividends</i>storage-costs etc. of underlying
--   instrument.
spotIncome :: GenForward f -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> IO Double

-- | returns spot value/price of an underlying financial instrument
spotValue :: GenForward f -> IO Double

-- | Returns the relevant forward rate associated with the FRA term.
forwardRate :: ForwardRateAgreement -> IO InterestRate

-- | The market-implied fair forward rate, computed by the pricing engine.
fairForwardRate :: FxForward -> IO Double

-- | NPV in source currency terms.
npvSourceCurrency :: FxForward -> IO Double

-- | NPV in target currency terms.
npvTargetCurrency :: FxForward -> IO Double

module QuantLib.Instrument.Credit
type CreditDefaultSwap = GenInstrument CCreditDefaultSwap
data ProtectionSide
Buyer :: ProtectionSide
Seller :: ProtectionSide
data Claim
FaceValue :: Claim
FaceValueAccrual :: Bond -> Claim

-- | CDS quoted as running-spread only. side Whether the protection is
--   bought or sold. notional Notional value spread Running spread in
--   fractional units. schedule Coupon schedule. paymentConvention
--   Business-day convention for payment-date adjustment. dayCounter
--   Day-count convention for accrual. settlesAccrual Whether or not the
--   accrued coupon is due in the event of a default. paysAtDefaultTime If
--   set to true, any payments triggered by a default event are due at
--   default time. If set to false, they are due at the end of the accrual
--   period. protectionStart The first date where a default event will
--   trigger the contract.
creditDefaultSwap :: ProtectionSide -> Double -> Double -> Schedule -> BusinessDayConvention -> DayCounter -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Claim -> DayCounter -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Word -> IO CreditDefaultSwap

-- | CDS quoted as upfront and running spread. side Whether the protection
--   is bought or sold. notional Notional value upfront Upfront in
--   fractional units. spread Running spread in fractional units. schedule
--   Coupon schedule. paymentConvention Business-day convention for
--   payment-date adjustment. dayCounter Day-count convention for accrual.
--   settlesAccrual Whether or not the accrued coupon is due in the event
--   of a default. paysAtDefaultTime If set to true, any payments triggered
--   by a default event are due at default time. If set to false, they are
--   due at the end of the accrual period. protectionStart The first date
--   where a default event will trigger the contract. upfrontDate
--   Settlement date for the upfront payment.
creditDefaultSwap' :: ProtectionSide -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Schedule -> BusinessDayConvention -> DayCounter -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> Claim -> DayCounter -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Word -> IO CreditDefaultSwap

-- | The fair running spread implied by the underlying CDS's term
--   structures at the option's exercise.
atmRate :: CdsOption -> IO Double

-- | An option giving the right to enter the underlying CDS, buying
--   protection and paying coupon.
cdsOption :: CreditDefaultSwap -> Exercise -> Bool -> IO CdsOption

-- | Volatility that reproduces a given option price under the pricing
--   engine's volatility model.
impliedVolatility :: CdsOption -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> DefaultProbabilityTermStructure -> Double -> Double -> Word -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | The risky annuity used to convert between the option's price and its
--   implied volatility.
riskyAnnuity :: CdsOption -> IO Double

-- | Conventional/standard upfront-to-spread conversion. Under a standard
--   ISDA model and a set of standardised instrument characteristics, it is
--   the running only quoted spread that will make a CDS contract have an
--   NPV of 0 when quoted for that running only spread. Refer to: "ISDA
--   Standard CDS converter specification." May 2009.The conventional
--   recovery rate to apply in the calculation is as specified by ISDA, not
--   necessarily equal to the market-quoted one. It is typically 0.4 for
--   SeniorSec and 0.2 for subordinate.The conversion employs a flat hazard
--   rate. As a result, you will not recover the market quotes.This method
--   performs the calculation with the instrument characteristics. It will
--   coincide with the ISDA calculation if your object has the standard
--   characteristics. Notably: The calendar should have no bank holidays,
--   just weekends.The yield curve should be LIBOR piecewise constant in
--   fwd rates, with a discount factor of 1 on the calculation date, which
--   coincides with the trade date.Convention should be Following for yield
--   curve and contract cashflows.The CDS should pay accrued and mature on
--   standard IMM dates, settle on trade date +1 and upfront settle on
--   trade date +3.
conventionalSpread :: CreditDefaultSwap -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> DayCounter -> PricingModel -> IO Double

-- | Returns the variation of the fixed-leg value given a one-basis-point
--   change in the running spread.
couponLegBPS :: CreditDefaultSwap -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the coupon (premium) leg.
couponLegNPV :: CreditDefaultSwap -> IO Double

-- | The coupon-leg cash flows of the CDS.
coupons :: CreditDefaultSwap -> IO Leg

-- | NPV of the default (protection) leg.
defaultLegNPV :: CreditDefaultSwap -> IO Double

-- | Returns the upfront spread that, given the running spread and the
--   quoted recovery rate, will make the instrument have an NPV of 0.
fairUpfront :: CreditDefaultSwap -> IO Double

-- | Implied hazard rate calculation. This method performs the calculation
--   with the instrument characteristics. It will coincide with the ISDA
--   calculation if your object has the standard characteristics. Notably:
--   The calendar should have no bank holidays, just weekends.The yield
--   curve should be LIBOR piecewise constant in fwd rates, with a discount
--   factor of 1 on the calculation date, which coincides with the trade
--   date.Convention should be Following for yield curve and contract
--   cashflows.The CDS should pay accrued and mature on standard IMM dates,
--   settle on trade date +1 and upfront settle on trade date +3.
impliedHazardRate :: CreditDefaultSwap -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> DayCounter -> Double -> Double -> PricingModel -> IO Double

-- | Returns the variation of the upfront payment value given a
--   one-basis-point change in the upfront.
upfrontBPS :: CreditDefaultSwap -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the upfront payment.
upfrontNPV :: CreditDefaultSwap -> IO Double
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Instrument.Credit.ProtectionSide
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Instrument.Credit.ProtectionSide
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Instrument.Credit.ProtectionSide

module QuantLib.Index.Inflation
type InflationIndex = GenInflationIndex CInflationIndex
type ZeroInflationIndex = GenZeroInflationIndex CZeroInflationIndex
type YoYInflationIndex = GenYoYInflationIndex CYoYInflationIndex
type GenInflationIndex iidx = GenIndex AnyOf CInflationIndex' iidx
type GenZeroInflationIndex zidx = GenInflationIndex AnyOf CZeroInflationIndex' zidx
type GenYoYInflationIndex yidx = GenInflationIndex AnyOf CYoYInflationIndex' yidx
asInflationIndex :: GenInflationIndex iidx -> IO InflationIndex
data ZeroInflationIndexType
AUCPI :: ZeroInflationIndexType
EUHICP :: ZeroInflationIndexType
EUHICPXT :: ZeroInflationIndexType
FRHICP :: ZeroInflationIndexType
UKHICP :: ZeroInflationIndexType
UKRPI :: ZeroInflationIndexType
USCPI :: ZeroInflationIndexType
ZACPI :: ZeroInflationIndexType

-- | A named zero inflation index (RPI<i>HICP</i>CPI family). Constructs
--   with no historical fixings and no linked term structure -- add fixings
--   via <a>addFixing</a>.
zeroInflationIndex :: ZeroInflationIndexType -> IO ZeroInflationIndex

-- | A custom zero inflation index (arbitrary family
--   name<i>region</i>currency), with no historical fixings -- add fixings
--   via <a>addFixing</a>.
zeroInflationIndex' :: String -> Region -> Bool -> Frequency -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Currency -> Maybe ZeroInflationTermStructure -> IO ZeroInflationIndex
data YoYInflationIndexType
YYAUCPI :: YoYInflationIndexType
YYEUHICP :: YoYInflationIndexType
YYEUHICPXT :: YoYInflationIndexType
YYFRHICP :: YoYInflationIndexType
YYUKRPI :: YoYInflationIndexType
YYUSCPI :: YoYInflationIndexType
YYZACPI :: YoYInflationIndexType

-- | A named quoted year-on-year inflation index.
yoyInflationIndex :: YoYInflationIndexType -> IO YoYInflationIndex

-- | A custom quoted year-on-year inflation index (arbitrary family
--   name<i>region</i>currency); needs its own past fixings added via
--   <a>addFixing</a>. See <a>yoyInflationIndexFromZero</a> for a YoY index
--   defined instead as a ratio of an existing <a>ZeroInflationIndex</a>'s
--   fixings.
yoyInflationIndex' :: String -> Region -> Bool -> Frequency -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Currency -> Maybe YoYInflationTermStructure -> IO YoYInflationIndex

-- | A year-on-year index defined as the ratio of an existing
--   <a>ZeroInflationIndex</a>'s fixings; stores no fixings of its own.
yoyInflationIndexFromZero :: ZeroInflationIndex -> Maybe YoYInflationTermStructure -> IO YoYInflationIndex
data Region
data RegionType
AustraliaRegion :: RegionType
EURegion :: RegionType
FranceRegion :: RegionType
UKRegion :: RegionType
USRegion :: RegionType
ZARegion :: RegionType

-- | One of the 6 named geographical/economic regions QuantLib ships (used
--   for the pre-baked named indices, e.g. <a>UKRPI</a> uses
--   <a>UKRegion</a> internally). See 'region'' for an arbitrary custom
--   region.
region :: RegionType -> IO Region

-- | An arbitrary custom region, given its name and ISO code.
region' :: String -> String -> IO Region

-- | The (possibly forecast) fixing at the given date; for a date with no
--   linked term structure this returns the stored historical fixing added
--   via <a>addFixing</a>.
fixing :: ZeroInflationIndex -> Day -> IO Double

-- | The (possibly forecast) year-on-year fixing at the given date; for a
--   date with no linked term structure this returns the stored historical
--   fixing added via <a>addFixing</a>.
yoyFixing :: YoYInflationIndex -> Day -> IO Double
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Bounded QuantLib.Index.Inflation.RegionType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Index.Inflation.RegionType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Index.Inflation.YoYInflationIndexType

module QuantLib.Index.Equity
type EquityIndex = GenIndex CEquityIndex

-- | A named equity total-return index, forecasting future fixings from an
--   optional risk-free interest rate curve and dividend curve, and an
--   optional spot <a>Quote</a> -- today's fixing is used when no spot is
--   given. Historical fixings are added via <a>addFixing</a>.
equityIndex :: String -> Calendar -> Currency -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y1) -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y2) -> Maybe (GenQuote q) -> IO EquityIndex

-- | The index currency.
currency :: EquityIndex -> IO Currency

-- | The risk-free interest rate curve used to forecast this index's future
--   fixings.
equityInterestRateCurve :: EquityIndex -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | The dividend curve used to forecast this index's future fixings.
equityDividendCurve :: EquityIndex -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | The index's spot quote; when empty, forecasting falls back to today's
--   fixing.
spot :: EquityIndex -> IO Quote

module QuantLib.Index

-- | <pre>
--   Index
--    InterestRateIndex
--      BMAIndex
--      IborIndex
--        OvernightIborIndex (COvernightIndex')
--      SwapIndex
--        OvernightIndexedSwapIndex
--    InflationIndex
--      YoYInflationIndex
--      ZeroInflationIndex
--    EquityIndex
--   </pre>
type Index = GenIndex CIndex
data GenIndex idx

-- | stores the historical fixing at the given date; the date must be the
--   actual calendar date of the fixing, not a settlement date
addFixing :: GenIndex idx -> Day -> Double -> Bool -> IO ()

-- | returns the calendar defining valid fixing dates
fixingCalendar :: GenIndex idx -> IO Calendar

-- | returns the fixing at the given date, forecasting it if not available
--   and <i>forecastTodaysFixing</i> is true
fixing :: GenIndex idx -> Day -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | whether a historical fixing has been stored for the given date
hasHistoricalFixing :: GenIndex idx -> Day -> IO Bool

-- | whether the given date is a valid fixing date for this index
isValidFixingDate :: GenIndex idx -> Day -> IO Bool

-- | stores historical fixings at the given dates; the date and value lists
--   must have equal length
addFixings :: GenIndex idx -> [Day] -> [Double] -> Bool -> IO ()

-- | clears all stored historical fixings for this index
clearFixings :: GenIndex idx -> IO ()
asIndex :: GenIndex idx -> IO Index
