UAH :: Ccy
USD :: Ccy
VEB :: Ccy
VND :: Ccy
XRP :: Ccy
ZAR :: Ccy
ZEC :: Ccy
AED :: Ccy
AOA :: Ccy
BGN :: Ccy
BHD :: Ccy
BWP :: Ccy
CLF :: Ccy
CNH :: Ccy
COU :: Ccy
EGP :: Ccy
ETB :: Ccy
GEL :: Ccy
GHS :: Ccy
HRK :: Ccy
JOD :: Ccy
KES :: Ccy
LKR :: Ccy
MAD :: Ccy
MKD :: Ccy
MUR :: Ccy
MXV :: Ccy
OMR :: Ccy
PHP :: Ccy
QAR :: Ccy
RSD :: Ccy
TND :: Ccy
UGX :: Ccy
UYU :: Ccy
UZS :: Ccy
XOF :: Ccy
ZMW :: Ccy
data Currency

-- | Look up one of the built-in ISO 4217 currencies by its enum tag.
currency :: Ccy -> IO Currency

-- | Construct a custom currency from its name, codes, symbols, rounding
--   convention and an optional triangulation currency used for indirect
--   exchange.
currency' :: String -> String -> Int -> String -> String -> Int -> Maybe Rounding -> Maybe Currency -> IO Currency

-- | The currency's ISO 4217 three-letter code, e.g. "USD".
code :: Currency -> String

-- | The number of fractional units (e.g. cents) in one unit of the
--   currency.
fractionsPerUnit :: Currency -> Int

-- | The currency's fractional-unit symbol, e.g. "¢".
fractionSymbol :: Currency -> String

-- | The currency's ISO 4217 numeric code, e.g. 840 for USD.
code' :: Currency -> Int

-- | The currency's symbol, e.g. "$".
symbol :: Currency -> String
data ExchangeRate

-- | Construct a Direct exchange rate: a unit of <tt>source</tt> is worth
--   <tt>rate</tt> units of <tt>target</tt>.
exchangeRate :: Currency -> Currency -> Double -> IO ExchangeRate

-- | The rate itself: a unit of the source currency is worth this many
--   units of the target.
rate :: ExchangeRate -> IO Double

-- | Whether the rate was given directly or derived by chaining two other
--   rates.
exchangeRateType :: ExchangeRate -> IO ExchangeRateType

-- | Apply an exchange rate to a cash amount (a <tt>(Double, Currency)</tt>
--   pair, standing in for QuantLib's <tt>Money</tt>), returning the
--   converted amount as a pair in the other currency of the rate. Throws
--   if the given currency is on neither side of the rate.
exchange :: ExchangeRate -> (Double, Currency) -> IO (Double, Currency)

-- | Combine two exchange rates sharing a common currency into a derived
--   rate between their other two currencies. Throws if the rates don't
--   share a common currency.
chainExchangeRate :: ExchangeRate -> ExchangeRate -> IO ExchangeRate

-- | Register an exchange rate with the global exchange-rate repository,
--   valid between the given dates (inclusive). Use
--   <a>minDate</a>/<a>maxDate</a> for an always-valid rate.
addExchangeRate :: ExchangeRate -> Day -> Day -> IO ()

-- | Look up a (possibly derived) exchange rate between two currencies at a
--   given date (or the current evaluation date if <a>Nothing</a>). Throws
--   if no rate can be found. Pre-populated with a set of known historical
--   rates even before any <a>addExchangeRate</a> call.
lookupExchangeRate :: Currency -> Currency -> Maybe Day -> ExchangeRateType -> IO ExchangeRate

-- | Reset the exchange-rate repository back to its built-in set of known
--   historical rates, discarding anything added via
--   <a>addExchangeRate</a>.
clearExchangeRates :: IO ()

-- | The global <tt>Money</tt> arithmetic setting controlling how amounts
--   in different currencies are combined (no conversion, convert to the
--   base currency, or convert automatically).
moneyConversionType :: IO MoneyConversionType

-- | Set the global <tt>Money</tt> arithmetic conversion setting.
setMoneyConversionType :: MoneyConversionType -> IO ()

-- | The global base currency used by <a>MoneyConversionType</a>
--   base-currency conversion, if set.
moneyBaseCurrency :: IO (Maybe Currency)

-- | Set the global base currency used by <a>MoneyConversionType</a>
--   base-currency conversion.
setMoneyBaseCurrency :: Currency -> IO ()

-- | Convert a cash amount to the configured base currency (via
--   <a>setMoneyBaseCurrency</a>), using <a>lookupExchangeRate</a> and
--   rounding the result per the target currency's convention. Throws if no
--   base currency is set or no rate path exists.
convertToBaseCurrency :: (Double, Currency) -> IO (Double, Currency)
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Currency.Ccy
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Currency.ExchangeRateType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Currency.MoneyConversionType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Currency.Ccy
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Currency.ExchangeRateType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Currency.MoneyConversionType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Currency.Ccy
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Currency.ExchangeRateType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Currency.MoneyConversionType

module QuantLib.CashFlow
type Leg = GenLeg CLeg
type CouponLeg = GenLeg CCouponLeg
asLeg :: GenLeg l -> IO Leg
data Dividend
data DurationType
Simple :: DurationType
Macaulay :: DurationType
Modified :: DurationType
data RateAveragingType
AveragingSimple :: RateAveragingType
AveragingCompound :: RateAveragingType
data TimingAdjustment
Black76 :: TimingAdjustment
BivariateLognormal :: TimingAdjustment
data CPIInterpolationType
CPIFlat :: CPIInterpolationType
CPILinear :: CPIInterpolationType
data GenLeg l
leg :: [(Day, Double)] -> IO Leg

-- | Returns the start (i.e. first accrual) date for the given Leg
startDate :: GenLeg l -> IO Day

-- | return cashflows that will occur after <i>settlementDate</i>
nextCashFlows :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Leg

-- | return cashflows that occurred before <i>settlementDate</i>
previousCashFlows :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Leg

-- | return cash flows together with an indicator whether they occurred as
--   of <i>settlementDate</i>
cashFlows :: Leg -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO [(Day, Double, Bool)]

-- | Cash-flow duration. The simple duration of a string of cash flows is
--   defined as &lt;math&gt; where $ c_i $ is the amount of the $ i $-th
--   cash flow, $ t_i $ is its payment time, and $ B(t_i) $ is the
--   corresponding discount according to the passed yield.The modified
--   duration is defined as &lt;math&gt; where $ P $ is the present value
--   of the cash flows according to the given IRR $ y $.The Macaulay
--   duration is defined for a compounded IRR as &lt;math&gt; where $ y $
--   is the IRR and $ N $ is the number of cash flows per year.
duration :: GenLeg l -> InterestRate -> DurationType -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Number of days in the accrual period of the coupon paying on
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
accrualDays :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Int

-- | End of the accrual period of the coupon paying on
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
accrualEndDate :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Length, in years, of the accrual period of the coupon paying on
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
accrualPeriod :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Start of the accrual period of the coupon paying on
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
accrualStartDate :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Accrued amount of the coupon paying on <i>settlementDate</i>.
accruedAmount :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Number of days accrued so far on the coupon paying on
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
accruedDays :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Int

-- | Fraction of the accrual period elapsed, as of <i>settlementDate</i>,
--   for the coupon paying then.
accruedPeriod :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | At-the-money rate of the cash flows. The result is the fixed rate for
--   which a fixed rate cash flow vector, equivalent to the input vector,
--   has the required NPV according to the given term structure. If the
--   required NPV is not given, the input cash flow vector's NPV is used
--   instead.
atmRate :: GenLeg l -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Basis-point value. Obtained by setting dy = 0.0001 in the 2nd-order
--   Taylor series expansion.
basisPointValue' :: GenLeg l -> InterestRate -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Basis-point value, as <a>basisPointValue'</a> but taking a plain
--   yield/day counter/compounding/frequency instead of an
--   <a>InterestRate</a>.
basisPointValue :: GenLeg l -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Basis-point sensitivity, as <a>bpsFromYield'</a> but taking a plain
--   yield/day counter/compounding/frequency instead of an
--   <a>InterestRate</a>.
bpsFromYield :: GenLeg l -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Basis-point sensitivity of the cash flows. The result is the change in
--   NPV due to a uniform 1-basis-point change in the rate paid by the cash
--   flows. The change for each coupon is discounted according to the given
--   constant interest rate. The result is affected by the choice of the
--   interest-rate compounding and the relative frequency and day counter.
bpsFromYield' :: GenLeg l -> InterestRate -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Basis-point sensitivity of the cash flows. The result is the change in
--   NPV due to a uniform 1-basis-point change in the rate paid by the cash
--   flows. The change for each coupon is discounted according to the given
--   term structure.
bps :: GenLeg l -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Cash-flow convexity. The convexity of a string of cash flows is
--   defined as &lt;math&gt; where $ P $ is the present value of the cash
--   flows according to the given IRR $ y $.
convexity' :: GenLeg l -> InterestRate -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Cash-flow convexity, as <a>convexity'</a> but taking a plain yield/day
--   counter/compounding/frequency instead of an <a>InterestRate</a>.
convexity :: GenLeg l -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Cash-flow duration, as <a>duration</a> but taking a plain yield/day
--   counter/compounding/frequency instead of an <a>InterestRate</a>.
duration' :: GenLeg l -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> DurationType -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Whether every cash flow in the leg has occurred as of
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
isExpired :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Bool

-- | Date of the leg's last cash flow.
maturityDate :: GenLeg l -> IO Day

-- | Amount of the first cash flow paying after <i>settlementDate</i>.
nextCashFlowAmount :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Date of the first cash flow paying after <i>settlementDate</i>.
nextCashFlowDate :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Coupon rate of the next cash flow paying after <i>settlementDate</i>.
nextCouponRate :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Nominal of the coupon paying on <i>settlementDate</i>.
nominal :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the cash flows, as <a>npvFromYield'</a> but taking a plain
--   yield/day counter/compounding/frequency instead of an
--   <a>InterestRate</a>.
npvFromYield :: GenLeg l -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the cash flows. The IRR is the interest rate at which the NPV
--   of the cash flows equals the dirty price.The NPV is the sum of the
--   cash flows, each discounted according to the given constant interest
--   rate. The result is affected by the choice of the interest-rate
--   compounding and the relative frequency and day counter.
npvFromYield' :: GenLeg l -> InterestRate -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the cash flows. For details on z-spread refer to: "Credit
--   Spreads Explained", Lehman Brothers European Fixed Income Research -
--   March 2004, D. O'KaneThe NPV is the sum of the cash flows, each
--   discounted according to the z-spreaded term structure. The result is
--   affected by the choice of the z-spread compounding and the relative
--   frequency and day counter.
npv' :: GenLeg l -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the cash flows. The NPV is the sum of the cash flows, each
--   discounted according to the given term structure.
npv :: GenLeg l -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | NPV and BPS of the cash flows. The NPV and BPS of the cash flows
--   calculated together for performance reason
npvbps :: GenLeg l -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Bool -> Day -> Day -> IO (Double, Double)

-- | Amount of the last cash flow that paid before or at
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
previousCashFlowAmount :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Date of the last cash flow that paid before or at
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
previousCashFlowDate :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Coupon rate of the last cash flow that paid before or at
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
previousCouponRate :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | End of the reference period of the coupon paying on
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
referencePeriodEnd :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Start of the reference period of the coupon paying on
--   <i>settlementDate</i>.
referencePeriodStart :: GenLeg l -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Implied internal rate of return. The function verifies the theoretical
--   existance of an IRR and numerically establishes the IRR to the desired
--   precision.
yield :: GenLeg l -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> Double -> Word -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Yield value of a basis point. The yield value of a one basis point
--   change in price is the derivative of the yield with respect to the
--   price multiplied by 0.01
yieldValueBasisPoint' :: GenLeg l -> InterestRate -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | Yield value of a basis point, as <a>yieldValueBasisPoint'</a> but
--   taking a plain yield/day counter/compounding/frequency instead of an
--   <a>InterestRate</a>.
yieldValueBasisPoint :: GenLeg l -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> IO Double

-- | implied Z-spread.
zSpread :: GenLeg l -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> Double -> Word -> Double -> IO Double

-- | try to downcast leg to a coupon leg don't blame me, it's how QuantLib
--   works
toCouponLeg :: GenLeg l -> IO CouponLeg

-- | start of the accrual periods for a coupon leg
couponAccrualStartDates :: CouponLeg -> IO [Day]

-- | Predetermined cash flow paying a fixed <i>amount</i> at <i>date</i>.
fixedDividend :: Double -> Day -> IO Dividend

-- | Predetermined cash flow paying <i>rate</i> times <i>nominal</i> at
--   <i>date</i>.
fractionalDividend' :: Double -> Double -> Day -> IO Dividend

-- | Predetermined cash flow paying a fractional <i>rate</i> of the
--   underlying's price at <i>date</i>.
fractionalDividend :: Double -> Day -> IO Dividend

-- | Build a leg of average-BMA coupons.
averageBMALeg :: Schedule -> BMAIndex -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> [Double] -> [Double] -> IO Leg

-- | Build a leg of fixed-rate coupons.
fixedRateLeg :: Schedule -> [Double] -> [InterestRate] -> BusinessDayConvention -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> IO Leg

-- | iborLeg keeps its original 12-arg signature -- existing callers are
--   unaffected -- but now delegates to iborLeg_, the raw binding widened
--   to IborLeg's full builder surface, hardcoding upstream's own defaults
--   for the params iborLeg doesn't expose. Use <a>iborLegFull</a> to reach
--   those (payment lag/calendar, ex-coupon period, fixing convention,
--   indexed/at-par coupons) via <a>IborLegOpts</a>.
iborLeg :: Schedule -> GenIborIndex ibor -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> [Word] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Bool -> IO Leg

-- | <a>iborLeg</a> widened to every <tt>IborLeg</tt> builder-method param
--   via <a>IborLegOpts</a>.
iborLegFull :: Schedule -> GenIborIndex ibor -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> [Word] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Bool -> IborLegOpts -> IO Leg
data IborLegOpts
IborLegOpts :: Int -> Maybe Calendar -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Maybe Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> BusinessDayConvention -> Maybe Bool -> IborLegOpts
[ilgPaymentLag] :: IborLegOpts -> Int
[ilgPaymentCalendar] :: IborLegOpts -> Maybe Calendar
[ilgExCouponPeriod] :: IborLegOpts -> (Int, TimeUnit)
[ilgExCouponCalendar] :: IborLegOpts -> Maybe Calendar
[ilgExCouponConvention] :: IborLegOpts -> BusinessDayConvention
[ilgExCouponEndOfMonth] :: IborLegOpts -> Bool
[ilgFixingConvention] :: IborLegOpts -> BusinessDayConvention
[ilgUseIndexedCoupons] :: IborLegOpts -> Maybe Bool
defaultIborLegOpts :: IborLegOpts

-- | CMS leg builder (analog of <a>iborLeg</a>), 12-arg core shape -- same
--   defaults-hardcoding pattern as <a>iborLeg</a> for the params not in
--   this signature. Use <a>cmsLegFull</a> to reach them
--   (<a>CmsLegOpts</a>).
cmsLeg :: Schedule -> GenSwapIndex sidx -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> [Word] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Bool -> IO Leg

-- | <a>cmsLeg</a> widened to every <tt>CmsLeg</tt> builder-method param
--   via <a>CmsLegOpts</a>.
cmsLegFull :: Schedule -> GenSwapIndex sidx -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> [Word] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Bool -> CmsLegOpts -> IO Leg
data CmsLegOpts
CmsLegOpts :: (Int, TimeUnit) -> Maybe Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> BusinessDayConvention -> CmsLegOpts
[cmslExCouponPeriod] :: CmsLegOpts -> (Int, TimeUnit)
[cmslExCouponCalendar] :: CmsLegOpts -> Maybe Calendar
[cmslExCouponConvention] :: CmsLegOpts -> BusinessDayConvention
[cmslExCouponEndOfMonth] :: CmsLegOpts -> Bool
[cmslFixingConvention] :: CmsLegOpts -> BusinessDayConvention
defaultCmsLegOpts :: CmsLegOpts

-- | Build a leg of overnight-index coupons.
overnightLeg :: Schedule -> OvernightIborIndex -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> [Double] -> [Double] -> IO Leg

-- | Build a leg of range-accrual floating-rate coupons.
rangeAccrualLeg :: Schedule -> GenIborIndex ibor -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> [Word] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> BusinessDayConvention -> IO Leg

-- | Fixed-rate coupons scaled by the ratio of a <a>ZeroInflationIndex</a>
--   fixing to <i>baseCPI</i> (a <tt>CPICoupon</tt> leg -- caps/floors are
--   not exposed, see README.md's TODO).
cpiLeg :: Schedule -> ZeroInflationIndex -> Double -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> [Double] -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Calendar -> CPIInterpolationType -> Bool -> IO Leg

-- | Year-on-year inflation-linked coupons (a <tt>YoYInflationCoupon</tt>
--   leg -- caps/floors are not exposed, see README.md's TODO).
yoyInflationLeg :: Schedule -> Calendar -> YoYInflationIndex -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> CPIInterpolationType -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> [Word] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> IO Leg
data ZeroInflationCashFlow

-- | Cash flow dependent on a <a>ZeroInflationIndex</a> ratio (not a coupon
--   -- no accruals). The ratio is taken between fixings observed at
--   <i>startDate</i> and <i>endDate</i> minus <i>observationLag</i>.
zeroInflationCashFlow :: Double -> ZeroInflationIndex -> CPIInterpolationType -> Day -> Day -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Day -> Bool -> IO ZeroInflationCashFlow

-- | Amount of the cash flow: the index ratio (times notional), or the
--   ratio minus one if growthOnly.
zeroInflationCashFlowAmount :: ZeroInflationCashFlow -> IO Double

-- | Fixing used as the base of the ratio (as of <i>startDate</i>, lagged).
zeroInflationCashFlowBaseFixing :: ZeroInflationCashFlow -> IO Double

-- | Fixing used as the numerator of the ratio (as of <i>endDate</i>,
--   lagged).
zeroInflationCashFlowIndexFixing :: ZeroInflationCashFlow -> IO Double
data CPICashFlow

-- | CPI-linked cash flow (not a coupon -- no accruals), with an optional
--   explicit <i>baseFixing</i> (pass <a>Nothing</a> to derive it from
--   <i>baseDate</i> instead).
cpiCashFlow :: Double -> ZeroInflationIndex -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Double -> Day -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> CPIInterpolationType -> Day -> Bool -> IO CPICashFlow

-- | Amount of the cash flow: the index ratio (times notional), or the
--   ratio minus one if growthOnly.
cpiCashFlowAmount :: CPICashFlow -> IO Double

-- | Fixing used as the base of the ratio: the explicit <i>baseFixing</i>
--   if given at construction, else derived from <i>baseDate</i>.
cpiCashFlowBaseFixing :: CPICashFlow -> IO Double

-- | Fixing used as the numerator of the ratio (as of
--   <i>observationDate</i>, lagged).
cpiCashFlowIndexFixing :: CPICashFlow -> IO Double
data EquityCashFlow

-- | Cash flow dependent on the total return of an <a>EquityIndex</a> (not
--   a coupon -- no accruals): <tt>index(fixingDate)/index(baseDate)</tt>,
--   or that ratio minus one if <i>growthOnly</i>. If no
--   <a>EquityCashFlowPricer</a> is attached via
--   <a>setEquityCashFlowPricer</a>, <a>equityCashFlowAmount</a> computes
--   this ratio directly from the index; a pricer (e.g.
--   <a>equityQuantoCashFlowPricer</a>) is only needed to price a
--   quanto-adjusted variant.
equityCashFlow :: Double -> EquityIndex -> Day -> Day -> Day -> Bool -> IO EquityCashFlow

-- | Amount of the cash flow: the index ratio (times notional), or the
--   ratio minus one if growthOnly -- or, if a pricer is attached, the
--   notional times the pricer's <tt>price</tt>.
equityCashFlowAmount :: EquityCashFlow -> IO Double

-- | Fixing used as the base of the ratio (as of <i>baseDate</i>).
equityCashFlowBaseFixing :: EquityCashFlow -> IO Double

-- | Fixing used as the numerator of the ratio (as of <i>fixingDate</i>).
equityCashFlowIndexFixing :: EquityCashFlow -> IO Double

-- | Attach a pricer (e.g. from <a>equityQuantoCashFlowPricer</a>) to a
--   single <a>EquityCashFlow</a>; see <a>setEquityLegPricer</a> to attach
--   one to every <a>EquityCashFlow</a> in a leg instead.
setEquityCashFlowPricer :: EquityCashFlow -> EquityCashFlowPricer -> IO ()
data YieldCurveModel
Standard :: YieldCurveModel
ExactYield :: YieldCurveModel
ParallelShifts :: YieldCurveModel
NonParallelShifts :: YieldCurveModel
data FloatingRateCouponPricer

-- | Black-formula pricer for capped/floored Ibor coupons
blackIborCouponPricer :: GenOptionletVolatilityStructure ov -> TimingAdjustment -> Maybe (GenQuote q) -> Maybe Bool -> IO FloatingRateCouponPricer

-- | BGM-based pricer for <tt>RangeAccrualFloatersCoupon</tt>s (a
--   <a>rangeAccrualLeg</a>)
rangeAccrualPricerByBgm :: Double -> SmileSection -> SmileSection -> Bool -> Bool -> IO FloatingRateCouponPricer

-- | Set the pricer of every floating-rate coupon in <i>leg</i>.
setCouponPricer :: GenLeg l -> FloatingRateCouponPricer -> IO ()

-- | Set the pricer of every floating-rate coupon in <i>leg</i>, picking
--   each coupon's pricer from <i>pricers</i> by matching coupon type.
setCouponPricers :: GenLeg l -> [FloatingRateCouponPricer] -> IO ()

-- | CMS-coupon pricer via static replication (Hagan's "Conundrums..."),
--   using an analytic closed-form approximation of the replication
--   integrals.
analyticHaganPricer :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> YieldCurveModel -> GenQuote q -> IO FloatingRateCouponPricer

-- | CMS-coupon pricer via static replication (Hagan's "Conundrums..."),
--   evaluating the replication integrals by numerical integration over
--   vanilla swaption prices.
numericHaganPricer :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> YieldCurveModel -> GenQuote q -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO FloatingRateCouponPricer

-- | The strategy <tt>LinearTsrPricer</tt> uses to pick the integration
--   cut-off strike bounds; each carries the strategy-specific parameter
--   upstream's corresponding <tt>Settings::withX</tt> takes
--   (<a>LinearTsrRateBound</a> has none). Pass explicit bounds via
--   <tt>LinearTsrPricerSettings'</tt> <i>ltsrBounds</i> rather than baking
--   upstream's own default bounds in here, since upstream's
--   no-explicit-bounds overloads aren't just sugar for those same numbers
--   -- they also flip <tt>Settings::defaultBounds_</tt>, which under a
--   normal-vol swaption surface adjusts the lower bound to
--   <tt>min(-upperBound, lowerBound)</tt> (see
--   <tt>ql<i>cashflows</i>lineartsrpricer.cpp</tt>). Passing
--   <a>Nothing</a> reaches that adjustment; passing explicit bounds via
--   <a>Just</a> does not.
data LinearTsrPricerStrategy
LinearTsrRateBound :: LinearTsrPricerStrategy

-- | vegaRatio
LinearTsrVegaRatio :: Double -> LinearTsrPricerStrategy

-- | priceThreshold
LinearTsrPriceThreshold :: Double -> LinearTsrPricerStrategy

-- | stdDevs
LinearTsrBSStdDevs :: Double -> LinearTsrPricerStrategy

-- | <a>ltsrBounds</a> of <a>Nothing</a> uses upstream's own default
--   lower/upper rate bounds (and, for a normal-vol surface, its
--   default-bounds strike adjustment -- see
--   <a>LinearTsrPricerStrategy</a>); <tt><a>Just</a> (lower, upper)</tt>
--   pins explicit bounds instead.
data LinearTsrPricerSettings
LinearTsrPricerSettings :: LinearTsrPricerStrategy -> Maybe (Double, Double) -> LinearTsrPricerSettings
[ltsrStrategy] :: LinearTsrPricerSettings -> LinearTsrPricerStrategy
[ltsrBounds] :: LinearTsrPricerSettings -> Maybe (Double, Double)

-- | CMS-coupon pricer using a linear terminal swap rate model
--   (Andersen/Piterbarg 16.3.2). <i>couponDiscountCurve</i> of
--   <a>Nothing</a> uses the coupon's own discount curve, matching
--   upstream's default empty <tt>Handle</tt>. The upstream constructor's
--   trailing <i>integrator</i> parameter (an advanced
--   numerical-integration override) is not exposed; upstream's own default
--   (<tt>ext::shared_ptr&lt;Integrator&gt;()</tt>) is always used.
linearTsrPricer :: GenSwaptionVolatilityStructure sv -> GenQuote q -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> LinearTsrPricerSettings -> IO FloatingRateCouponPricer
data EquityCashFlowPricer

-- | Quanto-adjusted pricer for an <a>EquityCashFlow</a> whose equity leg
--   is denominated in a currency other than the swap's payment currency.
equityQuantoCashFlowPricer :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv1 -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv2 -> GenQuote q -> IO EquityCashFlowPricer

-- | Attach a pricer to every <a>EquityCashFlow</a> found in <i>leg</i>
--   (non-<a>EquityCashFlow</a> entries are left untouched); see
--   <a>setEquityCashFlowPricer</a> to attach one to a single cash flow
--   instead.
setEquityLegPricer :: GenLeg l -> EquityCashFlowPricer -> IO ()
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.CashFlow.DurationType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.CashFlow.RateAveragingType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.CashFlow.TimingAdjustment
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.CashFlow.YieldCurveModel
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.CashFlow.DurationType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.CashFlow.LinearTsrPricerSettings
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.CashFlow.LinearTsrPricerStrategy
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.CashFlow.RateAveragingType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.CashFlow.TimingAdjustment
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.CashFlow.YieldCurveModel
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.CashFlow.DurationType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.CashFlow.LinearTsrPricerSettings
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.CashFlow.LinearTsrPricerStrategy
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.CashFlow.RateAveragingType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.CashFlow.TimingAdjustment
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.CashFlow.YieldCurveModel

module QuantLib.Model
data CalibrationErrorType
RelativePriceError :: CalibrationErrorType
PriceError :: CalibrationErrorType
ImpliedVolError :: CalibrationErrorType
type GJRGARCHModel = GenCalibratedModel CGJRGARCHModel
type HestonModel = GenHestonModel CHestonModel
type GenHestonModel hm = GenCalibratedModel AnyOf CHestonModel' hm
type BatesModel = GenBatesModel CBatesModel
type GenBatesModel bm = GenHestonModel AnyOf CBatesModel' bm
type PiecewiseTimeDependentHestonModel = GenCalibratedModel CPiecewiseTimeDependentHestonModel
type ShortRateModel = GenShortRateModel CShortRateModel
type GenShortRateModel sm = GenCalibratedModel AnyOf CShortRateModel' sm
data AffineModel
HullWhite :: HullWhite -> AffineModel
G2 :: G2 -> AffineModel
OneFactorAffineModel :: OneFactorAffineModel -> AffineModel
LiborForwardModel :: LiborForwardModel -> AffineModel
data Gaussian1dModel
Gsr :: Gsr -> Gaussian1dModel
MarkovFunctional :: MarkovFunctional -> Gaussian1dModel
type OneFactorAffineModel = GenOneFactorAffineModel COneFactorAffineModel
type GenOneFactorAffineModel om = GenShortRateModel AnyOf COneFactorAffineModel' om
type LiborForwardModel = GenCalibratedModel CLiborForwardModel
type HullWhite = GenOneFactorAffineModel CHullWhite
type Gsr = GenCalibratedModel CGsr
type MarkovFunctional = GenCalibratedModel CMarkovFunctional

-- | <pre>
--   CalibratedModel
--    LiborForwardModel + AffineModel
--    GJRGARCHModel
--    PiecewiseTimeDependentHestonModel
--    HestonModel
--      BatesModel
--        BatesDetJumpModel
--      BatesDoubleExpModel
--        BatesDoubleExpDetJumpModel
--    ShortRateModel
--      G2 + AffineModel
--      OneFactorAffineModel + AffineModel
--        HullWhite + AffineModel
--    Gsr + Gaussian1dModel
--    MarkovFunctional + Gaussian1dModel
--   </pre>
type CalibratedModel = GenCalibratedModel CCalibratedModel
data GenCalibratedModel m
type G2 = GenShortRateModel CG2
type BatesDetJumpModel = GenBatesModel CBatesDetJumpModel
type BatesDoubleExpDetJumpModel = GenBatesDoubleExpModel CBatesDoubleExpDetJumpModel
type BatesDoubleExpModel = GenBatesDoubleExpModel CBatesDoubleExpModel
type GenBatesDoubleExpModel bdem = GenHestonModel AnyOf CBatesDoubleExpModel' bdem
data LmCorrelationModel
ConstWrapperCorrelation :: LmCorrelationModel -> LmCorrelationModel
ExponentialCorrelation :: Word -> !Double -> LmCorrelationModel
LinearExponentialCorrelation :: Word -> !Double -> !Double -> !Word -> LmCorrelationModel
data LmVolatilityModel
ConstWrapperVolatility :: LmVolatilityModel -> LmVolatilityModel
FixedVolatility :: ![Double] -> ![Double] -> LmVolatilityModel
LinearExponentialVolatility :: ![Double] -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> !Double -> LmVolatilityModel

-- | <pre>
--   CalibrationHelper
--     BlackCalibrationHelper
--   </pre>
type CalibrationHelper = GenCalibrationHelper CCalibrationHelper
type BlackCalibrationHelper = GenCalibrationHelper CBlackCalibrationHelper
data GenCalibrationHelper ch
asCalibrationHelper :: GenCalibrationHelper ch -> IO CalibrationHelper
asCalibratedModel :: GenCalibratedModel m -> IO CalibratedModel
asHestonModel :: GenHestonModel hm -> IO HestonModel
asShortRateModel :: GenShortRateModel sm -> IO ShortRateModel
asOneFactorAffineModel :: GenOneFactorAffineModel om -> IO OneFactorAffineModel
asBatesModel :: GenBatesModel bm -> IO BatesModel
asBatesDoubleExpModel :: GenBatesDoubleExpModel bdem -> IO BatesDoubleExpModel

-- | Bates stochastic-volatility model: extends Heston with jumps in the
--   underlying's return process.
batesModel :: BatesProcess -> IO BatesModel

-- | Black-Karasinski short-rate model: d(ln r) = (theta(t) - a ln r) dt +
--   sigma dW, with constant reversion <tt>a</tt> and volatility
--   <tt>sigma</tt>.
blackKarasinski :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Double -> IO ShortRateModel

-- | Cox-Ingersoll-Ross short-rate model: dr = k(theta - r) dt + sigma
--   sqrt(r) dW.
coxIngersollRoss :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO OneFactorAffineModel

-- | Extended CIR model: adds a deterministic term-structure-fitting shift
--   to a standard Cox-Ingersoll-Ross process.
extendedCoxIngersollRoss :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> IO OneFactorAffineModel

-- | Two-additive-factor Gaussian (G2) short-rate model: the sum of two
--   correlated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck factors.
g2 :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO G2

-- | Generalized Hull-White model: like <a>hullWhite</a>, but reversion and
--   volatility are piecewise-linear functions of time given at
--   <tt>speedstructure</tt>/<tt>volstructure</tt> dates.
generalizedHullWhite :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> [(Day, Double)] -> [(Day, Double)] -> IO ShortRateModel

-- | GJR-GARCH stochastic-volatility model, extending GARCH(1,1) with an
--   asymmetric response to negative return shocks.
gJRGARCHModel :: GJRGARCHProcess -> IO GJRGARCHModel

-- | Heston stochastic-volatility model, calibrated from a
--   <a>HestonProcess</a>.
hestonModel :: GenHestonProcess hp -> IO HestonModel

-- | Single-factor Hull-White (extended Vasicek) short-rate model: dr =
--   (theta(t) - a r) dt + sigma dW, fitted to the given term structure.
hullWhite :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Double -> IO HullWhite

-- | Variance Gamma model for the underlying's log-return process
--   (Madan-Carr-Chang).
varianceGammaModel :: VarianceGammaProcess -> IO CalibratedModel

-- | Vasicek short-rate model: dr = a(b - r) dt + sigma dW, with an
--   optional risk premium <tt>lambda</tt>.
vasicek :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO OneFactorAffineModel

-- | Libor market (BGM) forward-rate model, built from a
--   <a>LiborForwardModelProcess</a> plus volatility and correlation
--   models.
liborForwardModel :: LiborForwardModelProcess -> LmVolatilityModel -> LmCorrelationModel -> IO LiborForwardModel

-- | One-factor GSR model (formulated in the forward measure), with
--   piecewise-constant volatility steps at <tt>volstepdates</tt> and a
--   single constant reversion.
gsr :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> [Day] -> [GenQuote q1] -> GenQuote q2 -> Double -> IO Gsr

-- | Markov-functional interest-rate model, calibrated to a swaption
--   volatility cube against <tt>swapIndexBase</tt>.
markovFunctional :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> [Day] -> [Double] -> SwaptionVolatilityStructure -> [Day] -> [(Word, TimeUnit)] -> GenSwapIndex sidx -> Word -> IO MarkovFunctional

-- | Calibrate to a set of market instruments (caps/swaptions) An
--   additional constraint can be passed which must be satisfied in
--   addition to the constraints of the model.
calibrate :: GenCalibratedModel m -> [(GenCalibrationHelper ch, Double)] -> OptimizationMethod -> EndCriteria -> Maybe Constraint -> [Bool] -> IO ()

-- | Iteratively calibrates the volatility step values, one at a time, to
--   the given helpers (assumed to have step dates matching the model's
--   volatility step dates).
calibrateVolatilitiesIterative :: Gsr -> [BlackCalibrationHelper] -> OptimizationMethod -> EndCriteria -> Maybe Constraint -> [Double] -> IO ()

-- | Calibration helper for an at-the-money interest-rate cap.
capHelper :: (Word, TimeUnit) -> GenQuote q -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Frequency -> DayCounter -> Bool -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> CalibrationErrorType -> VolatilityType -> Double -> IO BlackCalibrationHelper

-- | Calibration helper for the Heston model, from a European option's
--   market volatility.
hestonModelHelper :: (Word, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> GenQuote q1 -> Double -> GenQuote q2 -> GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> CalibrationErrorType -> IO BlackCalibrationHelper

-- | Calibration helper for a European swaption, with the exercise given as
--   a maturity <tt>Period</tt> from today.
swaptionHelper :: (Word, TimeUnit) -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> GenQuote q -> GenIborIndex ibor -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> DayCounter -> DayCounter -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> CalibrationErrorType -> Maybe Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> Double -> Maybe Word -> RateAveragingType -> IO BlackCalibrationHelper

-- | Like <a>swaptionHelper</a>, but the option's exercise is given as an
--   explicit date rather than a maturity <tt>Period</tt>.
swaptionHelperFromDate :: Day -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> GenQuote q -> GenIborIndex ibor -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> DayCounter -> DayCounter -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> CalibrationErrorType -> Maybe Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> Double -> Maybe Word -> RateAveragingType -> IO BlackCalibrationHelper

-- | Like <a>swaptionHelper</a>, but both the option's exercise and the
--   underlying swap's end are given as explicit dates.
swaptionHelperFromDates :: Day -> Day -> GenQuote q -> GenIborIndex ibor -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> DayCounter -> DayCounter -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> CalibrationErrorType -> Maybe Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> Double -> Maybe Word -> RateAveragingType -> IO BlackCalibrationHelper

-- | Times relevant to pricing this calibration helper's instrument, to be
--   added to the model's evolution time grid.
times :: BlackCalibrationHelper -> IO [Double]

-- | Price of a discount bond paying 1 at <tt>maturity</tt>, given the
--   short rate <tt>rate</tt> at time <tt>now</tt>. Not <a>pure</a>: the
--   model's short-rate fitting function depends on its
--   <a>YieldTermStructure</a> handle, which can be relinked after
--   construction, so the result at fixed arguments can change between two
--   calls -- a genuine <a>IO</a> action, not a value fixed at construction
--   time like the other <tt>{#fun pure ...#}</tt> bindings in this
--   codebase.
discountBond :: GenOneFactorAffineModel om -> Double -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | Futures convexity bias (difference between futures implied rate and
--   forward rate), per G. Kirikos, D. Novak, "Convexity Conundrums", Risk
--   Magazine, March 1997. <tt>t</tt>/<tt>T</tt> are in yearfraction using
--   the deposit day counter, <tt>futurePrice</tt> is the futures' market
--   price.
convexityBias :: Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double -> Double

-- | Marks the reversion (<tt>a</tt>) fixed and volatility (<tt>sigma</tt>)
--   free for <tt>calibrate'</tt>s <tt>fixParameters</tt> argument. Mirrors
--   <tt>HullWhite::FixedReversion()</tt>.
fixedReversion :: [Bool]

-- | Volatility step values, as calibrated so far.
gsrVolatility :: Gsr -> IO [Double]

-- | Volatility step values, as calibrated so far.
markovFunctionalVolatility :: MarkovFunctional -> IO [Double]

-- | Returns array of arguments on which calibration is done.
params :: GenCalibratedModel m -> IO [Double]

-- | Objective function value at <tt>params</tt> for the given calibration
--   instruments.
value :: GenCalibratedModel m -> [Double] -> [GenCalibrationHelper ch] -> IO Double

-- | Black price given a volatility.
blackPrice :: BlackCalibrationHelper -> Double -> IO Double

-- | returns the error resulting from the model valuation
calibrationError :: BlackCalibrationHelper -> IO Double

-- | Black volatility implied by the model.
impliedVolatility :: BlackCalibrationHelper -> Double -> Double -> Word -> Double -> Double -> IO Double

-- | returns the actual price of the instrument (from volatility)
marketValue :: BlackCalibrationHelper -> IO Double

-- | returns the price of the instrument according to the model
modelValue :: BlackCalibrationHelper -> IO Double

-- | Sets the pricing engine used to compute this calibration helper's
--   model value.
setPricingEngine :: BlackCalibrationHelper -> PricingEngine -> IO ()
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Model.CalibrationErrorType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Model.CalibrationErrorType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Model.CalibrationErrorType

module QuantLib.Instrument.Bond
type Bond = GenBond CBond
type FixedRateBond = GenBond CFixedRateBond
type ConvertibleBond = GenBond CConvertibleBond
type CallableBond = GenBond CCallableBond
type CPIBond = GenBond CCPIBond
asBond :: GenBond b -> IO Bond
data BondPriceType
Dirty :: BondPriceType
Clean :: BondPriceType
data CPIInterpolationType
CPIFlat :: CPIInterpolationType
CPILinear :: CPIInterpolationType

-- | constructor for amortizing or non-amortizing bonds. Redemptions and
--   maturity are calculated from the coupon data, if available. Therefore,
--   redemptions must not be included in the passed cash flows.
bond :: Word -> Calendar -> Maybe Day -> GenLeg l -> IO Bond

-- | old constructor for non amortizing bonds. <i>Warning</i> The last
--   passed cash flow must be the bond redemption. No other cash flow can
--   have a date later than the redemption date.
bond' :: Word -> Calendar -> Double -> Maybe Day -> Maybe Day -> GenLeg l -> IO Bond

-- | generic compounding and frequency InterestRate coupons
fixedRateBond :: Word -> Double -> Schedule -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Double -> Maybe Day -> Calendar -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> DayCounter -> IO FixedRateBond

-- | zero-coupon bond
zeroCouponBond :: Word -> Calendar -> Double -> Day -> BusinessDayConvention -> Double -> Maybe Day -> IO Bond

-- | floating-rate bond (possibly capped and/or floored)
floatingRateBond :: Word -> Double -> Schedule -> GenIborIndex ibor -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Word -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Double -> Maybe Day -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> BusinessDayConvention -> IO Bond

-- | CMS-rate bond
cmsRateBond :: Word -> Double -> Schedule -> GenSwapIndex sidx -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Word -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Double -> Maybe Day -> IO Bond

-- | An inflation-linked bond whose redemption and coupons scale with a
--   <a>ZeroInflationIndex</a> fixing relative to <i>baseCPI</i>.
cpiBond :: Word -> Double -> Double -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> ZeroInflationIndex -> CPIInterpolationType -> Schedule -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Maybe Day -> Calendar -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> IO CPIBond

-- | amortizing fixed-rate bond: like <a>fixedRateBond</a> but with a
--   per-period notional schedule instead of a single face amount (see
--   <a>sinkingSchedule</a>/<a>sinkingNotionals</a> for building one).
amortizingFixedRateBond :: Word -> [Double] -> Schedule -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Maybe Day -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> [Double] -> Int -> IO Bond

-- | amortizing CMS-rate bond (possibly capped and/or floored) with a
--   per-period notional schedule instead of a single face amount, and a
--   per-period redemption schedule instead of a single redemption value.
amortizingCmsRateBond :: Word -> [Double] -> Schedule -> GenSwapIndex sidx -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Word -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> [Double] -> IO Bond
data AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts
AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts :: BusinessDayConvention -> Maybe Word -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> [Double] -> Bool -> Maybe Day -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Maybe Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> [Double] -> Int -> AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts
[afrbPaymentConvention] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> BusinessDayConvention
[afrbFixingDays] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> Maybe Word
[afrbGearings] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> [Double]
[afrbSpreads] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> [Double]
[afrbCaps] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> [Double]
[afrbFloors] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> [Double]
[afrbInArrears] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> Bool
[afrbIssueDate] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> Maybe Day
[afrbExCouponPeriod] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> (Int, TimeUnit)
[afrbExCouponCalendar] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> Maybe Calendar
[afrbExCouponConvention] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> BusinessDayConvention
[afrbExCouponEndOfMonth] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> Bool
[afrbRedemptions] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> [Double]
[afrbPaymentLag] :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> Int
defaultAmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts :: AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts

-- | amortizing floating-rate bond (possibly capped and/or floored) with a
--   per-period notional schedule instead of a single face amount; see
--   <a>AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts</a> for the trailing optional
--   parameters (default via <a>defaultAmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts</a>,
--   override with record-update syntax).
amortizingFloatingRateBond :: Word -> [Double] -> Schedule -> GenIborIndex ibor -> DayCounter -> AmortizingFloatingRateBondOpts -> IO Bond

-- | returns a schedule for French amortization
sinkingSchedule :: Day -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Frequency -> Calendar -> IO Schedule

-- | returns a sequence of notionals for French amortization
sinkingNotionals :: (Int, TimeUnit) -> Frequency -> Double -> Double -> IO [Double]

-- | Returns the maturity date of the bond
maturityDate :: GenBond b -> Maybe Day

-- | theoretical bond yield
yield :: GenBond b -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Double -> Word -> (Double, BondPriceType) -> IO Double

-- | accrued amount at a given date
accruedAmount :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Double

-- | clean price given a yield and settlement date
cleanPriceFromYield :: GenBond b -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> IO Double

-- | dirty price given a yield and settlement date
dirtyPriceFromYield :: GenBond b -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> IO Double

-- | date of the next cash flow after the given (or default settlement)
--   date
nextCashFlowDate :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Expected next coupon: depending on (the bond and) the given date the
--   coupon can be historic, deterministic or expected in a stochastic
--   sense. When the bond settlement date is used the coupon is the
--   already-fixed not-yet-paid one.The current bond settlement is used if
--   no date is given.
nextCouponRate :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Double

-- | bond notional outstanding at the given date
notional :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Double

-- | date of the cash flow immediately before the given (or default
--   settlement) date
previousCashFlowDate :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Previous coupon already paid at a given date. Expected previous
--   coupon: depending on (the bond and) the given date the coupon can be
--   historic, deterministic or expected in a stochastic sense. When the
--   bond settlement date is used the coupon is the last paid one.The
--   current bond settlement is used if no date is given.
previousCouponRate :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Double

-- | settlement value as a function of the clean price The default bond
--   settlement date is used for calculation.
settlementValueFromCleanPrice :: GenBond b -> Double -> IO Double

-- | theoretical settlement value The default bond settlement date is used
--   for calculation.
settlementValue :: GenBond b -> IO Double

-- | yield given a (clean) price and settlement date
yieldFromPrice :: GenBond b -> (Double, BondPriceType) -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> Double -> Word -> IO Double

-- | whether the bond can be traded (i.e. still has a positive notional) at
--   the given date
isTradable :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Bool

-- | notionals for each period of the bond's amortization schedule
notionals :: GenBond b -> IO [Double]

-- | returns all the cashflows, including the redemptions.
cashFlows :: GenBond b -> IO Leg

-- | returns just the redemption flows (not interest payments)
redemptions :: GenBond b -> IO Leg

-- | settlement date computed from the given date (or today's date if none
--   is given)
settlementDate :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Day

-- | date the bond starts accruing
startDate :: GenBond b -> IO Day

-- | number of days in the current accrual period up to the given (or
--   default settlement) date
accrualDays :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Int

-- | end date of the accrual period containing the given (or default
--   settlement) date
accrualEndDate :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | length in time of the accrual period containing the given (or default
--   settlement) date
accrualPeriod :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Double

-- | start date of the accrual period containing the given (or default
--   settlement) date
accrualStartDate :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | number of days accrued up to the given (or default settlement) date
accruedDays :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Int

-- | length in time accrued up to the given (or default settlement) date
accruedPeriod :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Double

-- | the bond's yield to maturity given a market price and discount curve
atmRate :: GenBond b -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Day -> (Double, BondPriceType) -> IO Double

-- | basis-point value given an <a>InterestRate</a> yield
basisPointValue' :: GenBond b -> InterestRate -> Day -> IO Double

-- | basis-point value given a flat yield, day counter, compounding and
--   frequency
basisPointValue :: GenBond b -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> IO Double

-- | bps (Basis Point Sensitivity) given a flat yield, day counter,
--   compounding and frequency
bpsFromYield :: GenBond b -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> IO Double

-- | bps (Basis Point Sensitivity) given an <a>InterestRate</a> yield
bpsFromYield' :: GenBond b -> InterestRate -> Day -> IO Double

-- | bps (Basis Point Sensitivity) given a discount curve
bps :: GenBond b -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Day -> IO Double

-- | clean price given a discount curve and settlement date
cleanPrice :: GenBond b -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Day -> IO Double

-- | clean price given a discount curve, a Z-spread over it, compounding
--   and frequency
cleanPrice' :: GenBond b -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> IO Double

-- | clean price given an <a>InterestRate</a> yield
cleanPriceFromYield' :: GenBond b -> InterestRate -> Day -> IO Double

-- | convexity given an <a>InterestRate</a> yield
convexity' :: GenBond b -> InterestRate -> Day -> IO Double

-- | convexity given a flat yield, day counter, compounding and frequency
convexity :: GenBond b -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> IO Double

-- | duration given an <a>InterestRate</a> yield and duration type
duration' :: GenBond b -> InterestRate -> DurationType -> Day -> IO Double

-- | duration given a flat yield, day counter, compounding, frequency and
--   duration type
duration :: GenBond b -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> DurationType -> Day -> IO Double

-- | amount of the cash flow immediately after the given (or default
--   settlement) date
nextCashFlowAmount :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Double

-- | amount of the cash flow immediately before the given (or default
--   settlement) date
previousCashFlowAmount :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO Double

-- | end date of the reference period containing the given (or default
--   settlement) date
referencePeriodEnd :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | start date of the reference period containing the given (or default
--   settlement) date
referencePeriodStart :: GenBond b -> Day -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | yield given a (clean) price and settlement date, solved to the given
--   accuracy
yieldFromPrice' :: GenBond b -> (Double, BondPriceType) -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> Double -> Word -> Double -> IO Double

-- | yield value of a basis point given an <a>InterestRate</a> yield
yieldValueBasisPoint' :: GenBond b -> InterestRate -> Day -> IO Double

-- | yield value of a basis point given a flat yield, day counter,
--   compounding and frequency
yieldValueBasisPoint :: GenBond b -> Double -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> IO Double

-- | Z-spread over a discount curve implied by a (clean) price, solved to
--   the given accuracy
zSpread :: GenBond b -> (Double, BondPriceType) -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Day -> Double -> Word -> Double -> IO Double

-- | theoretical clean price for the current evaluation date and term
--   structure
currentCleanPrice :: GenBond b -> IO Double

-- | theoretical dirty price The default bond settlement is used for
--   calculation. <i>Warning</i> the theoretical price calculated from a
--   flat term structure might differ slightly from the price calculated
--   from the corresponding yield by means of the other overload of this
--   function. If the price from a constant yield is desired, it is
--   advisable to use such other overload.
currentDirtyPrice :: GenBond b -> IO Double

-- | fixed-rate bond with an embedded call/put schedule
callableFixedRateBond :: Word -> Double -> Schedule -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Double -> Maybe Day -> [Callability] -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> IO CallableBond

-- | zero-coupon bond with an embedded call/put schedule
callableZeroCouponBond :: Word -> Double -> Calendar -> Day -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Double -> Maybe Day -> [Callability] -> IO CallableBond

-- | convertible bond with a fixed-rate coupon leg
convertibleFixedCouponBond :: Exercise -> Double -> [Callability] -> Day -> Word -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> Schedule -> Double -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> IO ConvertibleBond

-- | convertible bond with a floating-rate coupon leg
convertibleFloatingRateBond :: Exercise -> Double -> [Callability] -> Day -> Word -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Word -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> Schedule -> Double -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> IO ConvertibleBond

-- | convertible zero-coupon bond
convertibleZeroCouponBond :: Exercise -> Double -> [Callability] -> Day -> Word -> DayCounter -> Schedule -> Double -> IO ConvertibleBond

module QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield
type YieldTermStructure = GenYieldTermStructure CYieldTermStructure
type GenYieldTermStructure y = GenTermStructure AnyOf CYieldTermStructure' y
type BondHelper = GenRateHelper CBondHelper

-- | <pre>
--   RateHelper
--     BondHelper
--     SwapRateHelper
--     OISRateHelper
--   </pre>
type RateHelper = GenRateHelper CRateHelper
type SwapRateHelper = GenRateHelper CSwapRateHelper
type OISRateHelper = GenRateHelper COISRateHelper
data FittingMethod
CubicBSplines :: ![Double] -> !Bool -> ![Double] -> ![Double] -> !Double -> !Double -> !Maybe Constraint -> FittingMethod
ExponentialSplines :: !Bool -> ![Double] -> ![Double] -> !Double -> !Double -> !Word -> !Maybe Double -> !Maybe Constraint -> FittingMethod
NelsonSiegel :: ![Double] -> ![Double] -> !Double -> !Double -> !Maybe Constraint -> FittingMethod
SimplePolynomial :: !Word -> !Bool -> ![Double] -> ![Double] -> !Double -> !Double -> !Maybe Constraint -> FittingMethod
Svensson :: ![Double] -> ![Double] -> !Double -> !Double -> !Maybe Constraint -> FittingMethod
type FittedBondDiscountCurve = GenYieldTermStructure CFittedBondDiscountCurve

-- | reference date based on current evaluation date
fittedBondDiscountCurve :: Word -> Calendar -> [BondHelper] -> DayCounter -> FittingMethod -> Double -> Word -> [Double] -> Double -> IO FittedBondDiscountCurve

-- | curve reference date fixed for life of curve
fittedBondDiscountCurve' :: Day -> [BondHelper] -> DayCounter -> FittingMethod -> Double -> Word -> [Double] -> Double -> IO FittedBondDiscountCurve

-- | A curve held behind a relinkable handle. It <i>is</i> a
--   <a>YieldTermStructure</a> -- pass it anywhere a curve is expected and
--   it upcasts like any other hierarchy member, sharing its <tt>Link</tt>
--   so that a later <a>linkTo</a> reaches everything already built on it.
type RelinkableYieldTermStructure = GenYieldTermStructure CRelinkableYieldTermStructure

-- | A curve behind a relinkable handle. The result <i>is</i> a
--   <a>YieldTermStructure</a>: pass it to any curve-taking function and
--   everything built on it keeps tracking whatever the handle currently
--   points at, so a later <a>linkTo</a> reprices already-constructed
--   instruments without rebuilding them. <a>Nothing</a> gives an empty
--   handle -- meaningful rather than an error, since that is what makes a
--   rate helper discount off the curve being bootstrapped -- but reading a
--   curve value through one throws until it is linked.
relinkableYieldTermStructure :: Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO RelinkableYieldTermStructure

-- | Point a relinkable handle at a different curve. Everything already
--   built on the handle reprices against the new curve, with no object
--   rebuilt.
--   
--   This is the one mutator in the module. The API rules here otherwise
--   forbid new setters and prefer constructing a fresh object, but
--   relinking <i>is</i> the capability being bound: a forecast curve is
--   cloned into every floating coupon of every instrument, so without it a
--   curve scenario means rebuilding the whole portfolio.
linkTo :: RelinkableYieldTermStructure -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> IO ()
data GenRateHelper rh
data BootstrapTrait
Discount :: BootstrapTrait
ZeroYield :: BootstrapTrait
ForwardRate :: BootstrapTrait
SimpleZeroYield :: BootstrapTrait
data PillarChoice
MaturityDate :: PillarChoice
LastRelevantDate :: PillarChoice
CustomDate :: PillarChoice
data FuturesType
IMM :: FuturesType
ASX :: FuturesType
Custom :: FuturesType
data CPIInterpolationType
CPIFlat :: CPIInterpolationType
CPILinear :: CPIInterpolationType

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over deposit rates, taking its
--   conventions from an ibor index.
depositRateHelper' :: GenQuote q -> GenIborIndex ibor -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over deposit rates.
depositRateHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> DayCounter -> IO RateHelper

-- | Fixed-coupon bond helper for curve bootstrap: builds the underlying
--   bond internally from a schedule and coupons (unlike <a>bondHelper</a>,
--   which takes an existing <a>Bond</a>).
fixedRateBondHelper :: GenQuote q -> Word -> Double -> Schedule -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Double -> Maybe Day -> IO BondHelper

-- | Bootstrap helper for a <a>CPIBond</a> -- a <tt>CPIBondHelper</tt>,
--   which is a plain <a>BondHelper</a> subclass with no extra methods, so
--   it's returned as the generic <a>BondHelper</a> type (same shape as
--   <a>fixedRateBondHelper</a>).
cpiBondHelper :: GenQuote q -> Word -> Double -> Double -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> ZeroInflationIndex -> CPIInterpolationType -> Schedule -> [Double] -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> Maybe Day -> Calendar -> IO BondHelper

-- | Returns a discount factor from the given YieldTermStructure object
discount' :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Day -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over swap rates, built from explicit
--   tenor/calendar/ frequency/day-count/index conventions rather than a
--   <a>GenSwapIndex</a> bundling them (as <a>swapRateHelper</a> does).
swapRateHelper' :: GenQuote q1 -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Calendar -> Frequency -> BusinessDayConvention -> DayCounter -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Maybe (GenQuote q2) -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> Maybe Word -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> Bool -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe BusinessDayConvention -> Maybe FloatingRateCouponPricer -> IO SwapRateHelper

-- | Flat interest-rate curve with a fixed reference date.
flatForward :: Day -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Flat interest-rate curve whose reference date moves with the
--   evaluation date, offset by <tt>settlementDays</tt> on <a>calendar</a>.
flatForward' :: Word -> Calendar -> GenQuote q -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | The resulting interest rate has the required daycounting rule.
zeroRate' :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Day -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> IO InterestRate

-- | The resulting interest rate has the required day-counting rule.
--   <i>Warning</i> dates are not adjusted for holidays
forwardRateForPeriod :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Day -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> IO InterestRate

-- | The resulting interest rate has the required day-counting rule.
forwardRate' :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Day -> Day -> DayCounter -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> IO InterestRate

-- | The resulting interest rate has the same day-counting rule used by the
--   term structure. The same rule should be used for calculating the
--   passed times t1 and t2.
forwardRate :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Double -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> IO InterestRate

-- | The resulting interest rate has the same day-counting rule used by the
--   term structure. The same rule should be used for calculating the
--   passed time t.
zeroRate :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Compounding -> Frequency -> Bool -> IO InterestRate

-- | The same day-counting rule used by the term structure should be used
--   for calculating the passed time t.
discount :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over FRA rates.
fraRateHelper :: GenQuote q -> Word -> Word -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> DayCounter -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> Bool -> IO RateHelper

-- | <i>Warning</i> Setting a pricing engine to the passed bond from
--   external code will cause the bootstrap to fail or to give wrong
--   results. It is advised to discard the bond after creating the helper,
--   so that the helper has sole ownership of it. BondPriceType
--   (QuantLib.Instrument.Bond) is later in exposed-modules than this file,
--   so priceType is marshalled as a plain Int via fromEnum here instead of
--   a {}'d enum type, per CLAUDE.md's cross-module workaround.
bondHelper :: GenQuote q -> Bond -> BondPriceType -> IO BondHelper
oisRateHelper :: Word -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> GenQuote q -> OvernightIborIndex -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO OISRateHelper
oisRateHelper' :: Day -> Day -> GenQuote q -> OvernightIborIndex -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO OISRateHelper

[oisTelescopicValueDates] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Bool
[oisPaymentLag] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Int

[oisPaymentFrequency] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Frequency
[oisPaymentCalendar] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Maybe Calendar
[oisForwardStart] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> (Int, TimeUnit)
[oisOvernightSpread] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Maybe (GenQuote m)
[oisPillar] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> PillarChoice
[oisCustomPillarDate] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Maybe Day
[oisAveragingMethod] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> RateAveragingType
[oisEndOfMonth] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Maybe Bool
[oisFixedPaymentFrequency] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Maybe Frequency
[oisFixedCalendar] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Maybe Calendar
[oisLookbackDays] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Maybe Word
[oisLockoutDays] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Word
[oisApplyObservationShift] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Bool
[oisPricer] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Maybe FloatingRateCouponPricer
[oisRule] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> DateGenerationRule
[oisOvernightCalendar] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> Maybe Calendar
[oisConvention] :: OISRateHelperOpts m -> BusinessDayConvention
defaultOISRateHelperOpts :: OISRateHelperOpts m

oisRateHelperFull' :: Day -> Day -> GenQuote q -> OvernightIborIndex -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> OISRateHelperOpts m -> IO OISRateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over swap rates, built from a

swapRateHelper :: GenQuote q1 -> GenSwapIndex sidx -> Maybe (GenQuote q2) -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> Bool -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe FloatingRateCouponPricer -> IO SwapRateHelper

-- | A yield curve offset from <tt>baseCurve</tt> by a spread added to its
--   instantaneous forward rate, remaining linked to changes in either.
forwardSpreadedTermStructure :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenQuote q -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | A yield curve offset from <tt>baseCurve</tt> by a spread added to its
--   zero-yield rate, remaining linked to changes in either.
zeroSpreadedTermStructure :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenQuote q -> Compounding -> Frequency -> IO YieldTermStructure
