bmaSwapRateHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Word -> Calendar -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> BusinessDayConvention -> DayCounter -> BMAIndex -> GenIborIndex ibor -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping from multiple-resets swap quotes (a
--   floating leg that resets several times per fixed-leg coupon period).
multipleResetsSwapRateHelper :: Word -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> GenQuote q1 -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Word -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> RateAveragingType -> Double -> Frequency -> DayCounter -> BusinessDayConvention -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over FRA rates, taking its
--   fixing/day-count conventions from an ibor index instead of explicit
--   <a>Calendar</a>/<a>BusinessDayConvention</a>/<a>DayCounter</a>
--   arguments.
fraIborRateHelper' :: GenQuote q -> Word -> GenIborIndex ibor -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> Bool -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over FRA rates, with the FRA period
--   given as a start/length pair rather than <a>fraRateHelper'</a>s
--   monthsToStart/monthsToEnd.
fraRateHelper' :: GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Word -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> DayCounter -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> Bool -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over FRA rates, taking its conventions
--   from an ibor index and the FRA period as a start/length pair.
fraIborRateHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> GenIborIndex ibor -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> Bool -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over IborIndex futures prices, given
--   explicit start/end dates.
futuresRateHelper' :: GenQuote q1 -> Day -> Day -> DayCounter -> Maybe (GenQuote q2) -> FuturesType -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over IborIndex futures prices, taking
--   its conventions from an ibor index.
futuresIborRateHelper :: GenQuote q1 -> Day -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Maybe (GenQuote q2) -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over IborIndex futures prices, given
--   explicit calendar/convention/day-counter conventions.
futuresRateHelper :: GenQuote q1 -> Day -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> DayCounter -> Maybe (GenQuote q2) -> FuturesType -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over overnight-index compounding
--   futures.
overnightIndexFutureRateHelper :: GenQuote q1 -> Day -> Day -> OvernightIborIndex -> Maybe (GenQuote q2) -> RateAveragingType -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> IO RateHelper

-- | Rate helper for bootstrapping over CME SOFR futures. Compounds
--   overnight SOFR from the third Wednesday of
--   <tt>referenceMonth</tt>/<tt>referenceYear</tt> (inclusive) to the
--   third Wednesday of the following month or quarter (exclusive), per
--   <tt>referenceFreq</tt>.
sofrFutureRateHelper :: GenQuote q1 -> Month -> Int -> Frequency -> Maybe (GenQuote q2) -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> IO RateHelper

-- | The quote value implied by the current bootstrapped state of the curve
--   the helper was last used against, i.e. what the helper's own market
--   quote would need to be to make it reprice exactly.
impliedQuote :: GenRateHelper rh -> IO Double

-- | A yield curve identical to <tt>baseCurve</tt> but reporting a
--   different reference date; observes and stays linked to
--   <tt>baseCurve</tt>.
impliedTermStructure :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> Day -> IO YieldTermStructure
asYieldTermStructure :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> IO YieldTermStructure
asRateHelper :: GenRateHelper rh -> IO RateHelper

-- | A yield curve with a vector of zero-yield spreads added to
--   <tt>baseCurve</tt>, interpolated linearly between the given dates.
--   Remains linked to changes in <tt>baseCurve</tt> or the spread quotes.
piecewiseZeroSpreadedTermStructure :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> Compounding -> Frequency -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Quanto term structure, modelling the quanto effect in option pricing.
--   Stays linked to all four inputs.
quantoTermStructure :: GenYieldTermStructure y1 -> GenYieldTermStructure y2 -> GenYieldTermStructure y3 -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv1 -> Double -> GenBlackVolTermStructure bv2 -> Double -> Double -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Blends <tt>originalCurve</tt> with an ultimate forward rate beyond the
--   last liquid point, per the "UFR" methodology used for extrapolating
--   long-dated (e.g. Solvency II) curves.
ultimateForwardTermStructure :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> GenQuote q1 -> GenQuote q2 -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Double -> Maybe Int -> Compounding -> Frequency -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | final value of cost function after optimization
minimumCostValue :: FittedBondDiscountCurve -> IO Double

-- | final number of iterations used in the optimization problem
numberOfIterations :: FittedBondDiscountCurve -> IO Int

-- | Term structure bootstrapped to reprice a set of <tt>instruments</tt>,
--   one interpolated segment per instrument, iteratively (pillar by
--   pillar): each bootstrapped instrument's maturity ends its own segment,
--   and reprices correctly on the resulting curve. Fixed reference date.
piecewiseYieldCurve :: Day -> [GenRateHelper rh] -> DayCounter -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> BootstrapTrait -> Interpolation -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Like <a>piecewiseYieldCurve</a>, but with a reference date that moves
--   with the evaluation date (settlement days on <a>calendar</a>), and
--   lets extrapolation past the curve's max date be enabled.
piecewiseYieldCurve' :: Word -> Calendar -> [GenRateHelper rh] -> DayCounter -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> BootstrapTrait -> Interpolation -> Bool -> IO YieldTermStructure
data IterativeBootstrapOpts
IterativeBootstrapOpts :: Maybe Double -> Maybe Double -> Maybe Double -> Word -> Double -> Double -> Bool -> Word -> Word -> IterativeBootstrapOpts
[ibAccuracy] :: IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Maybe Double
[ibMinValue] :: IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Maybe Double
[ibMaxValue] :: IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Maybe Double
[ibMaxAttempts] :: IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Word
[ibMaxFactor] :: IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Double
[ibMinFactor] :: IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Double
[ibDontThrow] :: IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Bool
[ibDontThrowSteps] :: IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Word
[ibMaxEvaluations] :: IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Word
defaultIterativeBootstrapOpts :: IterativeBootstrapOpts

-- | Like <a>piecewiseYieldCurve</a>, but exposes every
--   <tt>IterativeBootstrap</tt> setting through
--   <a>IterativeBootstrapOpts</a> instead of hardcoding upstream's
--   defaults. Start from <a>defaultIterativeBootstrapOpts</a> and override
--   with record-update syntax; passing it unchanged is exactly
--   <a>piecewiseYieldCurve</a>.
--   <a>ibAccuracy</a>/<a>ibMinValue</a>/<a>ibMaxValue</a> are <a>Maybe</a>
--   because upstream defaults them to <tt>Null&lt;Real&gt;()</tt> ("pick a
--   sensible value per pillar"), not to a number. <a>ibDontThrow</a> is
--   the one to reach for when a curve fails to bootstrap: it substitutes
--   the best value found so far for a pillar that won't solve, rather than
--   throwing.
piecewiseYieldCurveFull :: Day -> [GenRateHelper rh] -> DayCounter -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> BootstrapTrait -> Interpolation -> IterativeBootstrapOpts -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | <a>piecewiseYieldCurve'</a> with the same <tt>IterativeBootstrap</tt>
--   settings <a>piecewiseYieldCurveFull</a> exposes; see there for what
--   they mean.
piecewiseYieldCurveFull' :: Word -> Calendar -> [GenRateHelper rh] -> DayCounter -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> BootstrapTrait -> Interpolation -> IterativeBootstrapOpts -> Bool -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Like <a>piecewiseYieldCurve'</a>, but bootstraps with QuantLib's
--   <tt>GlobalBootstrap</tt> instead of <tt>IterativeBootstrap</tt> -- all
--   instruments (and, for a <a>MultiCurve</a> cycle, all member curves)
--   are solved for together under one optimizer, rather than
--   pillar-by-pillar. This is what lets a rate helper reference another
--   curve's not-yet-bootstrapped handle: see the "relinkable handles"
--   tests in <a>QuantLib.Spec.TermStructure</a> for the two-curve cycle
--   this exists for. Hardcodes trait=Discount/interpolator=LogLinear in
--   its own shim (the only combination this dispatch supports, per
--   CLAUDE.md's dispatch-table-scope note) rather than taking
--   <a>BootstrapTrait</a>/<a>Interpolation</a> params.
--   <tt>instrumentWeights</tt> is upstream's <tt>GlobalBootstrap</tt>
--   constructor's trailing <tt>instrumentWeights</tt> parameter -- an
--   empty list reproduces its default (equal weighting); a non-empty one
--   must have one entry per alive instrument. The
--   <tt>additionalHelpers</tt>/<tt>additionalDates</tt>/<tt>additionalPenalties</tt>/
--   <tt>additionalVariables</tt> overloads (functor callbacks into the
--   optimizer) are not bound -- see README's # TODO.
piecewiseYieldCurveGlobalBootstrap' :: Word -> Calendar -> [GenRateHelper rh] -> DayCounter -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> Double -> [Double] -> Bool -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Like <a>piecewiseYieldCurveGlobalBootstrap'</a>, but hardcodes
--   trait=SimpleZeroYield/ interpolator=Linear instead of
--   trait=Discount/interpolator=LogLinear -- QuantLib-SWIG's only bound
--   <tt>GlobalBootstrap</tt> combination
--   (<tt>GlobalLinearSimpleZeroCurve</tt>).
piecewiseYieldCurveGlobalBootstrapSimpleZeroLinear' :: Word -> Calendar -> [GenRateHelper rh] -> DayCounter -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> Double -> [Double] -> Bool -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Like <a>piecewiseYieldCurveGlobalBootstrapSimpleZeroLinear'</a>, but
--   bootstraps with <tt>GlobalBootstrap</tt>'s functor-callback
--   constructor instead of the plain <tt>accuracy</tt>/
--   <tt>instrumentWeights</tt> one -- upstream QuantLib-SWIG's canned
--   <tt>AdditionalErrors</tt>/<tt>AdditionalDates</tt> functors (see
--   README's # TODO), constructed internally from
--   <tt>additionalHelpers</tt>/ <tt>additionalDates</tt> rather than
--   taking the formula itself as a parameter (it's fixed, not a
--   user-supplied callback). <tt>additionalDates</tt> must have exactly
--   <tt>length additionalHelpers - 2</tt> entries --
--   <tt>AdditionalErrors</tt>' fixed linear-interpolation formula produces
--   that many equations, and <tt>GlobalBootstrap</tt> requires equations
--   to match unknowns; a mismatch raises a <a>Error</a> naming both
--   counts.
piecewiseYieldCurveGlobalBootstrapSimpleZeroLinearFull' :: Word -> Calendar -> [GenRateHelper rh1] -> DayCounter -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> [GenRateHelper rh2] -> [Day] -> Double -> Bool -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Yield curve interpolating zero-yield rates directly between the given
--   dates.
interpolatedZeroCurve :: [(Day, Double)] -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> Interpolation -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Yield curve interpolating instantaneous forward rates directly between
--   the given dates.
interpolatedForwardCurve :: [(Day, Double)] -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> Interpolation -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Yield curve interpolating discount factors directly between the given
--   dates.
interpolatedDiscountCurve :: [(Day, Double)] -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> [(Day, GenQuote q)] -> Interpolation -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Discount factors interpolated as a multiplicative spread applied on
--   top of <tt>baseCurve</tt>. Upstream requires the first discount factor
--   to be exactly <tt>1.0</tt>, flagging its date as the curve's own
--   reference date; a mismatched leading value throws a <a>Error</a>.
interpolatedSpreadDiscountCurve :: GenYieldTermStructure y -> [(Day, Double)] -> Interpolation -> IO YieldTermStructure
data MultiCurve

-- | Builds a set of curves that form a genuine dependency cycle -- the
--   scenario <a>RelinkableYieldTermStructure</a> exists for. Protocol (see
--   the class's own upstream doc comment): build each member curve's rate
--   helpers off an empty <a>relinkableYieldTermStructure</a> (the
--   <i>internal</i> handle), construct the curves themselves (e.g. via
--   <a>piecewiseYieldCurveGlobalBootstrap'</a>), then hand each pair of
--   (internal handle, curve) to <a>addBootstrappedCurve</a> -- which
--   returns an <i>external</i> handle to reference the curve by from then
--   on, and links the internal handle to it (with ownership/observability
--   stripped to avoid shared_ptr and notification cycles) so the curves'
--   own cross-references resolve.
multiCurve :: Double -> IO MultiCurve

-- | Add a curve built with a bootstrapper (e.g.
--   <a>piecewiseYieldCurveGlobalBootstrap'</a>) to the cycle. See
--   <a>multiCurve</a> for the protocol.
addBootstrappedCurve :: MultiCurve -> RelinkableYieldTermStructure -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Add a curve that isn't built with a bootstrapper (e.g. a spreaded
--   curve) to the cycle. See <a>multiCurve</a> for the protocol.
addNonBootstrappedCurve :: MultiCurve -> RelinkableYieldTermStructure -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> IO YieldTermStructure

-- | Bootstrapping helper for an ibor-ibor basis swap: pays <tt>baseIndex +
--   basis</tt>, receives <tt>otherIndex</tt>. Pass <tt>bootstrapBaseCurve
--   = True</tt> (with <tt>otherIndex</tt> carrying a forecast curve) to
--   bootstrap the forecast curve for <tt>baseIndex</tt>, or <a>False</a>
--   (with <tt>baseIndex</tt> carrying a forecast curve) to bootstrap the
--   forecast curve for <tt>otherIndex</tt>. An exogenous discount curve is
--   always required.
iborIborBasisSwapRateHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> GenIborIndex ibor1 -> GenIborIndex ibor2 -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Bool -> IO RateHelper

-- | Bootstrapping helper for an overnight-ibor basis swap: pays
--   <tt>baseIndex + basis</tt>, receives <tt>otherIndex</tt>. Bootstraps
--   the forecast curve for <tt>otherIndex</tt>; <tt>baseIndex</tt> needs
--   an existing forecast curve. If <a>Nothing</a>, the overnight index's
--   own curve is used as the discount curve.
overnightIborBasisSwapRateHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> OvernightIborIndex -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO RateHelper

-- | Bootstrapping helper for a constant-notional cross-currency basis
--   swap: the collateral is paid in the quote currency, the basis is given
--   on the base-currency leg. <a>Nothing</a> for either frequency
--   parameter derives the corresponding leg's schedule from its index
--   tenor (or, for the quote-currency leg, falls back to the base-currency
--   frequency if that is given).
constNotionalCrossCurrencyBasisSwapRateHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> GenIborIndex ibor1 -> GenIborIndex ibor2 -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe Frequency -> Int -> Maybe Frequency -> IO RateHelper

-- | Bootstrapping helper for a marked-to-market cross-currency basis swap:
--   like <a>constNotionalCrossCurrencyBasisSwapRateHelper</a>, but the
--   notional on the MtM leg resets at each payment to reflect the FX rate.
mtMCrossCurrencyBasisSwapRateHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> GenIborIndex ibor1 -> GenIborIndex ibor2 -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Bool -> Bool -> Bool -> Maybe Frequency -> Int -> Maybe Frequency -> IO RateHelper

-- | Bootstrapping helper for a fixed-vs-floating cross-currency par swap:
--   quoted at par, so the FX spot cancels out and isn't required.
--   <tt>collateralOnFixedLeg</tt> selects which leg is discounted with
--   <tt>collateralCurve</tt> -- the other leg's discount curve is the one
--   being bootstrapped.
constNotionalCrossCurrencySwapRateHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> Frequency -> DayCounter -> GenIborIndex ibor -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Bool -> Int -> IO RateHelper

-- | Bootstrapping helper from FX swap points, tenor-relative.
--   <tt>collateralCurve</tt> discounts the collateral currency; the curve
--   being bootstrapped is for the other currency. <tt>fwdPoint</tt> and
--   <tt>spotFx</tt> must be quoted in the same units (points already
--   scaled to match the spot).
fxSwapRateHelper :: GenQuote q1 -> GenQuote q2 -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Word -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Bool -> Bool -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Calendar -> IO RateHelper

-- | Bootstrapping helper from FX swap points, explicit start/end date.
fxSwapRateHelper' :: GenQuote q1 -> GenQuote q2 -> Day -> Day -> Bool -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> IO RateHelper

-- | The bond the helper prices. For
--   <a>fixedRateBondHelper</a>/<a>cpiBondHelper</a> this is the only way
--   to reach it, since they build the bond internally rather than taking
--   one (unlike <a>bondHelper</a>).
bondHelperBond :: BondHelper -> IO Bond

-- | The underlying swap the helper builds from its tenor and index.
swapRateHelperSwap :: SwapRateHelper -> IO VanillaSwap

-- | The underlying overnight indexed swap the helper builds from its tenor
--   and index.
oisRateHelperSwap :: OISRateHelper -> IO OvernightIndexedSwap
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield.BootstrapTrait
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield.FuturesType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield.PillarChoice
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield.BootstrapTrait
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield.FuturesType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield.PillarChoice
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield.BootstrapTrait
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield.FuturesType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.TermStructure.Yield.PillarChoice

module QuantLib.TermStructure.Inflation
type ZeroInflationTermStructure = GenTermStructure CZeroInflationTermStructure
type YoYInflationTermStructure = GenTermStructure CYoYInflationTermStructure
data ZeroCouponInflationSwapHelper
data YearOnYearInflationSwapHelper
data CPIInterpolationType
CPIFlat :: CPIInterpolationType
CPILinear :: CPIInterpolationType

-- | Bootstrap helper for a zero-coupon inflation swap, at the given
--   (observation lag, maturity).
zeroCouponInflationSwapHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Day -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> DayCounter -> ZeroInflationIndex -> CPIInterpolationType -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> IO ZeroCouponInflationSwapHelper

-- | Bootstrap helper for a year-on-year inflation swap. Unlike
--   <a>zeroCouponInflationSwapHelper</a>, also needs the nominal discount
--   curve (the YoY swap's fixed/floating legs discount off it).
yearOnYearInflationSwapHelper :: GenQuote q -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> Day -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> DayCounter -> YoYInflationIndex -> CPIInterpolationType -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> PillarChoice -> Maybe Day -> IO YearOnYearInflationSwapHelper

-- | The underlying swap the helper builds from its quote, observation lag
--   and maturity.
zeroCouponInflationSwapHelperSwap :: ZeroCouponInflationSwapHelper -> IO ZeroCouponInflationSwap

-- | The underlying swap the helper builds from its quote, observation lag
--   and maturity.
yearOnYearInflationSwapHelperSwap :: YearOnYearInflationSwapHelper -> IO YearOnYearInflationSwap
piecewiseZeroInflationCurve :: Day -> Day -> Frequency -> DayCounter -> [ZeroCouponInflationSwapHelper] -> Interpolation -> IO ZeroInflationTermStructure
piecewiseYoYInflationCurve :: Day -> Day -> Double -> Frequency -> DayCounter -> [YearOnYearInflationSwapHelper] -> Interpolation -> IO YoYInflationTermStructure

-- | Zero-coupon inflation rate implied by the curve.
zeroRate :: ZeroInflationTermStructure -> Day -> Bool -> IO Double

-- | Year-on-year inflation rate implied by the curve.
yoyRate :: YoYInflationTermStructure -> Day -> Bool -> IO Double

module QuantLib.Index.InterestRate
type InterestRateIndex = GenInterestRateIndex CInterestRateIndex

type IborIndex = GenIborIndex CIborIndex
type SwapIndex = GenSwapIndex CSwapIndex
type OvernightIndexedSwapIndex = GenSwapIndex COvernightIndexedSwapIndex
type GenInterestRateIndex ridx = GenIndex AnyOf CInterestRateIndex' ridx

type GenSwapIndex sidx = GenInterestRateIndex AnyOf CSwapIndex' sidx

-- | Creates the BMA (Bond Market Association) short-term tax-exempt index,
--   optionally linked to a forwarding curve.
bmaIndex :: Maybe (GenYieldTermStructure y) -> IO BMAIndex

-- | This method returns a schedule of fixing dates between start and end.
fixingSchedule :: BMAIndex -> Day -> Day -> IO Schedule

-- | It can be overridden to implement particular conventions.

--   corresponding value date.

asSwapIndex :: GenSwapIndex sidx -> IO SwapIndex

-- | Construct an overnight-indexed swap index. RateAveragingType

--   averagingMethod is marshalled as a plain Int via fromEnum in the

module QuantLib.Instrument.Swap
type Swaption = GenOption CSwaption
type Swap = GenSwap CSwap
type VanillaSwap = GenSwap CVanillaSwap
type AssetSwap = GenSwap CAssetSwap
type OvernightIndexedSwap = GenSwap COvernightIndexedSwap
type BMASwap = GenSwap CBMASwap
type ZeroCouponInflationSwap = GenSwap CZeroCouponInflationSwap
type YearOnYearInflationSwap = GenSwap CYearOnYearInflationSwap
type CPISwap = GenSwap CCPISwap
type ZeroCouponSwap = GenSwap CZeroCouponSwap
type EquityTotalReturnSwap = GenSwap CEquityTotalReturnSwap
type VarianceSwap = GenInstrument CVarianceSwap
type VarianceOption = GenInstrument CVarianceOption
asSwap :: GenSwap s -> IO Swap

-- | implied volatility
impliedVolatility :: Swaption -> Double -> GenYieldTermStructure y -> Double -> Double -> Word -> Double -> Double -> VolatilityType -> Double -> SwaptionPriceType -> IO Double
data SwapType
Receiver :: SwapType
Payer :: SwapType
data SwaptionPriceType
SwaptionSpot :: SwaptionPriceType
SwaptionForward :: SwaptionPriceType
data CPIInterpolationType
CPIFlat :: CPIInterpolationType
CPILinear :: CPIInterpolationType

-- | Multi leg constructor.
swap' :: [(Leg, Bool)] -> IO Swap

-- | The cash flows belonging to the first leg are paid; the ones belonging
--   to the second leg are received.
swap :: GenLeg l1 -> GenLeg l2 -> IO Swap

-- | Swap paying Libor against BMA coupons
bmaSwap :: SwapType -> Double -> Schedule -> Double -> Double -> GenIborIndex ibor -> DayCounter -> Schedule -> BMAIndex -> DayCounter -> IO BMASwap

-- | Fixed-rate vs floating-rate (Ibor) swap; if no payment convention is
--   given, the floating leg's is used.
vanillaSwap :: SwapType -> Double -> Schedule -> Double -> DayCounter -> Schedule -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Double -> DayCounter -> Maybe BusinessDayConvention -> Maybe Bool -> IO VanillaSwap

-- | Haskell equivalent of QuantLib's fluent <tt>MakeVanillaSwap</tt>
--   builder -- a single function with <a>Maybe</a>-wrapped optional
--   parameters instead of chained <tt>.with*</tt> calls, covering the
--   subset of <tt>makevanillaswap.hpp</tt>'s fields named in the
--   parameters below. Not covered at all (no parameter): explicit
--   effective/termination date overrides, a settlement calendar distinct
--   from the floating-leg one, floating-leg tenor/convention/ termination
--   convention/day count overrides (always taken from the index, matching
--   upstream's own defaults), <tt>withRule</tt> variants (always
--   <tt>DateGeneration::Backward</tt>),
--   end-of-month/first-date/next-to-last-date overrides, a floating-leg
--   spread other than <tt>0</tt>, a discounting term structure or custom
--   pricing engine (use <a>setPricingEngine</a> on the result instead),
--   indexed/at-par coupon overrides, and payment convention (always the
--   floating leg's, matching upstream's own default when unset).
--   <tt>fixedLegTenor</tt>/<tt>fixedLegDayCount</tt> are required
--   arguments here rather than optional with upstream's currency-based
--   inference. A <a>Nothing</a> <tt>settlementDays</tt> behaves as
--   <tt>Just 0</tt>, rather than replicating upstream's
--   index-<tt>valueDate</tt>-based spot-date convention.
makeVanillaSwap :: (Word, TimeUnit) -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Double -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Maybe Int -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> DayCounter -> Maybe BusinessDayConvention -> Maybe BusinessDayConvention -> Maybe Calendar -> Maybe Calendar -> Maybe Double -> Maybe SwapType -> IO VanillaSwap

-- | Haskell equivalent of QuantLib's fluent <tt>MakeCms</tt> builder, in
--   the style of <a>makeVanillaSwap</a> above -- not a binding of the
--   <tt>MakeCms</tt> C++ class at all, but a plain function composing
--   already-bound primitives (<a>schedule</a>, <a>cmsLeg</a>,
--   <a>iborLeg</a>, <a>swap'</a>). The result is a plain <a>Swap</a> (a
--   CMS swap has no calc/getter of its own beyond generic
--   <tt>Swap'</tt>s), with no <a>FloatingRateCouponPricer</a> attached --
--   attach one to the CMS leg afterwards via <tt>setCouponPricer =&lt;&lt;
--   <a>leg</a> result 0</tt> (<a>swap'</a> is used instead of <a>swap</a>
--   precisely so the CMS leg is always leg 0, regardless of
--   <a>SwapType</a>) and <a>setCouponPricer</a> before pricing.
--   
--   Unlike <tt>MakeCms</tt>, <tt>cmsLegTenor</tt>/<tt>cmsLegDayCount</tt>
--   are required arguments here rather than defaulted (upstream hardcodes
--   3 Months/<tt>Actual360</tt>); pass those literals to reproduce
--   <tt>MakeCms</tt>'s own defaults. Not covered at all (no parameter): an
--   explicit effective date override, CMS-leg/floating-leg
--   termination-date-convention/rule/end-of-month/
--   first-date/next-to-last-date overrides (always
--   <tt>ModifiedFollowing</tt>/<tt>Backward</tt>/<tt>False</tt>/ unset,
--   matching <tt>MakeCms</tt>'s own defaults for the CMS leg), CMS coupon
--   gearing/caps/floors (use <a>cmsLegFull</a> and <a>swap</a> directly
--   for those), an ATM-spread lookup, a discounting term structure or
--   custom pricing engine (use <a>setPricingEngine</a> on the result
--   instead). A <a>Nothing</a> <tt>settlementDays</tt> behaves as <tt>Just
--   0</tt>, rather than replicating upstream's
--   index-<tt>valueDate</tt>-based spot-date convention (matching
--   <tt>makeVanillaSwap'</tt>s own choice here).
makeCms :: (Word, TimeUnit) -> GenSwapIndex sidx -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Double -> (Int, TimeUnit) -> Maybe Int -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> DayCounter -> Maybe Calendar -> Maybe Calendar -> Maybe Double -> Maybe SwapType -> IO Swap

-- | A zero-coupon inflation-indexed swap (ZCIIS): a single
--   fixed-vs-CPI-ratio exchange at maturity. Per-leg NPV/BPS use the
--   generic <a>leg</a>/<a>legNPV</a>/<a>legBPS</a> (leg 0 = fixed, leg 1 =
--   inflation).
zeroCouponInflationSwap :: SwapType -> Double -> Day -> Day -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> DayCounter -> Double -> ZeroInflationIndex -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> CPIInterpolationType -> Bool -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> IO ZeroCouponInflationSwap

-- | The fixed rate that would make the swap's NPV zero.
zcisFairRate :: ZeroCouponInflationSwap -> IO Double

-- | A year-on-year inflation-indexed swap: fixed leg vs a
--   YoY-inflation-linked leg. Per-leg NPV/BPS use the generic
--   <a>leg</a>/<a>legNPV</a>/<a>legBPS</a> (leg 0 = fixed, leg 1 = YoY).
yearOnYearInflationSwap :: SwapType -> Double -> Schedule -> Double -> DayCounter -> Schedule -> YoYInflationIndex -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> CPIInterpolationType -> Double -> DayCounter -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> IO YearOnYearInflationSwap

-- | The fixed rate that would make the swap's NPV zero.
yoyFairRate :: YearOnYearInflationSwap -> IO Double

-- | A fixed-x-CPI-ratio leg (subtracting the inflation notional if
--   <i>subtractInflationNominal</i>) vs a float+spread leg -- QuantLib's
--   general-purpose inflation swap, also usable to replicate a
--   single-cashflow ZCIIS (see <a>zeroCouponInflationSwap</a>). Per-leg
--   NPV/BPS use the generic <a>leg</a>/<a>legNPV</a>/<a>legBPS</a> (leg 0
--   = CPI, leg 1 = float).
cpiSwap :: SwapType -> Double -> Bool -> Double -> DayCounter -> Schedule -> BusinessDayConvention -> Word -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Double -> Double -> DayCounter -> Schedule -> BusinessDayConvention -> (Word, TimeUnit) -> ZeroInflationIndex -> CPIInterpolationType -> Maybe Double -> IO CPISwap

-- | The fixed rate that would make the swap's NPV zero.
cpiSwapFairRate :: CPISwap -> IO Double

-- | Zero-coupon swap quoted in terms of a known fixed cash flow.
--   "payer"/"receiver" refer to the fixed leg.
zeroCouponSwap :: SwapType -> Double -> Day -> Day -> Double -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Word -> IO ZeroCouponSwap

-- | Zero-coupon swap quoted in terms of a fixed rate.
zeroCouponSwap' :: SwapType -> Double -> Day -> Day -> Double -> DayCounter -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Word -> IO ZeroCouponSwap

-- | The fixed payment that would make the swap's NPV zero.
fairFixedPayment :: ZeroCouponSwap -> IO Double

-- | The fixed rate, under the given day counter, that would make the
--   swap's NPV zero.
fairFixedRate :: ZeroCouponSwap -> DayCounter -> IO Double

-- | Exchanges the total return of an <a>EquityIndex</a> for a set of
--   floating cash flows linked to an <a>IborIndex</a>. <i>type</i>
--   (payer/receiver) refers to the equity leg.
equityTotalReturnSwapIbor :: SwapType -> Double -> Schedule -> EquityIndex -> GenIborIndex ibor -> DayCounter -> Double -> Double -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Word -> IO EquityTotalReturnSwap

-- | As <a>equityTotalReturnSwapIbor</a>, but with the floating leg linked
--   to an overnight index instead -- fixings are compounded over the
--   accrual period.
equityTotalReturnSwapOvernight :: SwapType -> Double -> Schedule -> EquityIndex -> OvernightIborIndex -> DayCounter -> Double -> Double -> Calendar -> BusinessDayConvention -> Word -> IO EquityTotalReturnSwap

-- | NPV of the equity total-return leg.
equityLegNPV :: EquityTotalReturnSwap -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the interest-rate leg.
interestRateLegNPV :: EquityTotalReturnSwap -> IO Double

-- | The margin that would make the swap's NPV zero.
fairMargin :: EquityTotalReturnSwap -> IO Double

-- | Variance swap: pays off the difference between realized and strike
--   variance, scaled by notional. This class does not manage seasoned
--   variance swaps.
varianceSwap :: PositionType -> Double -> Double -> Day -> Day -> IO VarianceSwap

-- | Realized variance -- requires a pricing engine to be set first
variance :: VarianceSwap -> IO Double

-- | Variance option: an option on realized variance, priced (e.g. via
--   <tt>integralHestonVarianceOptionEngine</tt>) against a payoff on the
--   variance level rather than the underlying price. This class does not
--   manage seasoned variance options.
varianceOption :: Payoff -> Double -> Day -> Day -> IO VarianceOption

-- | Discount factor at leg j's end date.
endDiscounts :: GenSwap s -> Word -> IO Double

-- | The j-th leg's cash flows.
leg :: GenSwap s -> Word -> IO Leg

-- | Basis-point sensitivity of leg j.
legBPS :: GenSwap s -> Word -> IO Double

-- | NPV of leg j.
legNPV :: GenSwap s -> Word -> IO Double

-- | The swap's maturity date, or <a>Nothing</a> if the swap has no legs.
maturityDate :: GenSwap s -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Discount factor at the instrument's NPV date.
npvDateDiscount :: GenSwap s -> IO Double

-- | The swap's start date, or <a>Nothing</a> if the swap has no legs.
startDate :: GenSwap s -> IO (Maybe Day)

-- | Discount factor at leg j's start date.
startDiscounts :: GenSwap s -> Word -> IO Double

-- | The BMA leg's cash flows.
bmaLeg :: BMASwap -> IO Leg

-- | Basis-point sensitivity of the BMA leg.
bmaLegBPS :: BMASwap -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the BMA leg.
bmaLegNPV :: BMASwap -> IO Double

-- | The Libor fraction that would make the swap's NPV zero.
fairLiborFraction :: BMASwap -> IO Double

-- | The Libor spread that would make the swap's NPV zero.
fairLiborSpread :: BMASwap -> IO Double

-- | The fraction of the Libor rate paid on the Libor leg.
liborFraction :: BMASwap -> IO Double

-- | The Libor leg's cash flows.
liborLeg :: BMASwap -> IO Leg

-- | Basis-point sensitivity of the Libor leg.
liborLegBPS :: BMASwap -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the Libor leg.
liborLegNPV :: BMASwap -> IO Double

-- | An option on a <a>VanillaSwap</a>.
swaption :: VanillaSwap -> Exercise -> SettlementType -> SettlementMethod -> IO Swaption

-- | Bullet bond vs Libor swap (par or market asset swap, per
--   <i>parAssetSwap</i>).
assetSwap :: Bool -> Bond -> Double -> GenIborIndex ibor -> Double -> Schedule -> DayCounter -> Bool -> Double -> Maybe Double -> Maybe Day -> IO AssetSwap

-- | The underlying bond's cash flows.
bondLeg :: AssetSwap -> IO Leg

-- | The bond's clean price, as passed to the constructor.
cleanPrice :: AssetSwap -> IO Double

-- | The clean price that would make the swap's NPV zero.
fairCleanPrice :: AssetSwap -> IO Double

-- | The non-par repayment that would make the swap's NPV zero.
fairNonParRepayment :: AssetSwap -> IO Double

-- | The non-par repayment, as passed to the constructor.
nonParRepayment :: AssetSwap -> IO Double

-- | Whether this is a par asset swap.
parSwap :: AssetSwap -> IO Bool

-- | Whether the bond coupon is paid (rather than netted against the
--   floating leg).
payBondCoupon :: AssetSwap -> IO Bool

-- | Fixed vs compounded-overnight-rate swap, with a single flat nominal
--   for both legs.
overnightIndexedSwap :: SwapType -> Double -> Schedule -> Double -> DayCounter -> OvernightIborIndex -> Double -> Int -> BusinessDayConvention -> Calendar -> Bool -> RateAveragingType -> Maybe Word -> Word -> Bool -> IO OvernightIndexedSwap

-- | As <a>overnightIndexedSwap</a>, but with a per-period nominal schedule
--   instead of a single flat nominal.
overnightIndexedSwap' :: SwapType -> [Double] -> Schedule -> Double -> DayCounter -> OvernightIborIndex -> Double -> Int -> BusinessDayConvention -> Calendar -> Bool -> RateAveragingType -> Maybe Word -> Word -> Bool -> IO OvernightIndexedSwap

-- | The overnight leg's cash flows.
overnightLeg :: OvernightIndexedSwap -> IO Leg

-- | Basis-point sensitivity of the overnight leg.
overnightLegBPS :: OvernightIndexedSwap -> IO Double

-- | NPV of the overnight leg.
overnightLegNPV :: OvernightIndexedSwap -> IO Double
class HasFixedLeg a
fairRate :: HasFixedLeg a => a -> IO Double
fixedLeg :: HasFixedLeg a => a -> IO Leg
fixedLegBPS :: HasFixedLeg a => a -> IO Double
fixedLegNPV :: HasFixedLeg a => a -> IO Double
class HasFloatingLeg a
floatingLeg :: HasFloatingLeg a => a -> IO Leg
floatingLegBPS :: HasFloatingLeg a => a -> IO Double
floatingLegNPV :: HasFloatingLeg a => a -> IO Double
class HasSpread a
fairSpread :: HasSpread a => a -> IO Double
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.SwapType
instance GHC.Internal.Enum.Enum QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.SwaptionPriceType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.SwapType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.SwaptionPriceType
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasFixedLeg QuantLib.Internal.Type.OvernightIndexedSwap
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasFixedLeg QuantLib.Internal.Type.VanillaSwap
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasFloatingLeg QuantLib.Internal.Type.VanillaSwap
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasFloatingLeg QuantLib.Internal.Type.AssetSwap
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasSpread QuantLib.Internal.Type.VanillaSwap
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasSpread QuantLib.Internal.Type.OvernightIndexedSwap
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasSpread QuantLib.Internal.Type.AssetSwap
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasSpread QuantLib.Internal.Type.CreditDefaultSwap
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasSpread QuantLib.Internal.Type.YearOnYearInflationSwap
instance QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.HasSpread QuantLib.Internal.Type.CPISwap
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.SwapType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show QuantLib.Instrument.Swap.SwaptionPriceType
